title.native: どすけべエンカウント

188006.description:
Rejected, But Now They Love Me!? A Laid-Back Harem School Romantic Comedy

At the urging of his popular friend, Eita ends up confessing to two beautiful girls: the gentle and airheaded Aira Yuzu, and the serious, no-nonsense class president, Himeno Mei. Naturally, he’s expected to crash and burn… or so he thought. But for some reason, both girls start getting attached to him. Why!?
synonyms: Even Though I Was Rejected by the Two Most Beautiful Girls in My Grade, For Some Reason They Seemed to be Fond of Me

title.native: 学年の二大美少女にフラれたのに、何故か懐かれたらしい
title.romaji: Gakunen no Nidai Bishoujo ni Furareta Noni, Naze ka Natsukareta Rashii

188008.description:
Cho Yeon, a shaman-in-training, climbs a haunted mountain where seven women have gone up and been returned with no memory. She meets a mischievous, hopelessly horny ghost who’s more interested in romance than haunting. Unable to seal him, they strike a deal: he helps her gather spiritual energy, and she’ll help him avoid becoming a vengeful spirit. But every time he aids her, they must get intimate. When a mysterious man appears knowing her past, Yeon’s journey becomes even more complicated.

(Source: Lezhin US)

188009.description:
After a failed marriage, Camilla returns to the grand estate where she once worked as a maid—only to find that Mika Aberdeen, the young master she used to care for, has grown into a flirtatious playboy, constantly surrounded by women. He teases her relentlessly, igniting a desire in her to turn the tables and toy with him instead. But just as she’s about to strike, she stumbles upon a shocking secret—Mika is still a virgin?! As Camilla finds herself caught in a whirlwind of teasing and temptation, things take an even messier turn when her ex-boyfriend, Felix, suddenly returns to the estate…

(Source: Lezhin US)
synonyms: คามิลลา สาวใช้คนนี้ไม่ธรรมดา

188010.description:
Ha-Ram, who has been in relationships several times but ends up breaking up just before they start a relationship, starts to complain to his childhood friend, Un-Hyeon, at the end of a relationship like any other. While drunk, Ha-Ram suggests that Un-Hyeon help her...

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

Note: Part of Lezhin's Sunaemul Danpyeonseon (순애물 단편선) Collection.
synonyms: [Pure Love Anthology] Can't We Be Friends?

188011.description:
“The childhood friend I reunited with has changed a lot.”

Yeonwoo and Da-in start over from a misaligned starting point, vowing not to repeat past mistakes. But they end up in bed together before they can confirm their feelings for each other…

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

188012.description:
On her first day of college, Ho-eun joins a campus club—only to find herself surrounded by charming, shamelessly bold upperclassmen. All she's asked to do is read a book out loud. It seems simple enough… until she realizes exactly what she's reading. Flustered and unsure how to react, Ho-eun is caught between embarrassment, confusion—and a strange thrill she can’t quite explain. The way they look at her, the way they tease her... it awakens something unfamiliar. She wants to run, but something holds her in place. After all, her graduation depends on this club. Will she manage to escape the clutches of her dangerously perverted sunbaes, or will she be pulled deeper into their twisted game?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes 28 extra chapters.

188013.description:
Ban Village, a lawless area in Hanyang, is home to butchers who make their living by slaughtering cattle. It’s a refuge for those seeking to escape their past crimes. Su-yeon, whose family faces serious charges, is forced into a desperate situation. Her escape leads her to marry a giant butcher from Ban Village, a man whose imposing presence initially frightens her. Over time, she begins to see a different side of him, softened by his unexpected kindness.

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

188014.description:
Sua’s biggest dream is fulfilled when she is given the chance to costar with her lifelong role model, Seo-Hyeon, in a movie. But the line between professional and personal feelings starts to blur when the two women need to shoot a steamy bedroom scene. Unable to get her act together, Sua asks Seo-Hyeon to help her practice the scene. It should be okay since it’s just acting... right?

(Source: Tappytoon)

Note: Part of Bomtoon's and Lezhin's Jeonmunjing Ungni Danpyeonseon (전문직 웅니 단편선) Collection.
synonyms: [Professional Woongni Anthology] Please Teach Me, Sunbae-nim!

title.english: Women at Work: Teach Me, Mommy!

188016.description:
To protect her village, Chohee is offered as a human sacrifice to the feared Choneun Peak. But instead of death, she finds herself face-to-face with the infamous leader of a band of outlaws—rumored to be more beast than man. Yet the more time she spends in his shadow, the more his brutal reputation begins to crack. Who is the man behind the mask of the wolf—and why does he seem more protector than predator? In the deadly silence of the mountains, a dangerous bond begins to form.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes five extra chapters.

188017.description:
Dragons are considered the most sacred of all natural creatures. It's said that the dragon's Yeouiju can grant any wish. The fairy Seolha, who stumbles upon a dragon's offspring, welcomes it into her home, hoping it might grant her wish. However, the longer she spends with Yooseong, the more she finds herself drawn to him...

(Source: Lezhin, translated)
synonyms: 仙女の願い〜龍が叶えてくれるなら〜
Rize Opens a Magical Tool's Shop

title.native: 魔道具師リゼ、開業します

188019.description:
Manga artist Shungiku Uchida, whose numerous hit works include the revolutionary child-rearing manga "We are Reproducing," and "Minami's Lover," which has been dramatized for TV many times, was suddenly diagnosed with colorectal cancer in 2015...!

The slapstick events leading up to the discovery, hospitalization, and surgery, the mechanism and side effects of anticancer drugs, the physical and environmental changes that ensued, and the turbulent days with her four children before and after the surgery... The author's unique comic essay on the battle against cancer faces cancer head-on and describes it in her trademark frank style.

(Source: Bunkasha, translated)
synonyms: Ganmanga: We Have a Serious Disease

title.native: がんまんが～私たちは大病している～
title.romaji: Gan Manga: Watashitachi wa Daibyou Shiteiru

188020.description:
Isaac Carter, the underboss, and soon to be the next leader of the mighty outfit “Rustynail”, is informed that he is going to be training Phil Rustynail, the Boss’s secret son. What he couldn’t tell was that he was Isaac’s one-night stand... To make matters worse, the Boss is considering Phil as the successor to the crown of the world’s most powerful crime family...!

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note:Part of Blühen's Hageukasang (하극상) Short Story Collection or Downfall Collection in English.

188021.description:
Kwon Joonhyuk, the class president infamous for his terrible personality, gets caught up with Min Dohyun at the freshman party. What starts as a seemingly harmless gathering takes a dark turn when Joonhyuk wakes up in Dohyun’s place, his hands tied to a bedframe. Now, it’s time to uncover the perfect student’s secret little hobby.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Part of Blühen's Hageukasang (하극상) Short Story Collection or Downfall Collection in English.
synonyms: [Hageuksang Short Story Collection] The model student's hobby is picking up trash
[Downfall Collection] The Perfect Student's Secret Hobby

188022.description:
Zhui Yu, an elite mercenary, transmigrated to another world as the unwanted daughter of a family of alchemists, trampled, and bullied by everyone. Nonetheless, Zhui Yu decided to live strong in place of her body's original owner and destroy every person who ever bullied her!

(Source: Webcomics)

title.english: When the Dragon King Falls for the Loli Alchemist

synonyms: …It's not like I don't want it!

188024.description:
A forbidden tale you must never witness. Imuko beckons you into the accursed realm. Deep within a secluded forest, a sacred rope stretches across the trees. Beyond it lies a world unlike our own. From that side, a lone girl has crossed over… Her name is Imuko, and those who encounter her are said to meet a dreadful fate. You must not set foot beyond the line. You must not meet her gaze. You must not speak to her.

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

188025.description:
Jiyeong has a secret: she’s got a full-blown finger fetish. And unfortunately (or maybe fortunately), her best friend Garam has the most perfect shands he’s ever seen. Long, slender fingers... veins in all the right places... yes, Jiyeong is quietly fangirling over them like it’s a full-time job. But now there’s a new problem: Is it just the hands she likes… or is it Garam too? After venting to a friend over drinks, Jiyeong blacks out—only to wake up to a shirtless Garam staring down at her.

“Do you like me that much?”

“…I-it’s not you! It’s your hands!!”

What started as a harmless little obsession is spiraling fast into chaos. Can Jiyeong separate love from... limbs?

(Source: Lezhin US)

188027.description:
Chan-Hee is a fierce gangster who is unexpectedly hit with wisdom tooth pain after beating up a rival gang. When she goes to a dental clinic to get it removed, she falls head-over-heels for Ha-Jin, the beautiful dentist who happens to be on the night shift. Although Ha-Jin rejects Chan-Hee when she asks her on a date, it doesn't stop Chan-Hee from bringing her fancy lunches and gifts to woo her. One thing leads to another and they hook up at the clinic, but can their new relationship last when they're from two completely different worlds?

(Source: Tappytoon)

Note: Part of Bomtoon's and Lezhin's Jeonmunjing Ungni Danpyeonseon (전문직 웅니 단편선) Collection.
synonyms: [Professional Woongni Anthology] Pick Out My Love Too

188029.description:
Yoon Hyunwoo is a pharmaceutical salesman with a secret craving. By day, a diligent office worker, by night, a dom... or so he wishes. Unfortunately, his girlfriend, Soojin, has no interest in BDSM. Worse yet, she’s his top client, so breaking up is out of the question. Frustrated and seeking release, Hyunwoo turns to an app to find a willing sub. What starts as harmless online flirting soon leads to a meeting—and the surprise of his life. His chat partner is none other than his cold, no-nonsense boss, Park Gaeun. As their late-night sessions grow more intense, the lines between dominance and submission, work and pleasure, begin to blur beyond control.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes five extra chapters.

188030.description: Note: The first story in Daewon's Neungyong Romance Danpyeon (능욕로맨스단편) Collection.

188031.description:
After two years trapped in the dull rhythm of daily life, Heesu has grown numb—disconnected from herself and everything around her. But when she stumbles across a cryptic online ad offering a one-day BDSM roleplay experience, something stirs. Torn between fear and curiosity, she agrees to surrender control—if only for a day. What begins as a fleeting escape soon becomes a raw plunge into desire, power, and vulnerability. As boundaries blur, Heesu must confront not just the limits of pleasure, but the aching emptiness she's been running from.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.
synonyms: 彼女の危険なプレイ体験

188032.description:
A memorial book featuring side stories of Fullmetal Alchemist and other content.

1. Hagane no Renkinjutsushi Gaiden: Moumoku no Renkinjutsushi
2. Hagane no Renkinjutsushi Gaiden: Shishou Monogatari
3. Hagane no Renkinjutsushi Gaiden: Nagai Yoru
4. Hagane no Renkinjutsushi 44.5: Tsukanoma
5. Hagane no Renkinjutsushi: Tobenai Tenshi Prologue
6. Hagane no Renkinjutsushi 2: Akai Elixir no Akuma Prologue
7. Hagane no Renkinjutsushi 3: Kami wo Tsugu Shoujo Prologue
8. Hagane no Renkinjutsushi: Akatsuki no Ouji Prologue
9. Hagane no Renkinjutsushi: Tasogare no Shoujo Prologue
10. Hagane no Renkinjutsushi Gaiden: Tabi no Hajimari

title.native: 鋼の錬金術師 20th ANNIVERSARY BOOK

188033.description:
Hui-Su, who has been single for 24 years and has grown up normally, finally has the love she has always dreamed of, but her fantasy is shattered by her first sleep with her boyfriend. So, she goes to a lesbian bar with her lesbian friend Jae-Yeon while drunk and meets Ju-Hui there. They are attracted to each other and end up kissing. Hui-Su feels confused about her sexual orientation and feels guilty about her boyfriend.

Confused, Hui-Su visits the lesbian bar several times to meet Ju-Hui again, and finally meets Ju-Hui again. Just before the two leave the motel and head out, Ju-Hui sees her boyfriend's KakaoTalk message on Hui-Su's phone. Ju-Hui, dumbfounded, leaves. Hui-Su thinks she left because she couldn't do it, and breaks up with her boyfriend because she feels sorry for him. However, Joo-Hee already misunderstands that Hui-Su is still dating her boyfriend. Even while in a relationship with her FWB, Min-Young, Ju-Hui continues to be concerned about Hui-Su.

Will Ju-Hui and Hui-Su be able to properly convey their feelings to each other?

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

Note: Includes three extra chapters.

188042.description:
A collection of 9 wonderfully weird and violent short stories from the mind of Kaneko Atsushi.

1. A Convenient Fiction (コンビニエンス・フィクション)
2. The Paranormal Phenomena Research Society (超常現象探究会)
3. BANG! x3
4. Eat Meat!
5. Tanaka Kachou VS Hamakawa Unyu (田中課長 V.S. 浜川運輸)
6. Hit and Run (ヒット・アンド・ラン)
7. The Thief and The Pencil (泥棒と鉛筆)
8. Full of Holes (穴だらけ)
9. FUCK THE FUCKIN' FUCKED FUCKER

188043.description:
I’m under a curse that makes the opposite sex appear as animals, and yet, I might just be falling for the “Gorilla” who sits next to me. She’s got a muscular build, coarse body hair, and a rugged, chiseled face—literally too far from human to be a typical love interest. But her voice, her gestures, and the way she responds in conversation? They’re all unmistakably those of a cool, composed girl.

As I spend my days getting along (sort of?) with this Gorilla, I can’t help but realize I’m genuinely drawn to her… though the all-important method to break this curse remains nowhere in sight!

Then one day, a “cat”—a senior one year above me, dressed in the boys’ uniform—shows up and says:

“I know how to break this curse.”

This is the story of my ordinary days with a gorilla, painted by a curse.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: 隣のゴリラに恋してる
幼馴染、ときどき女子高生。リボンをするのは俺の前で
title.romaji: Osananajimi, Tokidoki Mesukousei. Ribbon wo Suru no wa Ore no Maede

title.native: 淫靡なトラップに嵌められる女たち ～罠に堕ちた人妻とアイドル～
title.romaji: Inbi na Torappu ni Hamerareru Onna-tachi: Wana ni Ochita Hitozuma to Aidoru

188046.description:
Hina Airi, a senior one year above me, is renowned as the most beautiful girl in school. To me, Masahi Shuuma, she’s just my sister’s friend—someone I barely know beyond a polite nod… or at least, that’s how it was supposed to be.

"Looks like I enjoy spoiling you, Shuu-kun."

It all started when I visited her house to check on her while she was sick. Since then, Hina-senpai has been closing the distance fast—homemade meals, dates, lap pillows…

"Hey, I want you to teach me more. Why does my body ache for you—?"

She shows me a side of herself no one else gets to see. Before I know it, we’re in a temporary relationship!?

"I’ll make sure you can’t live without me, so you’d better brace yourself."

A romcom where my senpai pampers me into blissful ruin!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)
synonyms: My Sister's Friend is a Beautiful Senior Who is a Year Older, Spoils Me to Death.

title.native: 一つ年上で姉の友達の美人先輩は俺だけを死ぬほど甘やかす。
title.romaji: Hitotsu Toshiue de Ane no Tomodachi no Bijin Senpai wa Ore Dake wo Shinu Hodo Amayakasu.

188069.description:
Getting ghosted is the worst way to break up, no contest. After years of heartbreak, Eun-Kyo finally gets to enjoy a quiet life running a café with her best friend. But peace shatters when Jae-Heon, their new basement tenant, barges into her life. Wild, handsome, and maybe a bit of trouble, he begins to test Eun-Kyo's resolve to swear off dating.

(Source: Manta)

188070.description:
Uce, a down-on-his-luck young man, dreams of becoming the champion in the brutal and legendary War of Corpses—a sport where necromancers and their knights battle for supremacy. In a desperate bid, he revives Eleonora, an abandoned corpse who claims to have been the deadliest mercenary alive. There are two big problems, though. One, Eleonora is alive — a fact that cannot be revealed at any cost. Two, she and Uce can’t seem to coordinate their movements. Can this unlikely duo overcome all obstacles, win the War of Corpses, and prove everyone wrong?

(Source: WEBTOON)

188071.description:
As a child, Shin Woo-Jin was kidnapped and locked away in a warehouse, forced to live as a slave. But against all odds, he was rescued and finally stepped into the outside world. Though free, Woo-jin wasn’t like other children. He had an extraordinary gift—the ability to read people. By observing the smallest facial expressions and unconscious gestures, he could see through their thoughts, emotions, and intentions with near-perfect accuracy. Like a profiler, like a modern-day Sherlock, Woo-Jin learned to navigate the world, one observation at a time. But for someone who sees too much, living an ordinary life is the hardest thing of all. All he ever wanted was a peaceful, simple life. But the world had other plans.

“As I thought… living a normal life is far too difficult.”

(Source: Naver, translated)
synonyms: The Genius Who Sees Through the World
The Genius Who Reads the World

188072.description:
How is the reincarnated heroine supposed to survive as Enrica, a powerless noble lady who gets killed by her archduke husband on her wedding night? Fortunately, a mysterious but kind Count Belbrington hears Enrica's plight, suggests that she find another man to marry, and even says yes to her following proposal! Everything seems strangely smooth sailing from there. Not only is Enrica's power-hungry father surprisingly cool with her marrying a man of lower status, but the murderous archduke isn't retaliating at her for breaking off their engagement, either. Something's not adding up, but what could it be...?

(Source: Tappytoon)
synonyms: Hidden Villain, I'll Do Everything for You Except Marriage!

188073.description:
Hyeol Yu is a third-rate warrior feared more for his menacing appearance than his actual skills. Branded by false rumors and endless misunderstandings, he has long been an outcast in the world of martial arts. But everything changes when Seolhwa, the woman he once vowed his life to, reappears before him as a true martial arts master. From that moment on, Hyeol is thrust into chaos, his name weaving its way through the ranks of warriors, sects, and factions. As his unwanted reputation spirals out of control, he is pulled into a conflict far greater than he ever imagined.

(Source: WEBTOON)

188074.description: An unfortunate story in the spring of youth about a boy who can’t get off without being bullied by three girls.

synonyms: A Manga Where the World Is Saved by Sniffing and Breathing

title.native: スーハースーハースーハースーハー
title.romaji: Suu Haa Suu Haa Suu Haa Suu Haa

188079.description:
Jin Yu-An is a shy, sweet-faced sub who’s never actually tried any real SM play. He’s never had a partner or a lover—mostly because he’s way too busy, kind of a scaredy-cat, and hasn’t found anyone who fits his taste. One day, while browsing a BDSM app, he stumbles upon a profile that makes his heart race… only to realize the guy hasn’t logged in for years. Still, hoping against hope, Yu-An starts sending him cheerful messages. And then—a reply.

[You got a death wish?]
[Can’t you see my age?]

Oops. He missed the guy’s age. And the terrifying attitude in the response? Yikes. But somehow, Yu-An gets stubborn and insists on meeting him. The guy is exactly his type—intense gaze, scary tattoos, and an aura that screams danger. BDSM? More like organ theft??

Still… should he give this scary-sexy dom a shot?"

(Source: Lezhin US)
synonyms: マイ・サディスティック・マスター

188080.description:
Ménage à trois? More like menace à trois!

As a bashful, introverted BL lover, all Min-Ji Kim ever wanted for her final year of middle school was to be left alone to draw dinosaur-themed superhero smut -- Ahem, tasteful fanfiction. So exactly how she became part of the so-called Future Vision Club with school rebel Hae-In Shin and straight-laced student Ji-Su Han, she’ll never quite understand. The only thing that’s clear is that the year ahead promises to be unforgettable, to say the least! So, prepare for trouble and make it… triple?

(Source: WEBTOON, edited)

188081.description:
A brutal attack as a child leaves Hyun-Tae emotionless and numb with the inability to feel pain. His condition allows him to become a ruthless gangster that everyone fears. As he begins to hunt for the truth about his past, he also sets his eye on finding a missing jewel worth millions that puts his life at risk.

(Source: SpotToon)

188082.description:
""Become a hero!"

With that dream in her heart, Shirumiruku Eru became an adventurer. But becuase she had no special skills, she struggled to find companions.

That’s when she got the chance to join the dungeon investigation led by Yuris, a great sage who specializes in healing. However, rumor has it that all adventurers who accompanied Yuris have had their spirits broken and abandoned their path as adventurers halfway through… You see, Yuris had a bizarre interest in getting excited by the sight of female adventurers being attacked by monsters.

And so begins a cruel adventure where death is never an option!

(Source: Kurage Bunch)

title.native: もうやめて回復しないで賢者様！

188084.description:
Sousuke Satou, 18 years old (elementary school graduate), was summoned to another world, defeated the demon king, and returned to Earth for the first time in several years. While he is unable to find a job anywhere and lives a part-time job, he encounters a battle between a "magician" and a "monster" who he thought did not exist on earth! Sousuke easily defeats monsters, but that power catches the attention of others, and he ends up getting involved in demon subjugation...?! The former strongest hero takes part in modern, supernatural battles!!

(Source: Overlap, translated)

188085.description:
Asahiko, the reckless son of a long-established Western-style restaurant, spends his days lost in booze and women, letting the once-thriving business crumble.
In a bid to save the shop, Asahiko’s mother, the owner, calls in a business consultant, Komatsu, and the situation takes a dramatic turn.
Asahiko, uninterested in the restaurant’s future and willing to let it fail, clashes with Komatsu, who is determined to change the management strategy. But as they get to know each other’s pasts, their relationship begins to shift…!?

(Source: Shinshokan, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.native: いつか飛びたい風見鶏

188086.description:
"Sakuragi, I'm going to make you fall for me—no matter what."

Sakuragi Jun was living a peaceful life until he caught the attention of Samejima Rihito, the delinquent rumored to be the most dangerous guy in school. Stalked on the train, and chased through the halls—Sakuragi was nothing but terrified. But then, out of nowhere, Samejima confesses, "I like you."

Sakuragi is convinced he’s being messed with and is at a complete loss… but it turns out Samejima might actually be serious!?

(Source: Brite Shuppan, translated)

Notes:
- Originally self-published, was then licensed by Brite Shuppan for serialization.
- Includes three extra chapters.

鮫は桜に恋をする ～同棲編～

188088.description: Note: Published in "2D Comic Magazine Incest Yuri Sex vol.1".

188089.description:
Stylish, suave, and effortlessly popular with clients at the salon—Asuma seems to have it all. But what he truly longs for is a connection with another man. Once again, his dating app matches lead nowhere, so he heads to an elegant bar where his childhood friend Keigo works to vent his frustrations.
"Someone who's always been by my side, kind and comforting, witty in conversation, and a tall, handsome guy to top it off... The bluebird of happiness was right in front of me all along." —If only things were that simple!?

(Source: Gentosha, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.native: アンマッチング・ハートビート

188091.description:
Hazen Heim is a newly appointed imperial military officer who had the poor luck of being born without a silver spoon in his mouth. This means that instead of landing a cushy nepotism gig, he’s being sent to the front lines to deal with the worst of the worst. Awaiting him are scumbag supervisors who constantly steal credit, low-life leaders who love to abuse their power, and bumbling members of the brass who have never had to make a hard decision once in their lives. Fortunately, Hazen racked up decades of knowledge and experience in his past life as a legendary mage. Now it’s his turn to put the tyrants in their place, and they’re going to learn that when they go low, he goes lower…

(Source: Yen Press)

title.english: Rise of the Lowborn: Ascending the Ranks by Crushing Incompetent Nobles
title.native: 平民出身の帝国将官、無能な貴族上官を蹂躙して成り上がる
title.romaji: Heimin Shusshin no Teikoku Shoukan, Munou na Kizoku Joukan wo Juurin Shite Nariagaru

188092.description:
Nao has the worst luck with men—cheated on, treated as just a fling, never anyone’s first choice. No matter what, things never seem to go his way. And for some reason, Misumi, a fellow student from his department, always picks fights with him whenever they cross paths.
One night, after drinking too much and ending up too drunk to stand, Nao is unexpectedly helped by Misumi. They end up getting a hotel room and Nao finds himself venting about his ex. As usual, their conversation escalates into an argument, and before they know it—one thing leads to another, and they end up having sex…

(Source: Homesha, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.native: スキだと言いたいだけなのに
title.romaji: Suki da to Iitai dake nanoni

188093.description:
The serious-minded salaryman Umi meets the handsome Kai at a laundromat. Kai, having just been kicked out of the apartment where he was crashing with a girl, has nowhere to go. Seeing his situation, Umi offers him a place to stay.
Sharing meals, sleeping under the same roof… Umi, who has long felt lonely, finds himself gradually drawn to Kai. Mustering up the courage, he confesses, "I want to be with you, Kai." Kai responds with a kiss, making Umi believe they are finally a couple.
But then he learns the shocking truth—Kai never thought they were dating in the first place…

(Source: Homesha, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.native: ヒモと恋のすむところ
title.romaji: Himo to Koi no Sumu Tokoro

188094.description:
I'm Satsuki Mochizuki, 27 years old. After being unexpectedly dumped by my boyfriend, whom I thought I would marry, I tried solo camping and surprisingly found it quite enjoyable. In a twist of fate, I end up buying a mountain, only to discover it's an unexpected fantasy world. Now, I aim to escape from tent life and embark on a slow life in this otherworldly existence, prioritizing a tranquil lifestyle over romance.

(Source: Kakuyomu, translated)

title.native: 山、買いました ～異世界暮らしも悪くない～

188095.description:
Only a woman who gives birth to the prince's child can become queen. Can I take the throne when the Ladies'Chambers are so full of dangerous women?

(Source: Coolmic)

title.native: 異世界大奥～王妃になりたくば夜伽で殿下に愛され続けよ～
title.romaji: Isekai Oooku: Ouhi ni naritaku ba Yotogi de Denka ni Aisare Tsuzuke yo

188096.description:
I, Honori Chise, 24 years old, have a secret. I was born sensitive, so I react immediately when someone touches me and make strange noises...! Especially when it comes to someone I love, which is why my past relationships have always been failures. I'm supposed to act normal so no one will find out, but accidentally, my junior Kei, who is also my crush, finds out about my disposition...!? "You're reacting because you like me, right? There's no way I'd be bothered if you showed me your cute face like this." Kei loves me despite of my troublesome constitution and timidness. My love for him only grows stronger. I'm nervous at first, but little by little, I begin to feel Kei's heat as he loosens up my insides. "I'm so happy that I can be the first to see you like this.' The sweet and slightly sloppy caress of a younger junior is making me tingle with love!

(Source: MangaPlaza)

title.english: Kiss Me and Show Yourself, Just to Me
title.native: あばいてキスして、全部俺だけ
title.romaji: Abaite Kiss shite, Zenbu Ore dake

188097.description:
Anzu Yagihashi is in deep pain after her colleague stole her ex-boyfriend. As if this wound wasn’t enough, she receives an invitation to their wedding, amplifying her suffering and making the pitying and judgmental gazes around her cut even deeper into her heart.
On her way back from the wedding, she comes across a handsome bartender named Kyohei standing in front of a shop. His charming personality and warm words soothe her broken heart. However, over time, she finds herself confused by his overwhelming kindness, as if their connection might go beyond simple comfort.
Despite her growing attraction to him, Anzu realizes that Kyohei isn’t an ordinary man. He’s dangerous, and if she allows herself to be drawn into his emotions, she might find herself unable to escape.
synonyms: tonight with intense passion and fearless desire by your side

title.native: 今宵あなたとひたむき淫ら

188098.description:
Riko comes to see Shota after many years, bringing with her the bone of his sister Ai, who died 6 years ago. This deeply disturbs Shota, awakening a buried memory. The "bone" harbors a dark secret...

(Source: MANGA Plus)

188099.description:
Nora, who works as a maid in a wealthy family's mansion, has a crush on Makoto, the son of the family. One day, however, Makoto dies in a sudden car accident. That is when Makoto's twin brother Nozomu, who had been adopted away as a child, returns to the family. Appearing before Nora in her grief, "Should I become Makoto for you?"

Same face, different person, a bittersweet love story!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

Notes:
- All chapters were split into multiple parts in the original serialization and later combined in the volume releases.
- Includes four extra chapters.
synonyms: Don't Love Me with That Face.

188100.description:
A voluntary banishment declaration from the family, known as a "mastermind family!" In order to avoid destruction, Yuri decides to live an unconventional slow life in the frontier...!?

(Source: Kodansha, translated)
synonyms: Reincarnated Into a Villainous Family, but I'm Ignoring the Plot and Going Rogue!

title.native: 黒幕一家に転生したけど原作無視して独立する
title.romaji: Kuromaku Ikka ni Tensei Shita Kedo Gensaku Mushishite Dokuritsu Suru

188101.description:
Hyeong-Sik has one problem: The size of his dick. But he can't say no when he's offered a mysterious series of missions that promise to boost his size. With each challenge growing harder and hotter, will he be able to become a legend?!

"Take a peek at the landlord's wife's naked body."

(Source: DAYcomics, edited)

188102.description:
Kirishima Rei, a self-proclaimed introverted loner, botched his high school debut. By pure chance, he ends up saving the popular beauty Mikami Hina from a pinch. As thanks, she insists on spending lunch breaks together. But Mikami is clearly out of his league—a dazzling, untouchable flower. Rei figures this connection is just temporary; once her gratitude fades, they’ll go back to being strangers. Or so he thought—

Secret lunchtime meetups, after-school gossip, morning commutes, and weekend run-ins. Time spent with Mikami keeps piling up. Even when he tries to keep her at arm’s length, she brushes it off with a cheerful, “Don’t mind me♪,” barging deeper into Rei’s daily life.

An Invasion-style romcom unfolds between a kindhearted guy and a mysterious beauty!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)
synonyms: About The Case Where The Beautiful Girl I Rescued by Chance Became Attached to Me For Some Reason

title.native: 偶然助けた美少女がなぜか俺に懐いてしまった件について

女体育教師の喜辱　学生若牡との背徳蜜事
title.romaji: Onna Taiiku Kyoushi no Kijoku: Gakusei Wakashishi to no Haitoku Mitsuji

188105.description: Hibiki inherited a building from his wealthy grandfather. He decided to set up a handyman business with Ukyo Hase, who used to work for Hibiki's grandfather's detective agency. Before they knew it, they have somehow ended up in a relationship after sleeping with each other. They get a all sorts requests, ranging from obtaining proof of cheating to helping a band to find a substitute bassist. As they settle into their daily work, Ukyo's presence becomes second nature to Hibiki. However, there is a promise that he had forgotten about…

title.native: 高円寺スラップスティック

188106.description:
Sometimes people ask me, what kind of man was my father? This is his story.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

188107.description:
Luca, whose homeland was destroyed by a powerful curse, ended up bearing the curse himself. Determined not to let anyone else suffer the same misfortune, he sets out to uncover the curse's true nature by becoming a top-tier adventurer. Along the way, he meets the goddess Selimys and decides to become her "Proxy" (follower). Thus begins an adventure fantasy where a boy, now a servant of the goddess, races through a world entangled in divine conspiracies alongside his comrades!

(Source: Futabasha, translated)
synonyms: The Boy Who Became the Goddess's Proxy Rises as the King on the Board.

title.native: 女神の代行者となった少年、盤上の王となる
title.romaji: Megami no Daikousha to Natta Shounen, Banjou no Ou to Naru

188108.description:
"It's okay to do as I please, right, dear wife?" With his hot fingertips and sticky tongue... he teases my weak spots sweetly as I come again and again... This man whose thoughts I can't read turns into a "mean husband" only when he wants to tantalize me... "Please marry me." Fumika Momichi, who was leading a peaceful life working as the manager of a store, receives visit from a man who proposes to her with a bouquet of flowers in his hands. She soon finds out that her suitor is Masamune Isokawa, the heir of a large corporation. Confused by the marriage proposal of a childhood friend she doesn't remember, Fumika ends up having no choice other than marrying him after a certain event...!? Masamune's always smiling, elusive, and it's hard to understand his feelings. He tells her that getting married is one of the conditions for becoming the successor of his family. Despite that, he shows glimpses of attachment and twisted affection toward Fumika... How is her life going to be when she'll be at his mercy day and night!?

(Source: MangaPlaza)

title.english: The Scheming Heir Wants to Make His Wife Flustered and Make Her Cry ~This Contract Marriage Is a Sweet Trap~

188110.description:
I spent a decade cleaning up after Duke Havenik Brauno’s mess only to be murdered by him? Reincarnated as Aerin Brauno, an illegitimate child of the Brauno family, she’s horrified to find her adoptive father is none other than the man who killed her. This time, Aerin refuses to let him control her fate. Armed with the knowledge from her past life, she’s determined to escape his grasp and find a new path. Can she rewrite her destiny, outsmart the deadly Duke, and maybe even save the Brauno family?

(Source: WEBTOON)
synonyms: I Found a Family That Wasn't in My Adoption Plan
ครอบครัวผิดแผน

title.english: This Wasn’t in My Adoption Plan!

188111.description:
Anriette may look like an average noble, but she's actually a human who's been transported into the world of her favorite novel, cursed by its author for writing fanfics critical of the original ending. And as Anriette, her fate is to be slain by the very male lead she wrote her fanfics about! Can she use her inside knowledge to craft the ending she always dreamed of for her favorite lead?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: The Duke’s Obsession With His Wife

title.english: The Duke's Obsession With His Wife

188113.description:
When you're the infamous "genius killer" hitman The Fable, many things come easy. Being a normal person, however, isn't one of them. In fact, being told that he can't kill anyone for a while may just be the hardest job he's ever taken...

(Source: Kodansha USA)

title.native: ザ・ファブル The third secret

188114.description:
Lia, a penguin-turned-human, hides her anthropomorphic self from her dad for fear of abandonment and hatred. Fleeing her home, she’s discovered by Souradel—a killer whale anthro with a thing for penguins. His obsession with her fluffy belly leads to wild misunderstandings, mistaken kisses, and hilariously tense encounters. Now, Lia must dodge his affections while keeping her identity secret.

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: ペンギンですが、シャチに溺愛されています
L'orque folle et sa manchote préférée

188116.description:
After waking up inside a game, Minervina discovers that she has the ability to see information screens for everything within her new world. Unfortunately, she has also been given a quest to destroy this world, but she’s ignoring that. While Minervina wishes to use her near-omniscience to live a comfortable life, she’s continuously swept into chaos and political ploys. Her key to preserving the peace might be Exarch, the incorruptible Grand Duke. He seems to favor her, a trend that continues with everybody else, including the main system. Will Minervina be able to protect this world that loves her?

(Source: Tappytoon)

In this spin-off of the wildly popular series Kimongai, the untold stories of the demon-possessed are finally revealed! What drove them to seek power at the cost of condemning themselves to hell…?

"I love your crying face more than anything in the world. After all, I'm the only one you can cry in front of, aren't I?"

Achiba, an elite salaryman with exceptional work skills, happens to reunite at work with Sanami — someone he barely knew back in high school — and the instant they meet again, Achiba’s tears just won’t stop flowing! Ever since a certain incident twisted his personality and made it impossible for him to cry, Achiba now finds tears pouring out whenever and wherever he sees Sanami, no matter the situation. Meanwhile, Sanami teases him with that carefree attitude of his, all while making moves that feel suspiciously like he’s trying to seduce Achiba…? Little by little, along with those tears, both his heart and body start to melt.

(Source: Libre, translated)

188132.description:
Minori Kimura has made a manga adaptation of Kaho Nashiki's masterpiece "How Do I, and We, Live?" (Rironsha, later Iwanami Gendai Bunko)!
"I", a 14 year-old, is called "Koperu" after the main character of the novel "How Do You Live?" On the morning of the first day of the long weekend, his uncle Nobo, a dyer and weaver, comes to visit him and he decides to go and see his best friend Eugene, who has stopped going to school...
Why don't we think together about the meaning of living without letting go of "thinking"?

Ever since obtaining a device that could stop time, a power straight out of dreams, Shishigami had been living each day exactly as he pleased. One day, while in his usual frozen time, he encountered a classmate who was in the midst of attempting suicide by jumping...

188144.description:
On an April night in Tokyo, as the cherry blossoms are in bloom, blind university student Koharu Fuyutsuki spends time with the man she loves, Kakeru Sorano. In the three years since they started dating, he's shown just how much he cares about her, and even though Koharu can't see him, she can tell what a wonderful person he is. After all, Kakeru is the man who gave her a future. But just because they were gifted a miracle once, there's nothing to say it will continue forever. Pain and joy—and all the vibrant hues in between—color their lives like fireworks in the sky.

(Source: Yen Press)

In a world where Feminism has taken over the world, there are those who dare oppose it: The Homo Homo Block, a secret agency created to protect men's rights all over the world! 
Among the daily struggle of Homo Homo 7, an agent of the Homo Homo Block, there are agents from the Les Les Block getting in his way too!

188147.description:
A classic character of Japanese literature is reimagined as a mischievous, shapeshifting adventurer in this zany, Pop Art-esque gag manga by a titan of the genre.In the early 1960s, the Japanese manga artist Shigeru Sugiura took the well-loved literary character Ninja Sarutobi Sasuke and made him his own.

In this legendary gag manga, Ninja Sarutobi Sasuke, Shigeru sends the famous Ninja on a wild, eye-popping adventure: Sarutobi encounters cowboys and aliens, spaceships and sailing ships, mid-60s celebrity cameos, mushroom clouds, detectives with squirt guns, and more in a delightful and ever-surprising world.

(Source: New York Review Books)

Note: Complete revision of the original 1954 magazine serialization and is the basis for the NYR 2024 english licensed edition.

Ryohei, an invincible and dangerous yankee who gets support from men and women, loves Kanta, the local hated guy, famous for being the most whackjob around, if he's eager for a match, Kanta will take his dick out and they will jerk each other off.

Seeing Kanta being treated badly by the whole town, Ryohei's feelings grow distorted...?

After being ambushed by the Demonic Cult, Goheon Dok and Hyeonjo, his close friend from Mount Hua, are cornered and on the verge of losing their lives. Before they're both killed, Hyeonjo hands Goheon the Plum Blossom Spirit Beads, a sacred relic of Mount Hua that causes Goheon to take possession of the body of Muhwi, an apprentice of Hyeonjo. Now, as a Senior Disciple of Mount Hua, Goheon Dok must fight to protect Mount Hua and fulfill his friend's dying wish.

Everyone dreams of knocking out their insufferable boss, but what if that boss is a war hero, a duke, and constantly breathing down your neck? For Chloe, enduring Curtis's relentless inspections was a daily struggle... Until a royal marriage decree offers her an unexpected way out.

There's someone Haruto doesn't get along with. That person is Shin, a university student who works at his favorite restaurant. Haruto puts up with it, thinking that their relationship is merely a lunchtime encounter, but then Shin joins Haruto's company! For some reason, Shin seems to have taken a liking to Haruto, and he starts making aggressive advances towards him. Haruto hasn't had a girlfriend for a long time, and he's forgotten all about love, but...

Suit up! Jian is an Italian soccer league benchwarmer who needs to convince his childhood friend that he's a star player. A lucky goal or two might do the trick, but how long can he keep up the ruse? Unless, unbeknownst to him, Jian really is a genius...
