188161.description:
"NO WORKPLACE DATING! Violation results in death."

Thanks to this long-standing rule in the Gildong Gang, the organization’s top two members—Hwang Yongho, the boss's left-hand man, and Gu Jayeon, the boss's right-hand—maintain a fierce rivalry by day…but by night, things are much hotter behind closed doors. For four years, they’ve kept their secret romance under wraps. But one day, an anonymous note arrives:

"I know about your relationship. You're not the only two people in this office!"

(Source: Lezhin US)

188162.description:
The chaotic campus life of ‘Hakdo,’ a scholar from Cheonghak-dong, and ‘Dagu,’ a fanfiction-loving college freshman!

(Source: Toomics)

188163.description:
Nari is living her best life as a beautiful, wealthy university student on the prowl for hotties with her best friend, Miyeon. The pair live by Miyeon’s golden rule: don’t sleep with anyone at school. But Nari is having trouble abiding… When she accidentally hooks up with a junior from her university, the damage is done, right? What’s the harm in doing it again with another guy… or two? It was a silly rule anyway, right?

(Source: Tapas)

188164.description:
Yura is a huge fan of Jihyuk's live stream where he tries to survive in an apocalyptic game world, spending every last penny she has to buy him items. However, one day, she finds herself unexpectedly pulled into the game and actually meets Jihyuk! Despite having no skills or experience, Yura assists Jihyuk by purchasing items with her phone. Meanwhile, Jihyuk, who used to be a lone fighter, begins to enjoy Yura's company. Can they navigate this collapsing world together and make it out alive?

(Source: Tapas)

188165.description:
Watching his crush get married was too painful for Ryou so he left the ceremony and went drinking alone. At the bar, he met Hayato - who has the same voice as his crush - and went with the flow.

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.native: ゲームマスター獄木七笑に試される ～きみの人生逆転ショー、配信で見せつけちゃお？～
title.romaji: Game Master Hitoyagi Nanae ni Tame Sareru: Kimi no Jinsei Gyakuten Show, Haishin de Misetsukecha wo?

188168.description:
The strength of a Valhalla warrior comes from the Saga, a magical power born from the feats and achievements of their past life. Although Taeho was the world's greatest pro gamer and not a warrior, his character, the valiant Karstedt, was a legend in the world of Dark Age. Taeho must now begin a new saga to end Ragnarok and prevent the world from being destroyed.

(Source: WEBTOON)
synonyms: ヴァルハラサガ～ラグナロクゲームの実績でもレベルアップできますか？～

188169.description:
Koudai, heartbroken and single after being coldly dumped by his older girlfriend of three years from a office romance, finds himself wandering into a bar he’s never been to before after being abandoned by his colleagues who’ve grown tired of his complaints.

"You’ve got such a gloomy face. Hey, how about having a drink with me?"

The one who calls out to him is Oyanagi-san—a petite, energetic woman far smaller than the tall Koudai. Turns out, she's been cheated on and dumped by her boyfriend.

Bonding over their shared heartbreak, the two hit it off instantly and end up spending a single night together—

(Source: DASH X Bunko, translated)

188170.description:
Everyone has different tastes. An old school friend of Ha Na-Yeon hired her to seduce her husband. His preferences in sex life are strange to Ha Na-Yeon, but she will do anything to achieve the goal and earn a lot of money.

(Source: Toomics, translated)

188171.description:
1. Towa no Hana (永遠の花) [Tamio Baba]
2. Magnum no Kyuujitsu (マグナムの休日) [Hisashi Matsumoto]
3. Lupin III SSK wo Tori Modose!! (ルパン三世SSKを取り戻せ‼︎) [Takumi Karina]
4. Keitai Deka Kouichi Zenigata (ケータイ警部銭形幸一) [Shinpei Ito]
5. 101-pon no Zantetsuken (101本の斬鉄剣) [Eiji Nakanishi]

title.native: ルパン三世オムニバス

188172.description:
Seo Bo-jin, a college freshman, has a top-tier face and body, but her brains are well below average. Bo-jin ends up going on a pre-orientation trip with her handsome and well-off classmate Hyung-woo and a tall, well-built senior who’s the head of the student club. On a late-night bus heading to Gapyeong, Bo-jin, drunk and passed out, opens her eyes to find...

(Source: Lezhin, translated)
synonyms: Three of us on a Late-Night Bus

188173.description:
Han Seung-Ah, a vampire with a unique condition where men trigger her libido, instead of hunger. To keep herself safe, she's built a quiet life working at a company dominated by women. But her carefully constructed world is shaken when Lee Kang-Hyuk, a really handsome new male employee, arrives. While everyone else is swooning, Seung-Ah is plotting his swift departure. But her plans go awry, and she finds herself in increasingly awkward and perilous situations, battling the urge to sink her teeth into him.

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

188174.description:
A special collaboration book by Usamaru Furuya and Yama Wayama to commemorate the 15th anniversary of the publication of Litchi Hikari Club.

Includes a collection of short manga and illustrations by Yama Wayama based on the original work created before her debut which was highly praised for its quality.
The collection also contains a previously uncompiled spin-off story by Furuya titled Yumemiru Gantai (ユメミル眼帯) and Yumemiru Kurobara (ユメミル黒薔薇)

title.native: ライチ☆光クラブ コラボレーション

188175.description:
After being joyfully reunited with Jin-Han Ryu, the best friend of her brother, Ha-Yeon Ji’s day immediately takes a turn for the worse as the two witness her boyfriend with another woman, right in front of them. After a series of awkward, coincidental encounters between the two, Ha-Yeon and Jin-Han begin to get reacquainted with one another. But after spending some time together, Jin-Han seems to begin seeing her as more than his friend’s little sister.

(Source: WEBTOON)

Note: Includes three extra chapters.
synonyms: คิมหันต์นิรันดร

188177.description:
Yeon-hwa, who had to hide her identity and run away to a school for women called 'Hwajeopru' because her father was framed and killed for treason, barely managed to survive. 

Unable to adapt to Hwajeopru, Yeon-hwa, who was wandering around, is noticed by Wol-yeong, who begins to take care of Yeon-hwa, and feelings that go beyond friendship gradually begin to bloom between the two women...

(source: Naver, translated)

188178.description:
An apothecary lives a quiet life selling potions and medicine in a country village, until one day he’s approached with a devil’s bargain. A pawnbroker offers him the perfect ingredient for crafting legendary medicine—but the “ingredient” turns out to be a mortally wounded elf! Legend has it the flesh and bones of elves can be ground up into a true panacea, and this elven maiden is on the brink of death after being ruthlessly tortured by slavers. Filled with rage, the apothecary vows to nurse her back to health and happiness, no matter what it takes.

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title.english: The Apothecary Is Gonna Make This Ragged Elf Happy
title.native: ボロボロのエルフさんを幸せにする薬売りさん
title.romaji: Boroboro no Elf-san wo Shiawase ni Suru Kusuriuri-san

synonyms: 為遍體鱗傷的精靈調製幸福配方的賣藥郎

title.native: ボロボロのエルフさんを幸せにする薬売りさん
title.romaji: Boroboro no Elf-san wo Shiawase ni Suru Kusuriuri-san

188180.description: A karaoke prophet wanders around the town singing weird prophecies into his trusty handy karaoke. No matter how you look at it he's a risky guy, but his sinister prophecies are always right. A puppy that high schooler Yori got from her boyfriend dies. Later, a middle-aged man drowns after falling into a waterfall, a giant fire occurs in the city, and… even more?! The scary, the grotesque, even the ridiculous: a collection of bizarre horror stories!

188181.description:
A fateful mix-up brings an unexpected twist to a student's life at a cram school. When a mysterious package meant for his star lecturer, who shares his name, lands in his hands, an unusual relationship begins to unfold between them —one that blurs the lines between student and teacher.

(Source: Toomics)

Note: Includes 15 extra chapters.

188182.description:
The No.1 Hitman, Kim Gun, finds himself plunged into the world of martial arts due to a mysterious accident. To return to his original world, he must complete a mission called 'Martial Arts Conquest.' With a total of 2 guns, Kim Gun's adventure to subdue the unfamiliar martial arts world begins.

(Source: Naver, translated)

title.native: 夏休み、婆ちゃん家で起きた不思議な話
title.romaji: Natsuyasumi, Baa-chan-chi de Okita Fushigi na Hanashi

188184.description:
Have you ever been so angry that you wanted to break the laws of physics and throw down with a cosmic being? Well, you might if you’re Great—no, not “great”; I mean Great the Executioner. On planet Graymark, where the law decrees that all sinners must die, Great makes a name for himself butchering criminals in their thousands. Except now the law is no more, and Great must stand trial before the King of the Cosmos, Lohumlagaha. Enraged by fate, Great takes up his sword. It's just one last time… Or is it?

(Source: WEBTOON)

188185.description:
'Jodi', a girl who left her hometown to come to the city in search of a job, is a housekeeper for 'Mel', who is rumored to be crazy, in the city full of danger. Mel asks Jodi, whom she just met, to bring her a 'corpse' out of the blue..! A story about various weak people shown by 'Mel', a magician who can only burn corpses, and 'Jodi', a girl who learned about the world too early.

(Source: Kakaopage, translated)

188186.description:
A lawless city where the strong prey on the weak. Let's fix this wrong city.

(Source: Naver, translated)

Note: Chapter count includes a prologue.

188187.description:
The moment Duke Arcus saved her when she was a refugee, Miel became a sunflower. And after covering her heart with sincerity for 8 years… “Marry me.” The lord said to her who had become a capable adjutant. “I think you will be the least troubled.” What he wanted was a superficial relationship. To remain as a duchess until he passes the ducal title to his nephew. As always, the cool and cool man said that he would take care of everything as long as she did not produce an heir. The education of her siblings, the debt of the family. So she accepted. For the sake of everyone, she was able to hide her feelings until the end. However, his attitude is becoming more and more confusing. Could it be that he is also interested in me

(Source: Naver, translated)
synonyms: Unrequited Love Does Not End With Marriage
片想いは結婚しても終わらない

188188.description:
Burned out from work, Yeon-Seul’s long-awaited vacation takes a disastrous turn when she finds herself stranded on an island. Her only company? A maddeningly handsome stranger, infuriating as he is irresistible–but with survival forcing them together, sparks fly and an impulsive marriage marked by a night neither can forget transforms their relationship into something rather intimate. But as rescue brings an end to their rendezvous, Yeon-Seul reluctantly resigns herself to the end of her castaway romance–except her island husband doesn’t want to, their love story far from over.

(Source: WEBTOON)

188189.description:
Fifteen years ago, Eun-Seol was accused of attempting to murder her co-star, Yi-Hyeok. Her career ended and she hasn’t known peace since, all because her mother made her take the fall for her brother so he could keep acting. In present time, Yi-Hyeok is trying to find a way to displease his grandfather in order to change his inheritance and decides to approach Eun-Seol with an offer for a fake relationship. All they have to do is be convincing… so convincing that even they may start believing it.

(Source: Tapas, edited)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

188190.description:
Find love and…500 million won?! Three women are about to take on a special challenge to escape their “forever alone” status. The “airhead” Jurim, the “trash collector” Seona, and the “devout Christian” Chaeyul are ready to compete for both money and love for the first time ever. Who will take it all?

(Source: WEBTOONS)

188191.description:
When erotic novelist Enomura Haruka and shojo artist Nakata Miruku are brought together by their publisher to collaborate on a new manga, it seems like a perfect match—until the two meet in person and realize just how different they are! Haruka is a bit of a sadist with a cool-guy personality, and he immediately clashes with Miruku, who’s something of a masochist and doesn’t match his bright shojo style at all. There’s one thing the two have in common, however—their love of gourmet food, especially the mail-order variety. Can their passion for amazing food bridge the gap between them? Or could food be the catalyst that causes their passions to boil over? Includes reviews of real gourmet food items from Japan!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)
synonyms: Sensei’s Mail-Order Food: The Complete BL Manga Collection

188192.description:
If you want to make a man out of yourself in a hurry, this method sure beats a musical montage.

(Source: HMarket)

title.english: My First Orgasm: Lovey-Dovey Sex with a Girl Who Runs @ #NSFW Account
title.native: #裏垢お姉さんといちゃラブ精通式 ～ショタの絶倫ピストンに潮吹き絶頂～
title.romaji: #Uraaka Onee-san to Icha Love Seitsuushiki: Shota no Zetsurin Piston ni Shiofuki Zecchou

title.native: ねぇ、ことりの秘密見たでしょ?

188194.description:
In his hurried transfer to a rural school, Hyoun meets Seonhong, a bright and cheerful classmate who is everything he is not. As often happens with first love, the two quickly become each other’s whole world. But one day, Seonhong vanishes like smoke, leaving behind nothing but memories of a brilliant love at eighteen. Ten years later, they cross paths again by chance at a blind date arranged for Seonhong. Overwhelmed by the pain of being abandoned, Hyoun greets her not with joy, but with betrayal and vengeance.

"Have you thought about it? Ten million won for one night."

Their love is now tangled with resentment and regret. Can something so broken ever be mended into love again?

(Source: Lezhin US)

188195.description:
Taeseong, an actor past his prime known for playing gangster roles, accidentally switches places with a real-life gangster named Mun-gil. Taeseong’s life suddenly turns into a scriptless scene filled with dangerous thugs! One wrong move could mean the end for him. Will Taeseong be able to make it out alive in this world of real gangsters?

(Source: WEBTOON)

188196.description:
An orphan in real life one day wakes up as a main character in a novel she was reading. An orphan in the novel as well, she is adopted to a villainous family who served as the main adversary against the main character in the original plot... except, the family seems way nicer than she expected. Are these really the same villains that caused so much pain the novel?

(Source: Pocket Comics)
synonyms: 悪役公爵家に売られましたが幸せになります

title.english: The Perks of Being a Villain

188197.description:
What caused the massive earthquake is a mystery. Could it have been the time machine Gyungbae built? Was it the construction going on outside the school? Or was it something darker? Something that now lurks the hallways of the buried school, preying upon those who lingered? Whatever it is, the students and teachers trapped within the darkened halls of the school have more pressing issues to think about, like finding more food, whether they'll ever be rescued, and who stole Eunhui’s body...

(Source: Tapas)

188198.description:
While organizing books in the library, while exercising during a club activity, while walking down the hallway, love came unexpectedly the moment our eyes met. A refreshing love story of girls who are in a relationship.

Yeonjin and Jiwoon: Everyone's public, no awareness, a wounded devotion, a single-minded person. Jiwoon, a member of the library club, is taken aback when Yeonjin, a popular student at school, visits the library and approaches her in a friendly manner, but they gradually become closer. Jiwoon begins to like Yeonjin because of Yeonjin's behavior, which treats her differently from other people, and she believes that Yeonjin likes her too. However, she finds out that Yeonjin is Jiwoon's older sister's private tutor and that she is in love with her, not her...

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

188199.description:
Chae Gyeong-jun, who gave up both college and his dreams due to the IMF crisis, once again faces despair in front of his grandmother’s sudden hospitalization fees. But then, a “Mysterious Benefactor” steps in to cover the hospital costs for his family… 'Who would provide support that doesn’t help them at all, and why?' In search of an answer, Gyeong-jun heads to Taeseong.

(Source: Naver, translated)
synonyms: The Corporate Underdog Who Does Everything Right
A Corporate Underling Who Excels at Work
เบี้ยล่างระดับท็อป

188200.description:
"If I were her, I'd send them flying!" After a traffic accident, I was reincarnated in an otome game and swapped places with the villainess, Lady Alexandra. She was right in the middle of being condemned by her fiance, the second prince, under the spell of the heroine's charm magic. I sent him and the others flying! I thought I achieved a happy ending, but suddenly the world collapsed?! I awoke and found myself reliving Alexandra's life from childhood. Since regaining my memories, I've done all I could to avoid being condemned. This time around, instead of the second prince, I've caught the eye of the older and handsome crown prince...

(Source: MangaPlaza)

title.english: I Switched Places With the Condemned Villainess, But After Beating up Her Fiancé, True Love Was Waiting for Me
title.native: 断罪されている悪役令嬢と入れ替わって婚約者たちをぶっ飛ばしたら、溺愛が待っていました
title.romaji: Danzai Sarete Iru Akuyaku Reijou to Irekawatte Konyakusha-tachi wo Buttobashitara, Dekiai ga Matteimashita

188201.description:
To cover her father’s hospital bills, Ji-Wan agrees to become Tae-Seong's legal wife for three years; a marriage of convenience with one condition, one billion won once the contract ends. Bound by strict terms, the contract prohibits any contact throughout their marriage. Three years pass, and two weeks before the contract expires— Tae-Seong suddenly shows up at her door convinced that Ji-Wan is the love of his life. Now, with her payout on the line and Tae-Seong clinging to a love that never existed, will Ji-Wan still be able to walk away with the life she planned?

(Source: WEBTOON)
synonyms: Married Life That Crosses the Line

title.native: 地獄の沙汰も黄金次第 ～会社をクビになったけど、錬金術とかいうチートスキルを手に入れたので人生一発逆転を目指します～
title.romaji: Jigoku no Sata mo Ougon Shidai: Kaisha wo Kubi ni natta Kedo, Renkinjutsu Toka Iu Cheat Skill wo te ni Ireta no de Jinsei Ippatsu Gyakuten wo Mezashimasu

title.native: レベルガチャ～ハズレステータス『運』が結局一番重要だった件～@COMIC
title.romaji: Level Gacha: Hazure Status "Un" ga Kekkyoku Ichiban Juuyoudatta Ken@COMIC

188204.description:
For 15 years, Han Cho-Eun gave her all to actor Park Eun-Ho as his friend, his stylist, and eventually his lover. However, her heart is broken when she finds Eun-Ho cheating, exposing what a cruel "beast" he truly is. Determined to get revenge, Cho-Eun starts working for rival actor Cha Do-Jin and tries to seduce him one night while drunk. Though Cho-Eun only does this to show Eun-Ho she's moved on, Do-Jin surprisingly agrees to be seduced further! But will vengeance be as stylish as Cho-Eun imagines?

(Source: Tapas, edited)

Note: Chapter count includes a prologue.
synonyms: オオカミくんの落とし方

188205.description:
After being expelled from his guild under false charges, Gorsh decides to start solo streaming. During one of his solo farming streams, Danger Rank A dragons threaten to destroy his veggies! Five minutes later, he’s defeated all of them, and Gorsh apologizes for such a boring stream…but on the contrary, his viewers are hooked!

(Source: Manga UP!)

title.english: Local Farmer Kills Dragon, Outs Himself as The Strongest in the Land!
title.native: 最強は田舎農家のおっさんでした～最高ランクのドラゴンを駆除した結果、実力が世界にバレました～
title.romaji: Saikyou wa Inaka Nouka no Ossan deshita: Saikou Rank no Dragon wo Kujo shita Kekka, Jitsuryoku ga Sekai ni Baremashita

188206.description:
On a peaceful day, a text message announces the countdown until the end of the world. Soo Ah, a cheerful high school girl, sees how all of her loved ones gradually disappear and panics. She decides that the last thing she can try to do is save Sun Woo, her dear friend and crush.

(Source: Webcomics)

Note: Chapter count includes a prologue.

188207.description:
The death of So Kyung-Min, a coding prodigy who made a big splash in the world. But it doesn't seem right. What if he wasn't dead...?!

(Source: Naver, translated)

188208.description:
I was just enjoying my favorite web novel when the unthinkable happened—Castian, the male lead and my ultimate favorite, died in the most ridiculous way. Before I knew it, I found myself possessing Lydia, the necromancer who pulled him back from the dead! Whether it’s because I refuse to be falsely accused of harming my beloved character, or because even in his lifeless state, he remains as stunning as ever, I’m determined to save Castian no matter what. I ended up pretending to be his lover and officially joining his expedition team…

"Don’t leave my side, not even for a moment."

But wasn’t he supposed to distrust me? Why is Castian growing more and more affectionate toward me…?

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)
synonyms: I Am Being Loved by the Dead

188209.description:
“Pretty person! I like you!”

A 17-year-old dog-type who moved to Seoul from the countryside to find a new best friend, ‘Yuu’ meets ‘Robin’, a cat-type who is beautiful from head to toe, on the first day of school and makes a 100% straightforward confession.

The two part ways without even exchanging names due to the annoying ringing of the bell, knowing Robin’s pounding heart. Yuu follows her scent to meet her again and debuts as a student council worker…

The straightforward dog-type Yuu and the proud lover Robin’s crazy school life begins now!

(source: Peanutoon, translated)
synonyms: Please Give the Transferee a Pat

188210.description:
Upbeat witch doctor Kina Witchwood receives an ominous prophecy: she will face her execution in six months, but not before encountering three men--one she cannot refuse, one she cannot persuade, and one to whom she will vow her life. Though she tries to defy fate, she soon finds herself appointed as the emperor's personal physician and thrust into the heart of the imperial palace's trecherous political intrigues.

(Source: WEBTOON)

188211.description:
That song… It sounds like my brother’s unreleased track! Just before his untimely death, Su-In’s beloved older brother recorded an album dedicated to him – a final gift that was soon forgotten in a desk drawer. Years later, Su-In hears one of those tracks on TV, and it’s being claimed by his brother’s former bandmate. Now, Su-In must take the stage, beat the competition, and take back his brother’s songs… all through music.

(Source: WEBTOONS)

188212.description:
The “Demon King City,” where humans and demonkind coexist. In this city ruled by seven Demon Kings, one of them has been murdered. Arsarisa, the daughter of a hero who enforces justice under the law, sets out to solve the case and teams up with Keed, a rogue investigator who upholds loyalty over the law itself.

In a world swirling with violence and conspiracy, an unconventional investigation led by this mismatched duo begins.

188213.description:
Jingburger was having a rough time in life with finding a part time job and achieving her dream to become an idol. Since nothing was going as she was expecting, she was feeling very pessimistic about her future... until she met a magical poop head dog that suddenly told her that she had been forced to sign a "Magical Girls Contract" and took her to the "Magical World."

Now she has to defeat monsters in order to survive, but that's not all; the dog also tells her that if she succeeds in doing her duties of purifying monsters, she will be granted one wish. However, she is not the only magical girl desperate enough to have her wish granted, and there is another way to get your wish granted: by taking the soul of other magical girls!!

"How do you expect me to fight terrifying monsters like that?!"
"Why the hell is my weapon a hamburger?!!"
"What am I going to do if other magical girls try to hunt me?!!!!"

Six magical girls are in for a thrilling action-packed adventure!

(Source: Kakao, translated)

Note: Based on the VTuber group Isegye Idol.
synonyms: Magical Girls Are The Idols of This World

188214.description:
Then I thought it was a coincidence. That style is quite common and it’s not my specialty. After that, I got a little nervous. Did my drawing get copied and spread? Was it my follower? Was he referencing my style because he liked it?

Finally, I got anxious. When I saw the T-shirt with the pattern I drew myself, I thought, ‘Did I draw that pattern without knowing it? Or did my drawing get stolen?’

In the end, I asked her directly. “This one? I didn’t buy it anywhere...” And then, “I custom-made it myself. What do you think? Does it suit me?” She asked me back. She wore clothes that matched the style I drew, emphasized the items that emphasized the pattern I drew, styled the accessories so that they would stand out, and posed…

“I wanted to hear you say that I look good on you.” Looking straight into my eyes…

(source: Comico, translated)

188215.description:
Top Korean hunter Siu 'The Rabid Hound' Min defeated the Demon Lord with his disciples, only to be trapped in a monster-filled otherworld for 100 years. However, a century of struggles did not break Siu—it drove him to break his limits instead. Now, he returns to Earth with Pred, his mysterious partner, only to learn that his name and legacy have been erased, along with his disciples’... and that only 10 years have passed on Earth. As new conflicts arise, will Siu and Pred prevail and uncover the truth?

(Source: WEBTOONS)
synonyms: The Late Game Healer Is Way Too Strong

188216.description:
Hwalin Yong, once the shattered heir of a fallen martial sect, is thrust back in time-- but he isn’t alone. A monstrous darkness lingers at the edges of his mind, constantly whispering, waiting to claim him. Can Hwalin resist its pull, or will he surrender to the shadow? As the battle within intensifies, he uncovers a dormant power that could reshape his destiny and the fate of his sect.

(Source: WEBTOON)

title.english: Regression of the Yong Clan Heir

title.native: 人気配信者たちのマネージャーになったら、全員元カノだった
title.romaji: Ninki Haishinsha Tachi no Manager ni Nattara, Zenin Motokano Datta

188218.description:
Noah Harrington might not have been born with power or riches, but he was definitely born with talent. While breaking into Renée Academy to complete a request, he unleashes his wind magic against Illoise, an academy student. The headmaster offers Noah a chance to study at the academy after seeing his potential during the break-in. On the first day of school, a series of mishaps occur and Noah is given an ultimatum: study with Illoise or risk flunking. Will Noah be able to overcome the odds and show the nobles at school what he's capable of?

(Source: Tappytoon)

188219.description:
In a world where adventurers embark on perilous journeys to reach the legendary Golden Island, fierce battles unfold using golden weapons imbued with supernatural powers.
Among them is Shiba, a boy wielding a golden sword with an unusual trait—it "cannot cut anything." At first glance, his weapon seems utterly useless. But for Shiba, every challenge is just another thrill on his grand adventure!
Armed with his seemingly worthless blade, he defies expectations and overcomes impossible odds. His uncuttable sword is about to carve a new legend!

188221.description:
Housewife × teacher yuri.

It happened by chance, but she knew it was going somewhere. A mutual friend introduces a completely normal housewife to a completely normal school teacher. Little by litter, they get closer to each other, and before long, begin to want each other...

188222.description:
Leopold, a young boy, wakes up from a scary dream to find himself alone with his maid Eve in a dark and spacious mansion. He lives his life in the mansion, keeping the strange promise he gave to Eve, but gradually, mysterious events begin to take hold of Leopold.

(Source: Micro Magazine, translated)
synonyms: Six Days of Me and Eve

188223.description:
"Six months... Just six months, and it'll all be over."

After a one-night stand Hollywood top star Chase Miller, Joshua finds out he’s pregnant. As a single father, Joshua raises their child in secrecy. But when he is forced to return to work as Chase’s bodyguard, the two are reunited in a cruel twist of fate. Relieved that Chase doesn’t seem to remember him, Josh’s comfort is short lived - something primal, something desperate, yearns for the touch of his former lover, and every time he sees this beautifully twisted man, Josh’s heart races in spite of his mind. The more time passes, the more boundaries blur as instinct takes over… Will Joshua be able to resist the lips of his former lover? Or are the strings of fate too strong to resist?

(Source: Lezhin US)
synonyms: Kiss Me If You Can (キス・ミー・イフ・ユー・キャン)

188224.description:
Shy and reserved Lee-Won has admired the charismatic Seo Han-Gun for years, but their unexpected friendship blossoms into first love during middle school. Torn apart by reality, they lose touch for eight years—until a chance reunion in Busan forces them to confront old wounds and lingering feelings. Can love overcome the pain of the past?

(Source: Lezhin US, edited)
synonyms: The Only One Kind to Me

188225.description:
Enslaved by an archmage in another world for thirty years, Jihyeok is finally sent home to Earth with a pile of treasure. But when his riches disappear in transit, he’s left with nothing but his necromancy powers and a lazy attitude. Even worse, while he was away, Earth was invaded by monsters pouring out of gates. Posing as an Awakened, he summons armies of skeletons—not to hunt in the gates, but to start a business and earn his retirement funds with as little effort as possible!

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: How to Retire as a Disaster Necromancer

title.english: How to Retire as the Disaster-Class Necromancer

188226.description:
Jang Gwon-U, the illegitimate youngest son of the powerful Myeonghwa Group, is its one glaring stain—a troublemaker with devilish good looks but little else to recommend him. By his constant side is Hong Se-Ha, his ever-loyal, and workaholic, secretary. She has always genuinely and wholeheartedly assisted him and stood by his side. Against all logic, Se-Ha wanted him. No matter what. But a whispered, "Kiss me," blurs their boundaries, intertwining their bodies. Will Gwon-U and Se-Ha succeed in obtaining their captivating happily-ever-after?

(Source: Lezhin US, edited)
synonyms: How To Capture Your Boss's Body

title.native: 悪役令嬢の破滅の原因ですが、呪いの力で彼女を幸せにしようと思います。
title.romaji: Akuyaku Reijou no Hametsu no Genin desu ga, Noroi no Chikara de Kanojo wo Shiawase ni Shiyou to Omoimasu.

188228.description:
High school students Yukiya Sengoku and Airi Ichijo met online and became close friends after meeting up offline.

"I want to become closer..."

Yukiya and Airi have a feeling they're falling in love, but they both have a secret they can't tell each other. That secret is that Yukiya is the leader of a local boys' school for delinquents, and Airi is the leader of a local girls' school for delinquents! They must never let their true identities be revealed!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

Note: Originally self-published, it was picked up for commercial serialization by Comic Aily starting 2025-09-10.
synonyms: The Two Lovebirds Are Hiding Their Fangs: The Story of a Couple with a Crazy Gap

title.native: 恋するふたりは牙を隠す～ギャップがありすぎるカップルの話～
title.romaji: Koisuru Futari wa Kiba wo Kakusu: Gap ga Arisugiru Couple no Hanashi

synonyms: Dancing with You on the Snowy Night

title.native: 今宵、悪役令嬢の手をとれたら
title.romaji: Koyoi, Akuyaku Reijou no Te wo Toretara

188230.description:
Revered by his comrades, Seo Seung-Bum was once a man of unwavering strength. But when Hwang Jii-Hyuk uncovers his darkest secret, Seung-Bum becomes powerless against him. Stripped of control, he is forced into a world of torment—drugged, violated, and reshaped under the guise of twisted pleasure. As Ji-Hyuk’s cruel obsession spirals deeper, Seung-Bum struggles to grasp what his captor truly wants. Trapped in a cycle of pain and desire, he fights to survive each day… not knowing if escape is even possible.

(Source: Lezhin US, edited)
synonyms: Born on the 8th day of July

188231.description:
As high schooler Kagechiyo wakes up in his bedroom, he's surprised to find... a stunningly attractive girl sitting at the end of his bed? It's Moka, the girl of his dreams, and he's about to get another shot at getting her in the mood! As Kagechiyo starts another day in this new reality, he needs to find a way to get things right with Moka in any way he can...kissing, touching, or even further? How can Kagechiyo earn a perfect score and move forward with the super hot Moka?

(Source: Coolmic)

title.native: さよなら、私の大好きな1000人のキミ。
title.romaji: Sayonara, Watashi no Daisuki na 1000-ri no Kimi.

188232.description:
"Hey... will you still love me, even though I'm a former death row inmate?" Before her sentencing, Sawa couldn't stop thinking about her childhood friend, Itsuki. She had been executed for murder and was supposed to be dead, but against all odds, she survived...?! During the execution, the rope snapped, and Sawa narrowly escaped death. According to the law, inmates who survive their execution are no longer subject to further trials. Instead, they are considered "deceased" in the family register. Stripped of all legal protection, Sawa is now invisible to the world, enduring constant abuse and persecution as someone who no longer exists. But even so, Itsuki wants to protect her... This is the story of Itsuki and Sawa—A love that must overcome the whole of Japan against them.

(Source: Coolmic)

title.english: Would You Still Love an Ex-Death Row Inmate Like Me?
title.native: 元死刑囚でも私を愛してくれますか？
title.romaji: Moto Shikeishuu Demo Watashi wo Aishite Kuremasu ka?

188233.description:
There are tally marks notched on Michishige's thighs—a secret only Yuya knows! Due to the doodles on her legs, rumors spread that she was very experienced. People joked with Yuya, saying, "Get Michishige to help you become a real man!" As if he could ever do something like that… After things start to progress with Michishige, Yuya finally confesses his feelings. She responds, "If we're going to date, it has to be with the intention of getting married, right?" The tally marks on her thighs are actually her vows of love! With a quirky girl full of overwhelming affection, their romantic comedy begins!

(Source: Coolmic)

title.native: 道重さんはエッチな正の字を上書きされたい。
title.romaji: Michishige-san wa Ecchi na Shounoji wo Uwagakisaretai.

188234.description:
The Strongest Demon Lord of all time gets left by ALL 4 of his wives?! Meet Zeon, the Perfect Demon Lord. After focusing too much on work, all four of his brides decided to divorce the Demon Lord and return to their family homes. Just when things couldn't get worse, with the same timing, the female hero Alexia tries to take over his castle! Instead of defeating the weakened Demon Lord, Hero Alexia listens to his worries. As they prepare to part ways, Zeon admits his wives told him he's a terrible kisser. "Well... want to test that? Let's kiss!" And so begins Zeon's bumpy journey to rebuild his relationships with his wives, starting with a hero by his side!

(Source: Coolmic)

title.english: The Undefeated Demon Lord Makes a Harem with his 4 Ex-Wives
title.native: バツ4無双～捨てられ魔王、復縁ハーレム作ります。
title.romaji: Batsu 4 Musou: Suterare Maou, Fukuen Harem Tsukurimasu.

188235.description:
Set against the backdrop of a wintry Seoul, Winter Breeze tells a story of second chances, hope, and the unexpected warmth that can bloom even in the coldest seasons. Two years after their fleeting encounter at Seoul Station, Hae-Na is reunited with Do-Hwa at a newly opened photo studio tucked away in her quiet neighborhood, and finds herself drawn to the mysterious photographer she hasn’t been able to forget. Is their reunion merely coincidence, or is it the beginning of something meant to be?

(Source: WEBTOON)

188236.description:
Welcome to board game café Gather Round, where love starts with a roll of the dice. Join interim manager Kotarou “Banjo” Tokiwa, who has a crush on the youthful, fashionable part-timer Mifuru Takanashi but can’t ask her out because she has a boyfriend!

(Source: Yen Press)

188237.description:
In a world where the walking dead - known as Jiangshi - have become integrated into human society, protagonist Yintao's parents are murdered by a mysterious Jiangshi named Maomei. By an inexplicable twist of fate, Yintao ends up living together with Maomei. What secrets lie behind their origins and this mysterious world?

(Source: MANGA Plus)

188238.description:
After the great explosion, the world could never return to what it once was. Divided into small countries driven by specialized labor forces, it's now a dog-eat-dog new world. But Clawhammer Jang listens to more than just his stomach. As he pushes forward, he joins forces with others, new friends also gifted with immense power following the aftermath of the great explosion. But is Jang strong enough to stand for what he believes in? And who will stand with him?

(Source: Tapas)

188240.description: This maritime action manga follows the exploits of a black boy named “Gonzui” who washes ashore on a penal colony island after a slave ship sinks.

188241.description:
A special collection of Hideko Mizuno's early works from 1957-58.

1. Akai Kutsu (赤いくつ)
2. Misa ni Ageru Mono (ミサにあげるもの)
3. Aoi Hoshi no Yoru (青い星の夜)

Note: Was first released in a limited print edition in 2016, then in 2024 it became available on digital storefronts

synonyms: Yokohama Kaidashi Kikou: Seeing, Walking & Enjoying

title.native: 小説ヨコハマ買い出し紀行: 見て、歩き、よろこぶ者

188243.description: Machiko is a lovely young girl, or rather used to be until the day she found a mutilated corpse in the forest when she was out with her boyfriend. After this incident, Machiko starts to feel a thirst that couldn't be quelled by water: it was a thirst for blood! What is happening to her?! What caused it?! The answer for that is in this horror thriller you must read to believe!

188244.description: A manga adaption of the The Murders in the Rue Morgue and The Purloined Letter by Edgar Allan Poe
synonyms: The Murders in the Rue Morgue

188245.description:
Heartbroken and unemployed at 45, Anan Kakeru embarks on a spontaneous journey to clear his mind. There, he meets Ida Kenji, a former tour guide. At first glance, Ida seems like a charming older man—effortlessly kind, naturally saying the right words, and undeniably attractive. But as it turns out, he’s the same age as Anan—and, just like him, he’s gay. They spend a gentle, intimate night together, exchange contact information, and go on dates. The more Anan gets to know Ida, the deeper his feelings grow. But as their bond strengthens, so does the fear of embracing something even more profound…

(Source: Taiyoh Tosho, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.native: ミドルエイジはやさしく愛したい

188246.description:
1. Silver Moon (シルバー・ムーン)
2. Gin no Tobira wo Knock Shite (銀の扉をノックして)
3. Good Night (グッド・ナイト)
4. Blue By You (ブルー・バイ・ユー )
5. Season (シーズン)
6. Angie Girl (アンジー・ガール)

188247.description:
Junhyuk’s relentless journey to completely rewrite a past filled with regrets begins. After finally obtaining the Stone of Regression with great difficulty, Junhyuk carefully prepares to return to the past. However, an urgent crisis strikes, forcing him to initiate the regression with only the preparations he has managed so far.

“Haha, then let’s meet in the past.”

Leaving behind those who sought his life, Junhyuk regresses to the past.

“This is the start of something new.”

Armed with heightened senses and the ability to copy, Junhyuk embarks on a daring mission to fix a past riddled with regrets.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)
synonyms: Get Some Honey by Copying Skills

188249.description:
Zhou Mingrui possessed and reborn Klein Moretti who committed suicide due to the sealed artifact "Antigonus Family Notes". Zhou Mingrui once again held a "Transfer Ceremony" in order to return to Earth, but accidentally entered a mysterious gray fog space. During this process, he inadvertently pulled the consciousnesses of Audrey Hall and Alger Wilson into the gray fog space. In order to dominate the conversation and pretend to be a hidden existence in recovery, Mr. Fool, who calls himself Mr. Fool, has since embarked on a magnificent legend of becoming a god.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

188250.description:
The feeling of being watched... Mysterious phone calls asking for advice from strangers that started out of the blue... And a life-changing encounter that would alter everything?!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title.english: When the Fireball Falls for the 100th Time

188251.description:
When Hitsuji Hitsuji finally gets into her dream art school, she discovers "Laborinth," a bizarre club building on campus. Legend has it that those who enter this cursed labyrinth never return... Get ready for an extraordinary tale of the mysterious club building, brought to you by the brilliant mind of Kuurodakosei!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title.native: 研究大迷宮ラボリンス

188252.description:
Believing in his fantastic acting skills, Moon Ji-An stuck with Yoon Kang-Jae as his manager through thick and thin. But after eight years of constantly cleaning up after the mess Kang-Jae's picky personality made, Jian thinks it's time to focus on herself and quit her job. As soon as Kang-Jae hears, he cleans up his act, sticks to her like glue, and ponders how to make her stay. He's determined to keep Ji-An by his side, but can he come up with a proposal good enough for her before it's too late

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: わがままなプロポーズ

188253.description:
Born as a beast with shapeshifting powers, the tanuki Totto is abandoned by his family. But the unfortunate Totto has a dream: to take human form and eat ice cream that hasn’t been dropped on the floor. Neither tanuki nor human, Totto takes a small step toward his big dream.

(Source: MANGA Plus)

188254.description:
After yet another rejected novel, a failing romance author finds herself mysteriously transmigrated into her own story! It would be one thing if she inhabited the body of her main character, but she instead finds herself in the shoes of the cruel villain of the story, Hawn-Hee Kang! Can this "relationship newbie" break up the engagement that'll lead to this villainess' untimely demise?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: I Will Break off the Engagement With the Male Lead

188255.description:
“My shoulder feels heavy, and my body feels like something is weighing me down…? The chief priest at the temple preached about the importance of training and eating habits?! You will see the true form of muscle training…!”

(Source: MANGA Plus)

188256.description:
On a remote island, 2 brothers serve as lighthouse keepers. Their predecessors vanished without a trace - whether claimed by the sea or dragged into the depths by mermaids remains unknown. Then one day, a mysterious woman washes ashore, setting in motion events that would forever change their destiny.

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title.native: マッドデッド・ライトハウス

188257.description:
Shy and unpopular Da-Som Park rushes to meet her only friend, the beautiful and adored, Iseul Chae. Instead, she finds Iseul's dead body, or rather, its hollow shell. Da-Som enters it and takes over Iseul's seemingly perfect life. But as Dasom discovers horrific family secrets, she wonders where her friend went, and if it was an accident she ended up in Iseul's shell.

(Source: WEBTOON)

188258.description:
Lilliana is a neglected princess with a single mission: do not get pregnant. Ever since she woke up in a novel where she will die giving birth to the main character, Lilliana has known that her pregnancy will be her death sentence. However, her mission’s greatest obstacle is her new husband, Emperor Helio. Although they have married for political reasons, the ruthless emperor's fondness for Lilliana drives him to decide that his mission is to win her over. Thus begins the battle of wills between wife and husband. Will Lilliana be able to defy destiny and Helio’s affections?

(Source: Tappytoon)

title.english: Must the Reincarnated Mother Always Die?

188259.description:
The child of a black leopard and a snow leopard shapeshifter, 7-year-old Tiel escapes her abusive family to seek refuge with the father she never knew. All she wants is safety, but her father, the feared Duke Asterian, has other plans... to give his long-lost daughter a loving family and a wonderful home! Now, Tiel is set on protecting her family from the evil forces who want to take her away. Can she fight these foes to save her new home? Or will Tiel lose her loved ones once and for all?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: Baby Snow Leopard of the Black Leopard Family

title.english: The Black Leopard Family's Snow Leopard Baby

188260.description:
Reincarnation stories are all the rage these days, but I never thought I’d be the one getting reborn! But still, life as a rich man’s beautiful daughter is pretty sweet... except for one thing. No matter what I do, where I run, or who I romance, this novel is dead-set on getting me hitched to the handsome duke destined to kill me! There must be some way to change my fate, right? I won't go out like this!

(Source: Tapas)

title.english: You Think It's Easy Rewriting a Story?

188262.description:
Joo Eunchae seems to be married to the perfect man, the handsome and wealthy CEO of Myungsung Group, Cha Jinwook. But when she dies in an accident full of regret, a mysterious old woman gives her the chance to go back and relive the last year of her life. First step… divorce her unloving husband! Unfortunately for her, Jinwook isn’t willing to let her just leave. Will Eunchae finally get to live life her way and experience true love? Or will she be stuck in a loveless marriage once again?

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

188263.description:
Greetings from Amatsumizu City! Come for the sights, stay for the…Gago? At first glance, Amatsumizu is a normal-looking town, but mysterious creatures known as the Gago outnumber the people who call the city home.

The mayor calls in a crack-team of Gago busters to deal with the supernatural menace – except the team doesn't exist yet! The mayor's on a tight budget, leaving him no choice but to volun-tell a team of ordinary citizens to take on the job. Hair stylist Umeko, cashier Mii, high school student Hiromi, and Umeko's apprentice Yuuri become the Gago Hunters against their will. It sounds like an easy score for the supernatural, but each girl has something…off about them.

The Gago had better relocate fast, before they're hunted down by the real monsters of Amatsumizu!

(Source: Manga Mavericks)

title.english: Gago Hunters: Greetings from Amatsumizu City's Gago Suppression Squad
title.native: 天津水市「がご」撲滅だより がごはん

188264.description:
In a world where malevolent spirits roam freely, Jeong Wol has spent his entire life pretending not to see them. Having witnessed countless evil entities since childhood, he believes that ignoring the supernatural is the only way to survive. That fragile resolve shatters when he becomes entangled in a mission led by the Disaster Squad and loses his life in the process. Or so he believes.Jeong Wol awakens to find himself alive once more, bound by a mysterious pact with Sa Hyeon, a black serpent whose presence radiates both danger and allure. Granted immortality in exchange for an unknown price, he is forced to confront the very world he tried so desperately to deny.

Is this second life a blessing that spared him from death, or a curse that will drag him deeper into the serpent’s shadow?

(Source: Lezhin US)
synonyms: 月下巳影〜首なし蛇は月に恋する〜

title.english: In the Shadow of the Serpent

188265.description:
Lim Seo-Jun, a college student, is popular with guys but struggles with his lack of popularity among the opposite sex. At the opening assembly, he tries to get closer to the girls, but they all flock around Yun-Woo, a fellow student who has just returned from a break. Envious of Yoon-Woo's charm, Seo-Jun drinks too much and passes out. When he wakes up, he finds Yun-Woo unusually affectionate—and feels something strangely stiff in a very unexpected place.

"Seo-Jun hyung, can you feel it?"

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Part of Bomtoon’s and Lezhin’s Saekgwi Danpyeonseon (색귀 단편선) Collection or Dirty Demon Collection in English.
synonyms: Can You Feel It From Behind?
[Sex Ghost Anthology] Can You Feel It From Behind?

188266.description:
The batting center has a machine that no one can hit. It's a 160km/h fastball called "Surugameteor" that kicks up dust. But who is it really? A shy 15-year-old boy with a ridiculously big butt!? A hot-blooded captain and a small baseball team that operates in the shadows. "Let's have some fun baseball under the blue sky!" From behind the dark and narrow batting center, they aim for the dream of Koshien!

A "super youthful" baseball story brought to you by a hot-blooded captain and a shy genius freshman!!

(Source: Pocket Magazine, translated)

188267.description:
Terminally ill Miena Sidus has the ability to enter other people's dreams. Knowing her time will be up soon, Miena decides to use her power to gather money for her loving parents as a last gesture of gratitude. But as she navigates the dreams, she finds herself involved with a mysterious boy, a young lord, and a great dragon. Moreover, they all seem to need her help and are intent on saving her as well. Will these new relationships change Miena's fate and give her a ray of hope in life?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: 転生したのにまた余命宣告!? ～夢を渡る薄命令嬢～

188268.description:
Reincarnated as Sienna Winter, a minor villain with a terminal illness, her only goal is survival. However, she accidentally awakens a sealed demon and gets trapped in a lifelong contract. But... she's already dying?!

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)
synonyms: The Perfect Plan to Avoid the Death Ending

188269.description:
Avel is a cute young girl who’s chaotic and a little violent. She couldn’t care less about social rules and polite society. Nevertheless, to avoid her tragic fate in the future of this novel at the hands of the cold first prince Chesa, she has to get to him while he’s young and teach him to be a good person. So what if she has to break some rules (and kick some butts) along the way? What matters is that the neglected boy learns to care for other people. What could possibly go wrong?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: The Villain's Early Education Was Done Too Well

title.english: I Ended Up Educating the Secret Villain Too Well

188270.description:
Evanna is the orphaned daughter of the Holy Empire's second prince and Lyngena Granger, a powerful sorceress. She is taken advantage by her uncle Levlius who forces Evanna to ascend the throne. As an Empress, Evanna is ridiculed and scorned for being the daughter of a sorceress and is subjected to abuse in order to pray the magic in her away. However, upon discovering her mother's grimoire, Evanna turns back time only to return as a toddler. Her mission is to bring her parents together so that they may give birth to her and lead them to a happier future.

(Source: Pocket Comics)

title.english: Some Day You Will Give Birth To Me
title.native: 赤ちゃん聖女はバッド未来を回避したい～お二人は後日、私を生みます～
title.romaji: Aka-chan Seijo wa Bad Mirai wo Kaihishitai: Ofutari wa Gojitsu, Watashi wo Umimasu

188271.description:
When orphan Rosie learns of her brother Julian and that they are a part of the esteemed House Noart, she gains both riches and the greatest treasure of all—the pure love of family. But after an accident causes Julian to lose all memory of recent years, including Rosie's existence, she discovers House Noart has many hidden enemies. Preventing her family from falling to ruin is one thing, but will these siblings be able to prove that blood is not just thicker than water but lost memories as well?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: The Strongest Brother Lost His Memory

188272.description:
'In the afterlife, I hope to be reborn as a rich man's dog.'

Yujin is orphaned and unable to find a regular job. While thinking about being a rich man's dog, she is hit by a truck and enters the game Golden Cage! She finds herself possessing a little gray-haired extra who is killed by the prince at the beginning of the game.

Not wanting to live a life struggle, she decides to take the place of the game's heroine and become the prince's pet dog...

"Woof, woof, woof!"

By barking like a dog, she succeeds in attracting the prince's attention and gets a job as his 'dog'! Eugene earns the title of "puppy-sama" and is given a cushy puppy life... but the problem is, the crazed emperor, who was obsessed with whether the "dog" would run away in the original, is not so obsessed!

"What's wrong, my dear Yujin?"

Instead, he just looks at her with warm eyes... Awww, maybe I should have pretended to run away. Yujin's struggle to enjoy a cozy and comfortable life as a dog!

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)
synonyms: I Will Be the Main Character in That Prison
I Will Be the Protagonist of this Captivity Story
我要成为这监禁游戏的女主
ヤンデレ系乙女ゲームの主人公、私にやらせてください！

188273.description:
Jinseong streams the online action game Dungeon and Fighter for a living, and while assisting a ranger, he ends up doing exactly what the player warned him not to—helping him fight the boss. Little did Jinseong know that the ranger was a person sucked into the game world, and was now dead for failing his mission. Transported into the world of DNF to take responsibility, Jinseong must work his way through the quest line as a Dark Knight to stop the contamination from leading players astray and destroying the world of Arad. Will he make it through alive?

(Source: WEBTOON)

188274.description:
Let me hold your hand once more.

Jiwoo can see the future of those she holds hands with. Yet when she holds Haesung's hand, she can see her own! Hoping to know her fate in the upcoming art contest, Jiwoo tries to hold Haesung's hand again, but he refuses. What trauma lies in his past? Can the two pull each other back to the present?

(Source: Manta)

188276.description:
1. Goumon Kairaku: Toraware no Kunoichi (拷問快楽~囚われのくノー~); Angel Club 2024-12
2. Kachiku no Bunzai (家畜の分際); Angel Club 2024-08
3. Shakkin Hensai Oyako Bonburi (借金返済親娘丼); Angel Club 2025-02
4. Nerawareta Hitozuma: Kyou kara Watashi wa Niku Benki (狙われた人妻～今日から私は肉便器～); Angel Club 2023-11
5. Chitsu Roudo: Yanmama Kojin AV Ochi (膣労働～ヤンママ個人AV堕ち～); Angel Club 2024-03
6. Joshi Puro Seisai Matchi: Yínmugo no Ring (女子プロ制裁マッチ～淫惨のリング～); Angel Club 2024-01
7. Hitozuma Anal: Uzuku Ma ￮ ko do Bokkikuri (人妻アナル～疼くマ○コど勃起クリ～); Angel Club 2024-05
8. Sennyuu Sousa-kan: Toraware no Bijin Shimai (潜入捜査姦～囚われの美人姉妹～); Angel Club 2024-10
synonyms: 拷問快楽~囚われのくノー~
Nerawareta Hitozuma: Kyou kara Watashi wa Niku Benki
狙われた人妻～今日から私は肉便器～
Chitsu Roudo: Yanmama Kojin AV Ochi
膣労働～ヤンママ個人AV堕ち～
Joshi Puro Seisai Matchi: Yínmugo no Ring
女子プロ制裁マッチ～淫惨のリング～
Hitozuma Anal: Uzuku Ma ￮ ko do Bokkikuri
人妻アナル～疼くマ○コど勃起クリ～
Sennyuu Sousa-kan: Toraware no Bijin Shimai
潜入捜査姦～囚われの美人姉妹～

188277.description:
"I hate summer."

The reason being... that my cousin Yuzu comes to visit every year.
Whenever the two of us are left alone, she does all manner of things to me...

It really peeves me off how she plays and toys with me. And yet, my body reacts to her touch like it has a mind of its own.
Whether it be sitting at a table, or out at the summer festival... I am at her beck and call.
The volition of my mind and my body separate further and further apart...

"I just wanted to be more normal..."

On the final night of Yuzu's visit, I desperately utter such words and in response, Yuzu says... ...?

(Source: DLsite, edited)

title.english: Boys Be Submissive. Coyote-chan x Kai Ken
title.native: ♂が受け。コヨーテちゃん×甲斐犬くん

188278.description:
A rabbit girl heads to her wolfy friend's house.
She knocks on his door, and heads in to greet him but...!

It seems he'd been jerking off to a photo of her because her face is his type...?
But the rabbit girl is not satisfied with this answer.

"Look at my face. "It's much cuter than the picture, right?"

And so began his perverted punishment!

(Source: DLsite, edited)

title.english: Boy For Bottom: Bunny Girl x Wolf Boy
title.native: ♂が受け。ウサギちゃん×オオカミくん

188279.description:
A girl who dreams one day, a woman who loves one day. Now she lives as the mother of two children. Her dreams were broken by reality, and the memories of her love were too short to comfort her life. Her ordinary life, or her... "The Great".

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)
synonyms: The Great〜普通の、あるいは偉大なる〜

188280.description:
A foxgirl and her fiancé, a racoon dogboy, are left alone together after their respective families leave somewhere. They are very nervous in one another's presence, but then something happens and they get locked in a storage closet! In a small confined space, their bodies are in close proximity and the racoon dogboy becomes flustered!

(She's so close... and smells really good...)

This is not the time to be thinking like that!!!

"I'm sorry! It's scary, isn't it! Don't worry, it'll be okay."

But something's wrong with the foxgirl's demeanor......?

"I'm not scared... it's something else."
"Huh?"
"I need to pee... and can't hold it any... longer..."

Peeing herself, something snaps inside the foxgirl and she turns her horny gaze to her fiancé... What ever will the racoon dogboy do...!?

(Source: DLsite, edited)

title.english: Boy For Bottom. Foxgirl x Racoon Dogboy
title.native: ♂が受け。キツネちゃん×タヌキくん

188282.description:
Brunhild Wotan's wildest dream is to serve with Captain Sigmund Volsungr in the first order. Though he soon finds that it isn't always wise to meet one's heroes, he remains determined and throws himself into his journey as a knight, completely dedicated to the order and his captain. Romantic schemes and misunderstandings abound, finally bringing the sunny Sir Wotan and grumpy Captain Volsungr closer together and closer to realizing their true feelings.

(Source: Tapas)

188283.description:
“Hey, you'll catch a cold staying there like that.”

Ash Reeven, reincarnated into the world of an otome game, attends the Royal Magic Academy as a low-class nobleman. One day, he encounters Fienne Stout, the game's heroine, crouched in an alleyway, soaking wet in the rain. Hearing that she's facing expulsion after being branded a “villainess” by the academy's Four Knights and her friend Elise, Ash challenges them to a duel and rescues Fienne from rock bottom. Then she asks him, “Please let me stay with you as your housekeeper,” and so they begin living together... An isekai romantic comedy about rescuing a villainess from her bad ending.

(Source: Sneaker Bunko, translated)

title.native: 路地裏で拾った女の子がバッドエンド後の乙女ゲームのヒロインだった件
title.romaji: Rojiura de Hirotta Onnanoko ga Bad End gono Otome Game no Heroine Datta Ken

188284.description:
"Shall I exact revenge for the adultery on your behalf?" There is much adultery in this world... To ease the hearts of the victims, we inflict social "death" upon the perpretrators.

(Source: Coolmic)

Note: Simultaneously released in long-strip and traditional formats, with 18 episodes and 6 chapters respectively.

title.english: Adultery Victims Association ~ We Are Here to Take Your Revenge
title.native: 「不倫被害者の会」～サレた復讐、代行します。 불륜 피해자 모임
title.romaji: "Furin Higaisha no Kai": Sareta Fukushuu, Daikou Shimasu.

188286.description:
Riv Roydes, a tutor turned secret nude model, poses to pay for her sister's medicine, believing her identity to be safe. But when a painting reveals her profile, she is drawn into a forbidden romance with the enigmatic marquis Dimus Ditrion.

(Source: Manta)

188288.description:
Reborn into a boys' love novel as the stepsister of gang leader Baek Hawon, Cha Yeonbyul is determined to prevent her death at the hands of Hawon's future lover, Yugyeom, a rival gang member. But as she ends the original Yeonbyul's twisted obsession with her own stepbrother by pretending to seduce Yugyeom, the new Yeonbyul finds herself trapped as the unlikely object of Yugyeom's affection! Will she escape the clutches of the male lead or stay caught in the middle of this gang love triangle?

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Includes 10 extra chapters.
synonyms: The Male Lead's Boyfriend Is Obsessed With Me
男主人公の彼氏が私に執着する

title.english: My Brother's Boyfriend Fell for Me

188289.description:
"It's better not to lie, you know? You'll have a big problem here." Masato Teruya has a one-sided crush on his classmate, Emi Takanashi, but today is the day! The day he will finally confess… or so he thought. He has a bad habit of lying when getting embarrassed and can't seem to get the words out! When he finds an old doll that was sealed in a box… his cursed life begins. The doll is cursed like "Pinocchio", when he tells a lie his nose grows…but the nose isn't on his face! The more he lies the longer it gets! If anyone saw his "elephant" like this they'd surely run away. How will Emi react to his extra-large elephant?

(Source: Coolmic)

Note: Simultaneously released in long-strip and traditional formats, with 9 episodes and 3 chapters respectively.

title.english: If I Lie the Nose in My Pants Grows
title.native: ウソついたら下のお鼻が伸びる呪いにかかりました。
title.romaji: Uso Tsuitara Shita no Ohana ga Nobiru Noroi ni Kakarimashita.

188290.description:
Laura, the last heir of a fallen noble house, carries a duty passed down for generations — helping those lost in time and space find their way home. It's just that nobody has shown up for the past 500 years. And now, three clients arrive at once! Can Laura handle restoring her fallen house and babysitting time-traveling bachelors?

(Source: Manta)

188291.description:
Kinemia Lyon's got two rules for surviving a novel: recruit talented geniuses to save her territory and don't get involved with Ayan Krotz, a dangerous mage. But when Ayan gets captured for trespassing on her land over and over again, she decides to hire him as her bodyguard instead. Unfortunately, letting Ayan into her life means dealing with his erratic magic and even more concerning personality! Can Kinemia come to tame this master mage? Or will she regret not kicking him out for good?

(Source: Tapas)

188292.description:
An internet uncle using way too many emoji and cheesy lines to write to a high school girl... This uncle she looked down upon, was actually a real monster...!

(Source: Coolmic)

Note: Simultaneously released in long-strip and traditional formats, with 21 episodes and 7 chapters respectively.
synonyms: Gachi Koi SNS Oji-san no Ijounaru Kenshin

title.english: The Creepy Obsession of an Internet Sugar Daddy
title.native: ガチ恋SNSおじさんの異常なる献身
title.romaji: Gachikoi SNS Oji-san no Ijou naru Kenshin

188293.description:
My husband, Karlotian, loved the empire's saintess. All that was left after my ugly jealousy was the false accusation of cursing the saintess. And when I finally gave up everything in despair, I transmigrated into the body of the villainess who had actually cursed the saintess...and things are not going as planned.

(Source: POCKETCOMICS)

title.native: 後悔はいいから殺してください
title.romaji: Koukai wa Ii kara Koroshite Kudasai

188294.description:
Detective Irok Jin, a narcotics squad member, becomes sexually involved with Tae-Hyuk Ahn, a stunning man linked to illegal drug distribution. As they collaborate on cases, their relationship deepens, blurring the lines between investigation and romance.

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: ชำระแค้นแสนรัก

188297.description:
He’s a dad. Why would he do that? Daycare worker Yukari was too busy with the children for love. In fact, she didn’t have any opportunities to meet people in the first place...

But, just when she was thinking that, she found herself having drinks with her friend Manami’s boss, Koji. The man Manami said was “good-looking, but strange,” was a gentleman and escorted Yukari back home.

However, having had a few too many drinks, the two of them fell on to the bed, and... wound up kissing. The following morning, Koji was gone. Yukari was in agony recalling the previous night!!

With those memories in tow, she did her work, but the “handsome dad” there to pick up one of the children was... the same man she had just shared her bed with!?

(Source: Omoi)

188298.description:
"I want you to see me as I am now, not how I was when I was a kid." A complicated first love between childhood friends! A sweet gaze, melting from a kiss... If he plays with my breast and touches me down there with his gentle hands, I'll...! Yua, Haruki, and Shusuke are childhood friends and were basically brought up as siblings. Even as adults, they meet up every now and then. The three of them planned to meet up for drinks, but Shusuke got a sudden call from work and had to go back in the office, so Yua and Haruki decided to drink at home. Thanks to this, there was a... "big incident" that lead to Shusuke's sealed away love to come out full force! Shusuke definitely leaves his mark of his "pure love"!

(Source: MangaPlaza)

title.english: Getting Love-bombed (Physically) by My Crazy for Romance Childhood Friends I Thought of as Little Brothers
title.native: 初恋狂い〜弟だと思ってた幼なじみに激重感情を（※カラダで）浴びせられてます〜
title.romaji: Hatsukoi Gurui: Otouto da to Omotteta Osananajimi ni Gekijuu Kanjou wo (※Karada e) Abiseraretemasu

188299.description:
After three failed marriages, Archduke Theo de Phoenix has long accepted that love simply isn’t in the cards for him. After all, who could love a war-hardened monster like him? So when his fourth bride arrives, he greets her covered in blood, gives her a shabby attic for a room, and keeps his distance. Surely, this one will run too. But Yuelina is not like the others. To Theo’s disbelief, she welcomes his presence and fills his cold world with warmth and light. As the walls around his heart begin to thaw, will Theo finally allow himself to love?

(Source: WEBTOON)
synonyms: Push Harder So It Doesn't Run Away
Hold Her Tighter So She Wouldn't Run Away

188300.description:
“Who’s the garbage with zero morals saying they’ll marry a five-year-old?!”

I thought I had died in vain due to the betrayal of a comrade when I was a grand mage, but I was given a new life as ‘Nazia de Lavoie,’ the daughter of a baron. However, in this weak and frail body, I was treated as the family’s outcast and eventually sent off as a bride to the war-obsessed demon, Duke Iter. At the tender age of five, no less! I assumed he was a heartless scoundrel, but the Duke of Iter’s reaction to me was completely unexpected—

“I accept Lady Lavoie as a member of Iter. If the lady so desires, she can be my adopted daughter.”

Is this the beginning of Act Two—or rather, Act Three—of my life?

(Source: Naver, translated)
synonyms: I Became the Sea Guardian's Adopted Daughter
The Obsessive Infatuation of a Hostile Nobility

title.native: 絶対に勝てないサキュバスちゃん

188303.description:
Ai's boss-slash-crush, Kazushi Soejima, and best friend, Moe Kimizuka, started dating...! In the throes of heartbreak, Ai Nitobe meets a younger guy, Kotaro Mochizuki, who's a total puppy-dog type! It's love at first sight (for Kotaro anyways...). He asks Ai on a date and manhandles her at work! But, she still wants to see that wolf one more time... Nobody knows where this love boat is heading!!

(Source: Renta!)

title.native: ハニーウルフ、カムヒアー。

188304.description:
Geon-Yeong is a brilliant girl. Despite being underprivileged, her exceptional intellect allows her to enroll in the prestigious Pyeonghyeon High School. There, she meets new competitors and friends. She struggles to compete with all the other privileged students who have expensive lessons. Amidst these challenges, she is determined to succeed and become a judge. This is Geon-Yeong's journey to prove that despite the disadvantages life has dealt her, she is worthy of respect.

(Source: WEBTOON)

188305.description: Hito Natsu no Kids Game (ひと夏のKIDSゲーム Hito Natsu no KIDS Gēmu) is a short, debut manga work by Ken Akamatsu, the creator of Love Hina. The manga was published on September issue of Kodansha’s Magazine Fresh on September 10, 1993. Ken Akamatsu later received Kodansha’s "Freshman Manga Award" (Japanese: 新人漫画賞/少年マガジン新人賞) and Special Jury Award (Japanese: 審査員特別賞) for this work.The manga was re-published on 20 May 2001.

188306.description:
6 years her senior, Yui is a genius who's already claimed a Nobel Prize. Meanwhile, her little sister Mari is just your average elementary schooler. Struggling with the enormous gap between them, Mari finds herself literally stuck in a wall on her way to school...?! From the brilliant mind that brought you "MamaYuyu" comes an unpredictable tale of sisterhood!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title.english: My Sister, My Stuck Butt, and Me

188307.description:
A producer who wanted to succeed as a singer, but had no talent. Death came on the day he thought was his last chance, but the gods of music did not turn away from him. If the gods of music do not abandon you, can you really do it? Change began with the gods of music.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)
synonyms: Together With the Gods of Music
I Am With the Music Immortals
ゴッド・オブ・ミュージック～音楽の神々と共に～

188308.description:
Look up at the stars while floating on the sea. Surely, there are stories there that you don't yet know! Don't you want to learn about the unknown faces of the sky and the secrets of the sea? A seamstress stitching the starry sky, an angel who becomes your oshi (idol), and mermaids who fall in love with humans. A part of their lives have always quietly intersected with us.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

1. Hoshi no Ohariko (星のお針子); Asuka 2020-09
2. Kenshinteki Guuzousuuhai (献身的偶像崇拝); Asuka 2021-01
3. Utakata ni Musubu (うたかたに結ぶ); Asuka 2021-05
4-5. Niku to Uroko (肉と鱗); Asuka 2024-11, 2025-01
synonyms: Das Märchen von Sternum und Meer

188309.description:
1. Okujou wa Itsumohare (屋上はいつも晴れ, Their Toy); Comic Shitsurakuten 2024-04
2. Yarigai Oshigoto (ヤリガイお仕事, Worthwhile Work); Comic Shitsurakuten 2024-02
3. Ame no Yoru ni... (雨の夜に…, On a Rainy Night...); Comic Shitsurakuten 2023-08
4. Coin Laundry e Ikou! (コインランドリーへ行こう！, Let's Go to the Laundromat!); Comic Shitsurakuten 2023-10
5. Shikaku Kankei (しかくかんけい , Four-Way Relationship); Comic Shitsurakuten 2021-03
6. Shiken wa Tsurai yo (試験はつらいよ, Exams Are Tough); Comic Shitsurakuten 2021-01
7. Usagi no Onee-san (うさぎのお姉さん, Bunny Lady); Comic Shitsurakuten 2023-01
synonyms: コインランドリーへ行こう！

188311.description:
After overworking myself in my past life, I reincarnated as Rachel Leseltein, the villainess in a novel. I had no regrets, but I never got to chase my dream of opening a bakery. Unfortunately, every business the original Rachel touched crumbled, and she was ultimately destroyed by the story’s heroine. But this time, I’m changing my fate! My father and brother don’t support my idea, but I’ll whip up sweet recipes, knead my way to success, and maybe attract a handsome duke with a sweet tooth.

(Source: Tapas)

title.english: The Villainess Is Too Busy Baking Bread!

188312.description:
Ye-Ji, an 18-year-old student at Hana Arts High School, wants to win the world's best classical international violin competition held in Korea. She wants to fulfill her older sister Ye-Seo dream, who died a year ago. Ye-Ji practices repeatedly on the expensive violin "John Webster" that her older sister had borrowed from the DK Music Foundation, but Ye-Ji's mother, Su-Jin, has conflicts with Ye-Ji, who does not hesitate to abuse herself for practice, and eventually returns the violin to the music foundation. Ye-Ji, who believes that neither the competition nor the victory are meaningful without Webster, is about to give up everything when she receives a text message saying she has passed the final round of the competition. Will Ye-Ji be able to get John Webster back and win the competition? Ye-Ji's adventure in the city to get John Webster back begins now!

(Source: Naver, translated)

188313.description:
A haunting anthology that delves into the lives of women caught in the grip of mysterious obsessions. Each tale unfolds like an unmarked path - uncertain but irresistible - drawing you deeper into its eerie allure.

(Source: Lezhin US)

188314.description:
The story is set amid the feudal society during the last years of the ancient Eastern Zhou Dynasty. The turmoil of that era engendered an elegant and beautiful culture as well as magnificent, heroic sentiments.

(Source: Locus Publishing)
synonyms: The Heroes of the Eastern Zhou Dynasty

188315.description:
This installment in Chikuma Bunko's contemporary manga anthology series focuses on Horror, SF, and dark comedy from the 1960's to the present day and is curated by Tokushige Kawakatsu

1. Nurarinuma (ぬらり沼) [Yuuhei Youki]
2. Tako (蛸) [Shouhei Kusunoki]

title.romaji: Kyoufu to Kisou: Gendai Manga Senshuu

title.native: 長崎人情物語 どろくれもん

188317.description:
Unko is a young magic school student who constantly faces teasing from his classmate Tanaka due to his unfortunate name. But when Tanaka becomes possessed by a demon, everything changes! Get ready for an action-packed comedy about friendship and overcoming personal insecurities!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

188318.description:
Hayato Fujii is a closeted gay man. To live a peaceful life, he keeps his sexuality a secret due to the trauma he experienced in high school. That is, until one day, an openly gay coworker, Yusuke Kai, blackmails him with a photo of him kissing another man. Kai promises not to expose him as long as Fujii sleeps with him just once. Fujii reluctantly agrees, but when the moment arrives, Kai seems inexperienced...? A wonderful, bittersweet love story between two men from different worlds and with completely different personalities that will pull at your heartstrings!

(Source: MangaPlaza)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

188321.description:
Upright and serious secretary Emily is always being confronted with her handsome boss's woman troubles. Not only is Kadir a talented businessman who regularly travels around the world, he's also the prince of a bountiful desert kingdom. And he has a prodigious talent for attracting women. One day, after Kadir receives an emergency message from his home country, he makes an outrageous request: he'll pay Emily a huge sum if she pretends to be his horrible wife! Just what does he have planned?

(Source: Renta!)

title.native: 砂に消えた偽りの誓い

188322.description:
After a tragic accident, the queen of the architecture industry, Enfei, found herself reincarnated as Queen Eleanor of the Ghana tribe. Expecting a timeless romance with all kinds of prince charming, she instead discovered she's destined to be buried alongside the king at the royal funeral! In the Ghana tribe's tradition, upon the king's demise, his harem transfers to the prince who ascends the throne. Yet, the eldest prince refused her, leaving her condemned to a fiery fate! To make matters worse, she's accused of witchcraft! Death is not an option! Let's join the journey and witness Queen Eleanor's struggle in this magical realm as she strives to defy the odds and rewrite her destiny...

(Source: Webnovel)

188323.description:
Determined to escape her fate in the novel of being sold off to a loathsome man by her father, Beatrice Arosha runs off to the second male lead, Duke Ruslan Etenas, and proposes a contract marriage. After he immediately agrees, Beatrice moves into Etenas Castle, built on a sealed spirit gate and staffed by ghosts! But as she grows closer to the duke and experiences visions of the original Beatrice, she begins to realize the haunted castle may not be the strangest thing about her marriage…

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: 政略結婚が嫌でサブ主人公に逃げたのに

188324.description:
Hiiro Yamabuki is your normal high school girl who loves eating. The only thing that separates her from other people, is her reoccurring dream of a Western world. One day in the middle of class, she accidentally brushes hands with the transfer student who sits next to her, Sei Konno. The moment they touch...! They are transferred to the world that she always sees in her dreams! And that guy is here too?!

She finds herself wearing a gorgeous dress, people are calling her princess, and the transfer student is being called the Prince. Wait... she has to marry him right now? And spend the night together? What is going on?!

They're classmates that barely know each other and they've suddenly been transferred to this strange world! Thus their newlywed life starts in this world that they know nothing about!

(Source: MangaPlaza)

188325.description:
Barbara somehow finds herself role-playing Chuhan Bai, the pathetic female lead of a cliché CEO web novel she recently read, in a game. As the game has a mechanism that restarts every time she fails to complete a story quest, she has failed several times due to their completely different characteristics. Just when she is about to restart again, she realizes that Qian Song, a non-playing character, will restart along with her as well. In order to finish the game, these two decide to team up.

(Source: Webnovel)
synonyms: How Did I Fall for the NPC?!
이 결혼에 의미 부여를 하지 마세요

synonyms: ダイスキなのに・イケないコト・やめられない

188328.description:
Violence!!!! Shootouts!!!! Zombies!!!! Electricity!!!! An office life comedy without a lucky break begins!

Note: Kyatapi Land began as a web manga released on the author's Twitter account since March 25, 2023, and published in print by Kadokawa since August 19, 2024. Official serialization began in Ganma! on October 11, 2023.

A creepypasta anthology by various mangaka.

188332.description:
Featuring eerie urban legends that became popular on the internet, faithfully adapted into comics by skilled authors. A true horror anthology for urban legends!

My heart is racing because of a tough, toned body…? But sumo wrestlers aren't my type…! For some reason, it feels so good when I'm being held so tightly…

(Source: Coolmic)

The gap moe between the tall kouhai and I is making my heart pound!
A sweet love story between a short girl and a tall boy!

(Source: Margaret, translated)

A story about a girl who likes makeup.

(Source: Author's Twitter, translated)

Note: Originally published in Dessert Magazine 2021 Aug. issue PINK supplemental.
synonyms: All that's left is to put on the lips.
