title.romaji: Ato wa Lip wo Noseru Dake

188339.description:
Just a random comment?
Or did she really mean it?
That flirtatious girl.

(Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

Note: Originally published in Comic Yuri-Hime 2025 May issue.

188340.description:
The purification ritual must be conducted in darkness, hidden away from view.

(Source: Isekai Rakuten, translated)

Note: Originally published in Isekai Rakuten vol. 43.

188341.description:
Misaki, a workaholic, often works overtime with his colleague Asabuki. Misaki thought it was just a work relationship, until one day when she beckoned him to rest his head on her lap…? Crossing the line with his cool co-worker.

(Source: Comic Bavel, translated)

Note: Published in Comic Bavel 2025-04

188342.description:
The culprit who turned his twin cousins into villains by appearing in a side story of a novel! Who would have thought he would be reincarnated as a villain? I sighed deeply and made up my mind. ‘Let’s raise the twins with love and prevent their darkening!’ I don’t care about the novel and get along well with the twins, but the second male lead, whom I had no reason to get involved with, keeps getting more and more obsessed with me! Ah. Where did it go wrong?And why did the second male lead turn dark when I was just trying to stop the villain from turning dark?

“Please, please don’t back down anymore. I don’t know how much longer I can endure it.”

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

188343.description:
I thought I had died in a car accident, but instead, I was reborn as the playmate of the Northern Duke’s heir. But this poor thing is always sickly and in ill health, and destined to have his love, the princess, taken away by another man. In that case, I’ll help him become the perfect Dark-Haired Northern Duke and achieve love! That was my plan, but… Why is our Setsu so cute and sweet? Can I really succeed?

(Source: Naver, translated)
synonyms: My Male Lead Is a Northern Dark-Haired Grand Duke

title.native: 瞳輝ける夜 ソード・ワールド短編集
title.romaji: Hitomi Kagayakeru Yoru: Sword World Tanpenshuu

title.native: ムネいっぱいのほーよーりょく

188346.description:
The peak of strength in South Korea is the Esteemed Martial Lee Clan. In that martial clan, Lee Cheol was looked down on and chased out because of his status as an illegitimate child. In order to survive, he lived in shadows, but he was chased down and killed because of his family's schemes. He was then granted a second chance—regression. Using his "ability to absorb the memories of a weapon" as a foundation, Lee Cheol would train and go down a path of struggle. Persistent competition and schemes regarding the right to inheritance, attacks from other races and monsters in dangerous, unexplored lands, and even local clashes related to his family's internal struggles... His growth would bring about these things, bringing hardship upon Lee Cheol. Life itself would be a struggle for Lee Cheol, and this is his destiny. But in order to protect himself and his surroundings—in order to protect everything—as the fight continues, he'll unravel secrets from his past life, one by one...!

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

title.native: 乳牛教師のマゾメス補習
title.romaji: Chichiu Kyoushi no Mazo Mesu Hoshu

188350.description:
I am Karne Pivoine Feian, a poor and pitiful princess in hiding. Due to some unfortunate circumstances, I’m currently residing in the house of a Baroness under a hidden identity. I promised I’d do anything they asked me. But I didn’t think I’d be asked to do things that would put my life in danger! As expected, freeloading in someone else's house is no easy feat. I've got no choice. I have to find a way to reclaim my identity!

One day, a handsome man approached me to offer a deal.
"I’ll give you an unimaginably great reward if you bring me what I ask of you."

I think I've already found my reward, though! I've not only gained money, but an absolute hottie as well. Will I finally be able to walk down a path of happiness?

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)
synonyms: How to Change a Path Full of Thorns Into One Full of Happiness
いばらの道を花道に変える方法

title.native: ヒミツのカテキョは詰め込みまくり！！

188352.description:
They called him the Devil’s Violinist in another life, but now he’s just a student trying to blend in. As a reincarnation of Paganini, Juwon has spent years suppressing his extraordinary talent to live as an ordinary teenager. But when a twist of fate lands him in an arts high school, his silent strings begin to scream for attention. Surrounded by rivals and expectations, the genius who was once forced into silence must decide if he is ready to reclaim his throne. The legend has returned, and the world isn't ready for his encore.

(Source: Tappytoon)
synonyms: High School Musical Genius Is Paganini Reincarnated
芸術高校の天才は転生ヴァイオリニスト！

title.english: Our High School Music Genius is Paganini's Reincarnate

188353.description:
A booklet included inside Harta volume 50 of Hakumei to Mikochi manga and illustrations written and drawn by various Harta contributors.

(Source: Natalie, translated)

title.native: はくみこころころ 「ハクメイとミコチ」トリビュートブック
title.romaji: Haku Miko Korokoro: "Hakumei to Mikochi" Tribute Book

188355.description:
Kang Geon-woo, a genius major leaguer who has achieved wealth, fame, and everything. Even he could not continue his happy married life with his wife. Feeling the void left by his wife, he regrets it and returns to the past with the power of a mysterious ring. Will he be able to win love this time, having become a high school student during his innocent love days?

(Source: Naver, translated)

188356.description:
The ‘Bluebird’s Letter’ exposed noble secrets, ruining families. When debates about its author raged, Kirien Kailos, the ‘Blood Wolf,’ confronted Saint Selen Reclair.

“I know your secret,” he said, threatening to reveal her authorship unless she came to his mansion alone.

Troubled, Selen sought advice from past saints.

“Is he handsome?” they asked.

“Yes,” she replied.

“Then go. Life’s too short to miss opportunities.

(Source: Naver, translated)

188358.description:
When young Hahyeon Shin’s mother sacrifices herself to give him a chance to escape the family she married into, he finds himself alone in a hostile world. His only goal is to find his mother’s family, the House of Namgung, and train in martial arts to avenge her and become a protector of the innocent. But when he is tested by the Namgung family, they discover that he is a martial arts genius with a perfect physique and the potential to become the greatest martial artist who ever lived.

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: The Genius Grandson of the Namgung Family
南宮世家の天才的な外孫

title.english: The Genius Grandson of House Namgung

188359.description:
1-3. Kokonottsu (ここのッつ); Comic Mugen Tensei 2017-02, 06, 08
4. Youkoukangi: Dekiru kana (幼孔貫儀～できるかな～); BUSTER COMIC 2016-09
5. Himitsu no Katekyo wa Tsumekomimakuri!! (ヒミツのカテキョは詰め込みまくり！！); BUSTER COMIC 2016-11
6. Mune Ippai no Houyouryoku (ムネいっぱいのほーよーりょく); Comic LO 2014-06
synonyms: Girl and Father Seriously Incest Love.

title.romaji: Watashi to Papa no Maji Soukan

188360.description:
Master sorcerers are rare. Fewer still deal with space and time. So when the empire comes for Eleanor, she escapes to the past with plans to befriend her still-living mother. But the past isn’t what she hoped—she can’t enroll in the academy, her mother is aloof, she’s at odds with the only person willing to help, and they’re also plotting to overthrow the throne. With no way to know what secrets she’ll uncover, at least one thing is clear: getting involved is the only way to keep her mom safe.

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: 時を超えてあなたに会いに行きます

title.english: I'm Going Through Time to Meet You

188361.description:
Kang Min-A's daily life is completely turned upside down by the sudden acquisition of the ability to . Now, what unfolds before her are irreversible events caused by a single moment of choice. In the midst of anger, confusion, and suppressed sense of justice, Min-A begins a new journey, wondering where to use her power. In what direction will her power flow, and what choices will she make?

(Source: Naver, translated)
synonyms: พริบตาเปลี่ยนโลก

188362.description:
I'm Shiratori Nagisa, an idol! Tossing people around is a hobby of mine. Is there a strong and cool boy out there somewhere?

(Source: Book Walker)

188363.description:
Jayna’s life is a parade of misfortunes: born to a dragon mother who dies early, bullied by other dragons throughout her childhood, disregarded by her human father, and murdered as a teenager. At least, according to the novel she’s been reborn in. At 10 years old, she’s given the chance to live with her father, the Master of the Magic Tower, Diamid. She’s aware her father and destiny will not be kind to her, so her only goal is to enjoy the small luxuries of life until she dies at 17. But will this life truly be the same tragedy?

(Source: Tappytoon)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.
synonyms: 只想在反派爸爸身边躺平
お父さん、私は何もしませんから!

188365.description:
No Mi-Rae, a depressed office worker who is busy living from hand to mouth. One day, she suddenly starts raising a Tyrannosaurus?! Her future life that had no future is turned upside down by the companion dinosaur(?) that appeared overnight!

(Source: Naver, translated)

188366.description:
Physical therapist Lee Ki-jeok. The center is failing, and his girlfriend has dumped him! On a day when nothing is going well, he gets hit by a falling star and starts showing a status screen?! The story of Lee Ki-jeok growing into the best physical therapist!

(Source KakaoPage, translated)

188368.description:
In this town, there are many happy families. When Kazuya learns that his wife is pregnant with their second child, he decides to return home after working away for some time. Excited to reunite with his family, Kazuya opens the door to find a monster covered in hair sitting in his home! The creature has huge claws and fangs, but his daughter runs up to it, calling it her "friend." They all eat together with the monster as if it's completely normal. Is Kazuya the only one who finds this crazy? And his wife... she was "given" something by the monster... rubbing her belly... does that mean the baby in his wife's belly is...?!

(Source: Coolmic)

title.english: Congratulations! My Wife Is Pregnant with a Monster
title.native: ご怪妊おめでとう～妻が××を孕んだ日～
title.romaji: Gokai Migomo Omedetou: Tsuma ga xx wo Haranda Hi

188369.description:
When a high school teacher was hospitalized due to bullying by students, a new teacher is assigned to replace him. The substitute teacher Ms. Kasai is a beautiful woman, with a stunning figure. On top of that, she doesn't get bothered by risqué remarks, always responding with a smile. Even as she laughs and says, “I became a teacher to make my students happy,” her students are already making evil plans. But what the bullies don’t know — is that Ms. Kasai is a psychopath.

(Source: taskey, translated)

188370.description:
A new fan approached the 5-year unknown idol Won-I. Her behavior was different from other fans. Despite her obsession and crazy behavior, Won-I, who is an idol, couldn't help but laugh, and as if she knew the situation, her obsession only got worse...

(Source: Naver, translated)

188372.description:
Veronica lost everything—her home, her family, and even her humanity. Her monstrous red eyes see only horror until Leon, a renegade holy knight, presses a kiss to her lips. Could he be her only hope for salvation?

(Source: Manta)

188373.description:
After losing his memories in an accident, Eun Jo transfers to a new school, convinced he's a model student—quiet, kind, and hardworking. But when he sees his classmate Bom being bullied, something in him snaps. His instincts take over—and so do his fists. As Eun rises against the school’s cruel hierarchy, he starts to wonder: Who was he before? And why does Bom feel so familiar? Packed with school drama, mystery, and unexpected fists, this is the story of a “good student” who may not be so good after all.

(Source: WEBTOONS)

188374.description:
Yaguchi and Kimika have been crushing on each other since high school. Now they're in college, and they still haven't worked up the nerve to ask each other out. Their friends are all teasing them to get together already, but a curvy older girl with a thing for virgin boys is watching them from the sidelines, and she's about to go in for the kill...

(Source: Irodori Comics)

Note: Released at Comiket 105.

title.native: 君の童貞いただきま～す～人の男ほど欲しがる童貞大好き性悪逆NTR先輩
title.romaji: Kimi no Doutei Itadakimasu: Hito no Otoko Hodo Hoshigaru Doutei Daisuki Seiaku Gyaku NTR Senpai

title.native: ナイショのつまみ喰い

188376.description:
While the lolicon protagonist was lazing around watching TV on Halloween, an angel dressed as a little devil appeared in his room! As things turned out, the protagonist ended up taking the virginity of two little girls. It was a lolicon's dream to really insert his dick deep into a real virgin pussy! He could have they sit on his face, get them give him a double blowjob, or compare the taste of their pussies to his heart's content!

(Source: Mujin Comics, translated)

Note: Published in Comic Mugen Tensei 2017-10

188377.description:
The protagonist is enjoying secret sex with his niece, Shibuki. However, Shizuku, her twin sister, joins in, saying "Shibuki is the only one being unfair". A double loli-girl and girl are clinging to each other!!!

(Source: Mujin Comics, translated)

Note: Published in Comic Mugen Tensei 2017-12

188378.description:
"I just don’t get people who cheat."
Cram school instructor Mishio Ryousuke truly believes that.

One night, he helps a woman quietly crying alone in a bar. But when they meet again later at the cram school, he realizes—she's one of his student's parents.

(Source: Our Feel, translated)

title.native: たぶんここから始まる恋
お隣さんは淫乱金髪サキュバス母娘
title.romaji: Otonari-san wa Inran Kinpatsu Succubus Oyako

title.native: メルティホワイトアウト

188381.description:
A spin-off story from the NOVEL "DIGIMON SEEKERS"! A new story about what happened after Eiji and Loogamon!

(Source: Digimon web)

title.english: Digimon Seekers ーWall Slum's Nightmareー
title.native: デジモンシーカーズ ~ウォールスラムの悪夢~
title.romaji: DIGIMON SEEKERS: Wall Slum no Akumu

188382.description:
Kim Hana is reincarnated as Wilhelmina, a fallen noblewoman whose fate takes a turn when she's married off to the wealthy House Layton. But there’s a catch—her husband is already dead, leaving her to become the Dowager Duchess. Younger than her new stepson and his wife, she must navigate the treacherous waters of high society and a daughter-in-law determined to make her life miserable. Will she find a way to remedy this family drama or be unfairly painted as the monster-in-law she’s not?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: Although I Am a Mother-In-Law, I Do Not Like Conflict Between My In-Laws
O Manual de Uma Boa Sogra

188383.description:
Will Destiny's crush on a ghost-seeing cutie next door work out?

(Source: Toomics)

188384.description:
The flirt who hits on her even during work is... a former yakuza!? Azusa is a doctor working as an occupational physician who takes her job seriously. Itsuki Sakuma, a handsome but suspicious guy who constantly annoys her during his evaluations! He's frivolous, aggressive, and mysterious... But then, he was the only one who noticed Azusa being terrified of her ex-fiance, who now stalks her. He said, "I'll protect you. I don't want you to be alone." He suddenly started looking so serious! She tries to discipline herself by telling herself to not get spoiled, but as he shows his gentlemen like personality, she can't help relying on him.... And that's when she saw the vivid traditional tattoos on him, and...!? He's a (former) yakuza who never let his prey escape from him, and now he goes all out for the love of his life. Let the show begin☆

(Source: MangaPlaza)

title.english: Mr. (Former) Yakuza is in Over His Head with Me, and I Can’t Escape Him.
title.native: 恋に溺れたヤクザさん（元）から、逃げられない私。
title.romaji: Koi ni Oboreta Yakuza-san (Moto) kara Nigerarenai Watashi.

188385.description:
When Dalhee opens a sharehouse to make money, she didn't expect to meet a guest like this! 'Suspicious human rights lawyer' VS 'faithful childhood friend', what will happen to the three of them?

(Source: Toomics)

188391.description: This manga is partly inspired by the real-life Japanese horse bandit, Hakuro Kohinata, and depicts the tumultuous life of Kensaku Ohinata, who moved to China at a young age, was kidnapped by a group of horse bandits, but rose to prominence among their ranks and eventually grew up to unite a number of them under the name of Xiao Dongyang. Kensaku's adventurous spirit and ambition, as well as his positive, brave personality, can sometimes lead to light-hearted mischief, but as he matures into a young man, he grows to experience bouts of delusion. Regarded as one of Mitsuteru Yokoyama's most realistic and human works, this manga draws inspiration from another real-life Japanese horse bandit: Date Junnosuke, thus vividly depicting the reality of Chinese horse bandits.

188393.description:
1. Lycéen (リセアン)
2. Shounen no Gogatsu no Uta (少年の五月の歌)
3. Futastu no Violin (二つのバイオリン)
4. Lucienne no Mori (リュシェンヌの森)

188395.description:
His younger sister Uka and his fiancee Kiou teamed up to try and seduce their older brother. However, they continue to be treated like children. Then a new rival, the blonde Elle, appears, and the three decide to work together...!!

(Source: Mujin Comics, translated)

Note: Published in Comic Mugen Tensei 2018-04, 07, 11

188396.description:
Transfer student Sakana was selected as a relay runner for the track and field team. Tired, Sakana fell asleep in the club room and when she woke up, she found the other team members and the coach doing naughty things to her, calling it a "ritual to improve teamwork"!

(Source: Mujin Comics, translated)

Note: Published in Comic Mugen Tensei 2018-09

188397.description:
1-3. Tricolore Houimou (とりころ～る包囲網); Comic Mugen Tensei 2018-04, 07, 11
4. Tsunagete Iku yo! (つなげてイクよ!); Comic Mugen Tensei 2018-09
5. Synchro ♥ Rinsho (シンクロ♥りんしょー); Comic Mugen Tensei 2017-12
6. Koakuma Shuurai Eve (小悪魔襲来イベ); Comic Mugen Tensei 2017-10
7. Naisho no Tsumami Kui (ナイショのつまみ喰い); Comic LO 2014-02

188398.description:
In a rural country town where nothing exciting ever happens, a new face suddenly appears at the library: a man from the city who starts to show up every week without fail. With each visit, the librarian, Hagiwara, can't help but notice little things about this new regular, Yabumi--his punctuality, his demeanor, his strangely methodical approach to reading every single book by a single author... Slowly, without realizing it, that simple observation blooms into a deeper interest that draws Hagiwara in, until he can't help it! He wants to get to know Yabumi better. But how will be bridge the distance, when there's no talking in the library?

(Source: Kodansha USA)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.native: フリップ・フリップ・スローリー

188399.description: Note: Published in COMIC Magnum Vol. 129

188400.description:
When he was a child, high school student Miyahira Asahi started helping people hoping to be popular like a superhero he saw on tv, but he’s always just a “good guy”. Even though he’s looking excited to change classes and insists “This year, I’ll get a girlfriend!”, he ends up in the same class as the cool and good-looking school idol Genda Kaede. When he gets to bed frustrated, an angel appears before his eyes and tells him, “I’m giving you telepathic powers.” He thought it was just a dream, but the next morning, he can really hear people’s inner voices when he touches them…!?

To take advantage of his ability and become popular in school, he decides to listen to Kaede’s thoughts, but… huh, who does Kaede like!?

A slapstick youth romantic comedy that begins with telepathy.

(Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

Note: Includes an extra chapter.
synonyms: Tớ Nghe Được Hết Tiếng Lòng Của Cậu Đó!

title.native: 俺には全部きこえてる！

188401.description:
Cha Seon-Ho lives a humble yet diligent life, but something has been bothering him for months: someone keeps leaving a sticky mess in his locker. As the cruel pranks escalate, Seon-Ho and his best friend, Lee Yu-Geon, decide to catch the culprit by staking out the locker overnight. But when Seon-Ho takes a break to visit the restroom, he discovers something deeply unsettling has happened to his own body…

(Source: Lezhin US, edited)

188402.description:
Jae-Ui and Mu-Yeong, used to be in the same club but grew apart until they unexpectedly crossed paths nearly ten years after graduation. During their college days, Mu-Yeong had always admired his senior, Jae-Ui, harboring feelings that went unnoticed. Now, as adults, Mu-Yeong is excited to reconnect and warmly approaches Jae-Ui. However, Jae-Ui doesn’t share the same enthusiasm. Instead of welcoming their reunion, he seems distant and reluctant to engage in conversation. Despite Jae-Ui’s cold demeanor, Mu-Yeong persistently tries to bridge the gap between them. But as their interactions continue, Jae-Ui reveals a deeply personal and painful secret, one that explains his reluctance to reconnect. As the past resurfaces and hidden emotions come to light, their relationship takes an unexpected turn, leaving Mu-Yeong to question whether some distances are truly impossible to overcome.

(Source: Lezhin US, edited)

Note: Part of Lezhin's SS Short Story Collection (SS 단편선) or the Depraved Collection in English.
synonyms: [SS Short Story Collection] Point of Inaccessibility

188403.description:
Igarashi Kei works for an advertising agency and is currently engaged. Through work he reunites with his younger adoptive brother Nanase Chiharu, whose real name is Igarashi Haru, after 10 years.

Note: Includes 2 extra chapters.

188404.description:
Siora spent her days as the servant of an ancient god until she was sucked into a novel and possessed characters close to the male lead, Duke Kruelo Whitedesert. A mysterious voice tells her that if she prevents Kruelo from destroying this world, she'll return to her own. But the duke's life is fraught with danger, and she dies twice before accomplishing anything. With time running out, will Siora finally be able to go home, or will Kruelo's treacherous life kill her for the third time?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: หุ่นเชิดเที่ยงคืน

188405.description:
Ji-Hwa Yeon died before her time. However, she is sent back to live the remainder of her life with a reaper to watch over her. She is also chosen as the unprecedented 1,001st candidate for King of the Netherworld. Now she must participate in brutal exams for the throne while getting burned for her trusting, helpful nature. She is told she is a “good person” and suspects it’s because she has no noteworthy traits. With no special powers, Ji-Hwa will see how far being a good person will take her.

(Source: Tapas, edited)
synonyms: Guide to be King of the Dead

188406.description:
Eighteen-year-old U-Ri Chae is just a normal high schooler who loves reality dating shows—until she unexpectedly lands a spot on "Love in Session" alongside her childhood crush, U-Jin Hyeon. Frantic to win his heart, U-Ri throws herself at the opportunity. But her mission quickly becomes complicated: U-Jin is mysteriously absent, one participant hates her, and she finds herself unexpectedly attracted to others on the show. As romantic tensions rise, U-Ri must navigate her feelings and the show’s drama. Can she untangle her heart and find true love amid the chaos?

(Source: WEBTOON, edited)

188407.description:
The protagonist works as a courier. The request this time is to transport a container with unknown contents. However, the contents of the container are young girls! The protagonist sympathizes with the girls, who seem to have been deceived and brought here from overseas, but...

(Source: Mujin Comics, translated)

Note: Published in Comic Mugen Tensei 2019-03

188408.description:
When doomed to get the bad ending, everyone would try to avoid it no matter what, right? But, that’s not the case for A-Min Kim. Reborn as Jayna Blake, the main character of her favorite game: “How to Fall in Love with the Obsessed Man”, A-Min Kim is determined to get the locked up ending. Free food, limitless sleep, and no need to work! Who’d refuse that? At least, not Jayna!

(Source: WEBTOON)

title.native: 監禁してください！主人公は執着男子
title.romaji: Kankin Shite Kudasai! Shujinkou wa Shuuchaku Danshi

188411.description:
A hard-working girl reincarnates as a villainess in a light novel...at the same time, a decent businessman reincarnates as a villain prince in the same story! They meet and fall in love.

Honoka, a thirty-year-old working girl fell off the stairs after she was told from her fiance he wants to break up. The next moment, she was in the world of "Fated, Love～A Cinderella Story～", a light novel which her sister was into. She is now Clarisse, a seventeen-year-old aristocrat lady. Honoka knows that she is going to be a villainess along with Eduard, brother of the crown prince Arnold. She decides to change her fate and live happily in this world. When she meets Eduard for the first time, they fall in love almost instantly. To her surprise, Eduard is nothing like the villain described in the book. He is gentle, clever and nice...and handsome! She never knew that Eduard too, had reincarnated from the world she came from.

(Source: BookWalker)

title.english: The Villainess and Villain Try to Avoid Another Unhappy Ending
title.native: 悪役令嬢に転生した私と悪役王子に転生した俺
title.romaji: Akuyaku Reijou ni Tensei shita Watashi to Akuyaku Ouji ni Tensei shita Ore

188412.description: In Shimoyama Middle School, the Experiment Club and Karate Club each only have one member left, and as a result, must share one classroom. These two students, Homura Sharaku and Yousuke Yamazaki (a.k.a Karate Kid) together solve numerous impossible mysteries that they happen to run into!
synonyms: Sharaku Homura: Detective of the Uncanny

188413.description:
An offer that was too good to be true. A group of society's bottom-dwellers are offered money to take part in a clinical trial. What they didn't know, was that this trial would possible be the last thing they ever did.

(Source: DAYcomics)

188414.description: A collection of creepy, unsettlingly funny and super odd horror oneshots from the Horror M magazine made by Naomi Tsukamoto

188415.description: Mortal Kombat manga based on the 1995 movie by Paul W.S. Anderson as it takes iconic movie scenes in manga format.

188416.description:
Han Ba-Ram and Lim Han-Tae first met the day Ba-Ram quit his guitar academy after an incident with the teacher. Now, six years later, the two are close, but Ba-Ram secretly has feelings for his best friend. Ba-Ram has tried to move on from the past and his crush, but when their former guitar teacher plays Ba-Ram's song on TV and claims it's his, he is forced to confront his past and tell Han-Tae what really happened that day. Will Ba-Ram finally stand up for himself... and confess his crush on Han-Tae?

(Source: Tapas)

title.native: NHK その時歴史が動いた 冒険・挑戦編
title.romaji: NHK Sono Toki Rekishi ga Ugoita: Bouken Chousen-hen

synonyms: NHK Sono Toki Rekishi ga Ugoita: Kodai Chuusei no Mystery-hen

title.native: NHK その時歴史が動いた 古代・中世の謎編
title.romaji: NHK Sono Toki Rekishi ga Ugoita: Kodai Chuusei no Nazo-hen

188419.description:
Mutou Kushina's life, filled with brutality, came to an abrupt end. In his new incarnation, the goddess granted him three abilities: [Super Speedy Regeneration], [Agelessness], and [Grit: Indomitable Spirit]. However, those skills were outlier skills that were not offensive skills!
The place where he was reborn with such skills is the Forest of Endless Calamity, where a large number of Danger Level S monsters roam, one of which is capable of destroying the world. Having no offensive skills, Kushina's should have been killed by the monsters right away, but...? With all three skills, he can instantly regenerate no matter what kind of attack he receives! And every time he is attacked, he gets stronger and stronger...

(Source: firecross, translated)
synonyms: The Three Skills I Received, When Combined, Were The Most Powerful

title.native: 貰った三つの外れスキル、合わせたら最強でした
title.romaji: Moratta Mittsu no Hazure Skill, Awasetara Saikyou Deshita

188420.description:
As a first-year law student, Lee Yeon never expected to cross paths again with his middle school crush — the charming upperclassman Hong Ki-Hoon. But a chance reunion on campus leads to an even more unexpected twist: a spontaneous trip, and a strange challenge known only as the Red Thread Quest.

Red Thread Quest, Round 1: Five Kisses on the Cheek!

Skeptical about soulmates and fate, Yeon finds himself drawn into the legend of the Red Thread of Fate — and as each round of the quest unfolds, his relationship with Ki-Hoon begins to take an unpredictable turn.

What started as a game might just lead them to something real…if the Red Thread Rock has anything to say about it.

(Source: Lezhin US)
synonyms: 赤い糸クエスト〜XXでクエストを完了せよ！〜
เควสต์ด้ายแดง

188422.description:
Our protagonist wakes up one day to find herself as Elia, the daughter of a bankrupt baron and a side character in a romance-fantasy novel. While on the run from debt collectors, she saves a child from an attacker -- only to be accused of being the kidnapper by the child’s guardian, Duke Kaiden. Taken to his mansion, she’s forced to live with them and be the child’s nanny. Can Elia clear up the misunderstanding and find her way out of this mess?

(Source: WEBTOON)
synonyms: I Became the Mother of a Sub-Male Son

title.english: Raising the Second Male Lead’s Son

188423.description:
"I'll give you one condition. I'll take you."

Shino, who had been living happily with her family at an orphanage, one day receives notice from Chitose, the eldest son of a wealthy family, that he will no longer be supporting the orphanage. Wanting to protect her family, Shino decides to become a fake couple with Chitose in exchange for his continued support!?

They are supposed to be a newlywed couple, but Chitose is extremely cold towards Shino, and no matter what Shino does, he gets angry at her... But at the same time, she also becomes aware of the loneliness he is feeling. At that time, at a party at the Suka family home, a man tries to kill Chitose! When Shino risks her life to protect him, the cold-hearted Chitose approaches her with an unexpected expression...!?

A hardworking girl and a cold-hearted husband, the frustrating love story of a temporary couple.

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title.native: 冷血旦那様に口づけを～大正かりそめ婚姻譚～
title.romaji: Reiketsu Danna-sama ni Kuchizuke wo - Taisho Karisome Konin Tan

188424.description: “I’m going to make a friend just for me.” Piecing corpses together, the doctor made his very own “friend”, but this “friend” thinks of him as more than a friend…

title.native: フランケンシュタインの友人

188425.description:
Ever since she was separated from her mother at an early age, Eliza has been treated as an untouchable in the house of Adal Luna, the lord of the house. One day, however, she is summoned by the lord and told that she is his blood daughter and that she is to marry the third prince, Leo, who is rumored to be promiscuous and arrogant. Eliza is perplexed, but Sati, the lord's wife, tells Eliza an even crueler truth... Is this love a trick or the truth? Can Eliza, who has lost everything, find happiness?

(Source: Manga Plaza)

title.english: The Prince, a Witch's Daughter and their Love
title.native: 魔女の娘エリザと王子の恋
title.romaji: Majo no Musume Eliza to Oji no Koi

188426.description:
We don't know yet. That the world is coming to an end. That the superhumans (Overmen) who live in the underground world are protecting the sky. And...that a boy will come to the surface.

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

188427.description:
Having had her engagement broken off and now past the age of marriage, Alerila is known behind her back as the "official lady." She works steadily as the right-hand man to the "cold-hearted Prime Minister," Marquis Easteria Wegmund. One day, while on duty, the Prime Minister proposes to her. Given rumors that the Prime Minister is in love with another woman, Alerila's own low family status, and her status as an unmarried administrative officer, she understands that he is asking her to enter into a contract marriage, and so she accepts the engagement. A businesslike married life with the cold-hearted Prime Minister begins...!!

(Source: Comic Earth Star, translated)
synonyms: Otsubone Reijou to Shiyuka no Kisetsu

title.native: お局令嬢と朱夏の季節　〜冷徹宰相様のお飾りの妻になったはずが、溺愛されています〜
title.romaji: Otsubone Reijou to Shiyuka no Kisetsu: Reitetsu Saishou-sama no Okazari no Tsuma ni Natta Hazu ga, Dekiaisareteimasu

188428.description:
Roelle’s life has been nothing but tragic at the hands of her abusive family. But the worst tragedy of all occurs when she kills her cousin after he tries to take advantage of her. In order to avoid being put to death for the murder, Roelle runs away deep into the winter forest, where she encounters the lone Kayden in his cabin. When Kayden allows Roelle to stay with him for a while, the hopeless cold quickly turns into passionate heat. Will this cabin become Roelle’s haven? Or will it be the start of a new hell?

(Source: Tappytoon)
synonyms: A Quiet and Crazy Winter Cabin
กระท่อมร้อนในคืนฤดูหนาว
靜謐雪夜裡的炙熱木屋

title.english: A Winter Cabin of Serenity and Insanity

188429.description:
"Would it bother you if I asked you to go out with me?" Hotaru, who works at an advertising production company, is not very comfortable with men due to her past experience with a crappy boyfriend. However, her daily life changes little by little when she meets Nagisa, a good-looking, fem stylist. It's Nagisa's feminine nature in fact, that leads Hotaru to believe that she might be able to go out with him, despite him being a man. As the nature of their relationship becomes unclear, Nagisa steps up and confesses his interest in Hotaru?!!

(Source: MangaPlaza)

Note: Includes three extra chapters.

title.english: The Erotically Sweet Love Lessons of Nagisa, the Feminine
title.native: 渚くんはオネエ系♂ 秘密の恋人レッスンは淫らに甘く
title.romaji: Nagisa-kun wa Onee-kei ♂ Himitsu no Koibito Lesson wa Midara ni Amaku

188430.description:
Binge-reading my favorite romantasy novel is my one and only solace after late-night shifts at my part-time job. I was just reading my novel while walking home from yet another long shift, when suddenly a truck…! Huh? Delivery truck driver Taek-Jin’s struggle to return back to Korea after waking up in a strange world begins!

(Source: WEBTOON)
synonyms: อัศวินเดลิเวอรี

188431.description:
"I want a divorce."

The arrogant Christoph believed Marianne would eventually return. That she'd left home on a whim. After all, the facts had always said he was right. Well, he couldn't have been more wrong. Filled with regret, he tries to bring Marianne back, but she refuses to change her mind. Can Christoph earn Marianne's forgiveness and win her heart again?

(Source: WEBTOON)

title.native: 最強マシン モンスターに挑むホンダF1プロジェクト
title.romaji: Saikyou Machine: Monster ni Idomu Honda F1 Project

188433.description:
Ruuru came to the room of his favorite classmate, Ariwa-kun, to discuss a class meeting. Ariwa-kun fell asleep for some reason, and Ruuru made a bold advance on him, but she was caught in the act by Ariwa-kun's father! The father, who runs a calligraphy class, is eating out his son's classmates!?

(Source: Mujin Comics, translated)

Note: Published in Comic Mugen Tensei 2019-08

188434.description:
Sara Popo was a highly-regarded elementary school teacher in her past life. Reborn into a new world, she becomes a sought-after tutor for aristocratic children. Her unique methods quickly earn her praise--and the Emperor’s attention. He asks Sara to tutor his notorious twin siblings, infamous for their wild pranks. While a daunting challenge, she can’t refuse the Emperor’s generous offer.Winning over the twins might be her specialty, but can she handle the Emperor’s irresistible charm too?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: I Became the Tutor of the Royal Twins
双子殿下の家庭教師になりました

title.english: I'm the Tutor of the Twin Highnesses

188435.description:
The protagonist finally opens his dream privately run cafe. However, it turns out to be a hangout spot for female students after school! After the girls discover the camera he was secretly taking pictures of in the bathroom, the protagonist is forced to provide naughty service at the students' command. What will become of him?

(Source: Mujin Comics, translated)

Note: Published in Comic Mugen Tensei 2019-10, 2020-01

title.native: みにみにミルクホール

188436.description:
Two sisters who were assaulted by their mother's new husband go on a "god-waiting" spree to seek help. The man who picked them up turns out to be a kind man who lets many girls in trouble stay at his house. However, the trauma of their stepfather comes back to haunt them...

(Source: Mujin Comics, translated)

Note: Published in Comic Mugen Tensei 2020-04

title.native: あったかおふとん～お泊まり夜話～

188437.description:
1. Hakobiya no Oshigoto (運び屋のお仕事); Comic Mugen Tensei 2019-03
2. Yokodori Shodou Kyoushitsu (よこどり書道教室); Comic Mugen Tensei 2019-08
3-4. Minimini Milk Hall (みにみにミルクホール); Comic Mugen Tensei 2019-10, 2020-01
5. Attaka Ofuton: Otomari Yawa (あったかおふとん～お泊まり夜話～); Comic Mugen Tensei 2020-04

title.native: つるぺたハーレムだよ♥

188438.description:
"Prepare yourself, Protagonist. With this power, I will change this predetermined future."

One day, he was suddenly reincarnated into the world of his favorite romance RPG. However, the body he had reincarnated into belonged to the 'Incompetent Evil Prince' Harold who had his engagement broken off with the heroine. On top of that, according to the setting, he wasn't able to use his magic power and would be defeated by the protagonist.

But, it'll be different this time.

First, he stopped his engagement from being broken off with the heroine and started training himself. Then, he obtained a power different from the one he had in the original work, and overwhelmed everyone with the enormous magic power he shouldn't have been able to use!

And before he realized it, his single-minded pursuit of strength had also gotten the attention of the other heroines...

The overwhelmingly popular villain reincarnation fantasy makes a grand entrance!
synonyms: The Survival of an Incompetent Villainous Prince

title.native: 無能の悪童王子は生き残りたい～恋愛RPGの悪役モブに転生したけど、原作無視して最強を目指す～
title.romaji: Munou no Akudou Ouji wa Ikinokoritai: Renai RPG no Akuyaku Mob ni Tensei shita kedo, Gensaku Mushi shite Saikyou wo Mezasu

188439.description:
Three beautiful girls break into a manga cafe! The protagonist is confused by the girls who ask him to have sex with them and play with his dick. However, when the three girls spread their unused pussies, dripping with love juice, he ends up having sex with them!

(Source: Mujin Comics, translated)

Note: Published in Comic Mugen Tensei 2020-10

188440.description:
An overworked game developer dies and is reincarnated as the weakest character in the game he created himself. Challenged by Jaeseokcheon, the ruler of the game universe, he must complete a series of quests to survive and prevent a second death. Epic battles between monsters, celestial beings with magic powers, and Jaeseokcheon ensue. In this tug-of-war between the omniscient game designer and the hidden mastermind ruler… Who will win?

(Source: WEBTOON)
synonyms: Resurrected Knight Trapped in a Cursed Game
The Knight's Revival Through a Cursed Game

title.native: 女教師は絶倫交尾でメスになる
title.romaji: Onna Kyoushi wa Zetsurin Koubi de Mesu ni Naru

188442.description: Note: A live-action AV adaptation (MIMK-262) was released on 16th January, 2026.

title.native: オタクの僕にも中出しさせてくれる優しいヤリマンビッチギャル
title.romaji: Otaku no Boku ni mo Nakadashi Sasete Kureru Yasashii Yariman Bitch Gal

188443.description:
The maid of the Sewa family, who has served the Nankiri family for generations, is a boy. He lives his school life disguising his gender for the Nankiri family, but some of the female students in the same department know that he is a boy. They have sex with him in secret in the nurse's office or the student council room! Then the young lady of Nankiri, whom he serves, shows up...?!

(Source: Mujin Comics, translated)

Note: Published in Comic Mugen Tensei 2021-04

188444.description:
Three small beautiful girls from a rural village come to visit the protagonist. A week after the protagonist begins living with them, one of the girls, Nao Tomoe, pressures the protagonist into a physical relationship! Nao Tomoe, who needs the protagonist's sperm, seduces the protagonist and has sex with him, but the three girls have a secret...?!

(Source: Mujin Comics, translated)

Note: Published in Comic Mugen Tensei 2021-11, 2022-04

title.native: ちっちゃ妊娠♥ハラみ隊

188445.description:
Kyouka, a transfer student, has been luring men and threatening them, asking for money. Just as she is about to extort them as she usually does, she is kidnapped. She is taken to a place where she finds the class representatives of her school. They belong to the "Town-Pleasure Circle" which maintains public order by arranging sugar daddies for the whole town. As punishment for Kyouka's disruption of public order, they make her have sex as punishment!

(Source: Mujin Comics, translated)

Note: Published in Comic Mugen Tensei 2022-09

title.native: 旬のそざいのゆうこうかつよう
title.romaji: Shun no Sozai no Yuukou Katsuyou

188446.description:
Top idol 'Kwon Jae-Sung' suddenly returns to his hometown to take a break from his prime, and there, his childhood friend 'Lee Soo-Ah', who he had separated from when he was young, is preparing to become an adult. Kwon Jae-Sung, who had a hard time parting ways, wants to impress his presence on Lee Soo-Ah again before they go their separate ways as adults.

(Source: Naver, translated)

188447.description:
One feverish night, 6-year-old Liliana Bercchio suddenly recalls the plot of a tragic reverse harem novel. Unsure if she's been reincarnated or has time traveled, her young mind struggles to make sense of it all. Her family is doomed to get caught up in the protagonists' mess—but there's still time… or so she thought. When she witnesses the female lead's death and the deranged male leads appear before her sisters, the story takes a turn. They seem different now, but is her family truly safe?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: I Became the Youngest Sister-in-Law of the Ruined Reverse Harem's Male Leads
Je suis devenue la belle-soeur adorée dans un harem inversé

title.english: Youngest Sister-in-Law in a Tragic Reverse Harem
title.native: 피폐 역하렘 남주들의 막내 처제가 되었다
title.romaji: Pipye Yeok Harem Namjudeur-ui Maknae Cheojega Doeeossda

188448.description:
1-2. Chiccha Ninshin ♥ Haramitai (ちっちゃ妊娠♥ハラみ隊); Comic Mugen Tensei 2021-11, 2022-04
3. Kyoushuu ♥ Mini Mittsu (強襲♥みにみっつ); Comic Mugen Tensei 2020-10
4. Shun no Sozai no Yuukou Katsuyou (旬のそざいのゆうこうかつよう); Comic Mugen Tensei 2022-09
5. Tsukutsuku Houshi‼ (つくつくほーし‼); Comic Mugen Tensei 2021-04
synonyms: PREGNANT GIRLS CAME TO MY APARTMENT
Shun no Sozai no Yuukou Katsuyou

title.native: ちっちゃ妊娠♡ハーレム日和

188449.description:
Will Inabi, who lives as an ordinary middle school student while hiding her true identity as a witch, be able to maintain her daily life?

(Source: Naver, translated)

Note: Series ended on 2023/7/26, but a special chapter was released on 2025/2/11.

188450.description:
Do-Hun has been secretly in love with Ye-Jun since middle school. They were always together through high school and college, and Do-Hun believed they would stay by each other’s side forever. But one day, Ye-Jun suddenly got married, shattering Do-Hun’s quiet hopes. Even after years of trying, he couldn’t shake off his endless, frustrating one-sided love. Determined to move on, he decides to take a solo trip. Just as he’s about to leave, he hears the news, Yejun is getting divorced after just three years of marriage. That very night, Ye-Jun unexpectedly shows up at Do-Hun's door and asks him...

“Can you take me on that trip?”

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes three extra chapters.
synonyms: 最も深い告白〜ずっとお前が好きだった〜
คำสารภาพที่ไม่อาจเอื้อนเอ่ย

188451.description:
“One moment, she was about to be hit by a truck, but that next...”

"I'll return you to your world if you marry the prince." That was the shocking proposal of the self-proclaimed god! I won't really get a bad ending if I refuse, will I!? Office worker Sara was involved in a traffic accident, or so she thought. One moment, she was about to be hit by a truck, but that next... she found herself transported to an unfamiliar, grand castle, falling right on top of Prince Ars! When a soldier recognized her as "Sara," the saint who saved the kingdom five years earlier, everyone suddenly started treating her as some divine being!! After questioning her reality, a voice came to her and said, "Capture the heart of the prince, who longs for the saint, and marry him!" The voice then threatened her denying her return to her own world should she fail... Her only weapon in this challenge is her face that apparently looks just like that of the saint's! And so began her zealous attempt to steal the prince's heart!

(Source: Comikey)

title.english: I'm a (Fake) Saint Who Was Summoned to Another World, But Apparently I'm Fated to Die If I Don't Marry the Prince
title.native: 異世界に召喚された(偽)聖女の私は、王子様と結婚出来ないと死ぬ運命のようです
title.romaji: Isekai ni Shoukansareta (Nise) Seijo no Watashi wa, Ouji-sama to Kekkon Dekinai to Shinu Unmei no you desu

188452.description:
All Nae-Un Kim ever wanted was to become the best surgeon she could be. She’s satisfied, even if there’s no time for herself. But when her power-hungry father sends her on a blind date, her life is thrown into chaos. Kang-Joon Cha is a legend–and not just because of his powerful family. He’s a brilliant and respected surgeon in his own right. As busy as he is, it’s no wonder he’s single--unless there's another reason. Can this pair thread the needle? Or will this relationship end before it starts?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: นัดบอดลวงเล่ห์

188454.description: Note: This is a promotional one-shot for the webnovel of the same name.
synonyms: The Main Villain Is Stuck To Me Like Chewing Gum

188455.description:
Cecily is a romantic who dreams of finding true love—the only problem is that she's a witch! Scorned by society, she gives up on meeting her very own Prince Charming until a chance encounter with the gruff but gallant knight Zeke reignites her dream. She concocts a love potion in secret and brings it to him, but before she can get a word in edgewise, he accidentally drinks the whole thing! Will Cecily manage to come clean about the whole affair? And will this slipup lead to the happily ever after she's always wanted?

(Source: J-Novel Club)

title.english: Accidentally in Love: The Witch, the Knight, and the Love Potion Slipup
title.native: 恋する魔女はエリート騎士に惚れ薬を飲ませてしまいました ～偽りから始まるわたしの溺愛生活～
title.romaji: Koisuru Majo wa Elite Kishi ni Horegusuri wo Nomasete Shimaimashita: Itsuwari kara Hajimaru Watashi no Dekiai Seikatsu

188456.description:
In a world where humanity battles monsters with powerful weapons called Relics, Hinata Asahi is the ultimate underdog at Valkyria Academy, a school for training warriors. Mocked for his relic, a gimmicky suit that looks like a comic book costume, and bullied by classmates, no one knows it holds a secret. The more he is pushed down, the stronger it becomes. Driven by his father’s legacy, Hinata forges new friendships and pushes past every obstacle. With unwavering determination, can he rise to become one of the academy’s strongest?

(Source: WEBTOON)
synonyms: ฮีโร่ต้นทุนต่ำ

title.native: 俺だけスーパーヒーロー

188457.description:
Everything seems to be going downhill for the quiz club this year. Not only did they lose at the district qualifiers of the national competition, one of the club’s core members, Kuma, suddenly said she’s quitting school. Kuma has memorized many quiz books and knows an incredible amount of facts… but Kuma has a secret that none of the other members know. What could it be and what connection does it have with her quitting school?

(Source: Azuki)

188458.description:
The strange life of a man brought back from his previous life. Can a man, brought from the modern day, fall in love again with his beautiful elven former lover...?!

(Source: Coolmic)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.english: Miiyu Just Wanted His Dead Lover Back
title.native: ミィユは死んだ恋人を喚び戻したかった
title.romaji: Miiyu wa Shinda Koibito wo Yobimodoshitakatta

188459.description:
A military policeman, Taka'akira, couldn't stand his childhood friend, Chiaki's way of living...he doesn't work, just plays around with women every day using money he had inherited.
Recently, Taka'akira's team has been working on "Ladykiller" cases--victims were all young men, their faces ripped off and their arms and legs chopped off.
After warning Chiaki about the serial killer, Taka'akira encountered a monster...which a young girl sliced with her sword. She was Kikyo--a priestess who exorcises Magatsuhi.
Next day, he was told that he was transferred to Special Branch Zero, a special team that deals with Magatsuhi, inhuman evil beings in this world.
He is now the partner of Kikyo...but he has a feeling he had met her long ago...when?

(Source: Azuki)

Note: Chapter count includes one extra.
synonyms: Daily Heresy Record of the Special Mission No. Zero Agency

title.english: Special Branch Zero's Demonological Daily Chronicle
title.native: 特務第零機関の日常異端録
title.romaji: Tokumu Dai Zero Kikan no Nichijou Itanroku

188460.description:
Mei lost her mother, dumped by her boyfriend...and stabbed by a mysterious sword that fell from the sky.
She thought she died, but when she opened her eyes, she was in another world. A world she had seen in the textbooks she was using to teach her students at cram school...ancient China.
Everyone calls her "The War God Mei" and looks like she has to save the country by fighting the war!
Mei decides to act like the War God, but the beautiful general who came to pick her up looks suspicious...

(Source: MangaPlaza)

title.english: A Blossom in the Snow Stands as a War God
title.native: 雪中の花は、軍神を偽る
title.romaji: Sechuu no Hana wa, Gunshin wo Itsuwaru

188461.description:
Eun-Yu never had any reason to talk to, much less eat with, her manager, Ki-Jo Baek. Understandably, she's caught off guard when she's suddenly invited to lunch by her charismatic boss. And she's even more taken aback when that boss suddenly confesses his feelings for her! Unfortunately for Mr. Baek, this new crush of his is actually employed by his mother and looking to blackmail him!

(Source: Tapas)

188462.description:
Ryugeom Cheok, a loyal Goryeo warrior, throws himself off a cliff with his enemy to protect his master—only to be frozen in ice for 900 years. Awakened in the modern era, the greatest swordsman of Goryeo begins his journey of vengeance…

(Source: WEBTOON)
synonyms: นักรบแช่แข็ง

188465.description:
The largest theme park in America has been overrun by a zombie virus. Sung-heon finds himself trapped with his daughter among zombies and foreign tourists with whom he cannot communicate. In this unprecedented disaster where any moving living creature, not just humans, is turned into a zombie, Sung-heon struggles with his injured leg to save his daughter. They must survive - from the zombies, and from them.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

188466.description:
Actually, I didn't want to be a teacher. I gave up my dream and was about to take responsibility for the path I chose, when a cocky boy said, "Would you like to lend me a light?". My life as a teacher seems to be going awry as I get entangled with this cocky kid who has genius talent, overflowing wealth, and fame. A story about school life intertwined with dreams, talent, and love.

(Source: Naver, translated)

Note: Includes 10 extra chapters.
synonyms: Do You Want Me to Lend You a Lighter?

188467.description:
Reincarnated as the heroine of a novel she once read, Veronica seeks revenge against her tyrannical father. Amidst a web of intrigue, she cautiously aligns herself with the enigmatic Prince Lowen and Duke Evan, who happen to be the murder suspects of her previous homicidal death. As Veronica carefully carry out her plan of revenge, she also finds herself drawn to Lowen and Evan, unraveling hidden truths of her past life.

(Source: POCKET COMICS)

Note: based on a Korean web novel, the comic was first published by POCKET COMICS in English (2024-04-23), but its first AniList-eligible publication was in Japanese by Comico (2024-06-12), and its Korean release was not until 2024-10-22 on KakaoPage. Thus by AniList priority rules this is categorized as a Japanese manga.

title.native: 殺されたヒロインの完璧なエンディングのために
title.romaji: Korosareta Heroine no Kanpeki Ending no Tame ni

188468.description:
She’s got the perfect guy, she’s just graduated, and she’s about to go on vacation! Kaitlyn’s life was perfect… until it wasn’t. After getting dumped and finding out she has no place to stay, Kaitlyn is forced to crash at the Dune Scape, a dilapidated motel owned by her childhood crush and her brother’s best friend, Cole Thomas! Will sparks fly between the two of them? Or will Cole’s loyalty to her brother doom their relationship before it even begins?

(Source: Tapas)

188469.description: Kazama Endo is the ultimate delinquent, unbeaten in a fight. He goes to scope out a boy who beat up his henchmen, but it turns out this boy is anything but ordinary!

188470.description:
“Let the Survival Game Begin!”

Designated as a disruptive species in the universe’s ecology, humanity must now participate in the ‘league’ under the watchful eye of the universal administrators. Jae-Hui Jin, sent back in time during the final stage of the game, arrives at one conclusion - only Sion Kang has the power to lead humanity to victory.

(Source: WEBTOON)

188472.description:
Azure, the founding father of vampires who has lived since time immemorial, is challenged to a fight by Shuuya, a vampire hunter who makes no effort to conceal his hostility. Interest piqued, Azure proposes a game. Should Shuuya come to love Azure by the time the red spider lilies wither, he shall become a bride. Should Shuuya’s feelings remain unchanged, his wish shall be granted. What will become of Shuuya, fiancé to the strongest vampire...!?

(Source: Opera, translated)

title.native: ブルーブラッドヴァンパイア

188475.description:
Harang is a rising star in women’s handball… until she isn’t. Unexpectedly sidelined by a devastating shoulder injury, Harang tries to return to her daily grind as a student. But life has a way of throwing huge curveballs, and she finds herself a part of the women’s futsal team at her high school along with passionate, determined teammates. Women’s national league, here we come…?!

(Source: WEBTOON)

188476.description:
"I must never let anyone know that I'm a man..." The Witch's Country. It's a garden where only women are allowed to enter, and no men are allowed to enter. If a man enters the royal capital, he will be executed immediately! Someone knocks on the door of the Witch Academy in this royal capital. His name is Towa Mitsumine. He is a high school boy who has been reincarnated in another world. Of course, Towa, a boy, shouldn't be able to enter the royal capital. However, when he was reincarnated in the other world, Towa gained a certain skill. It wasn't just an "ordinary" strongest skill -- it was a "female transformation" skill that allowed him to transform into a girl. Moreover, it seems that when he is in a female body state, he can use super powerful magic...! For a former high school boy, school life with only girls is too stimulating! Aiming to become the "Strongest Witch Knight" he has always dreamed of, Towa's slightly erotic female transformation fantasy life begins!

(Source: BOOK☆WALKER, translated)

188477.description:
19-year-old Sei dreams of a stable life as a government official. But when her mother suddenly passes away, she discovers a bankbook with 1.5 billion yen—money secretly sent every year by her father, who disappeared 15 years ago.

Sei soon learns he owns Tengoku District, a lively nightlife hub. Then, a scout named approaches her, asking, "Want to be the Queen of the Night?"

(Source: Natalie, translated)

188478.description:
All Seong-A Myeong wants to do is spend her life playing video games. Unfortunately, after defeating a streamer in an online game and taking his money, she realizes that he is actually a boy in her class named Han-Jun Kang, who also happens to be a terrifying delinquent! Determined to keep her identity a secret, she decides to request a class transfer, only to run into Tae-Ui An, another classmate who looks exactly like her game character! Can she spend time with Tae-ui while keeping Han-Jun from discovering who she really is?

(Source: WEBTOON)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

188480.description:
Yi-Jae, an ambitious small town cop, discovers that his first love, Jun-Hyuk, is involved in the band of criminals known as the Black Goat Gang. Forced to pose as lovers, they must navigate danger and desire. Can their fake romance help put the bad guys behind bars, or will their tangled past blow their cover?

(Source: Manta)

188482.description:
Jeanette’s evil stepmother has been tormenting her for years, making her into the laughingstock of high society. And when Jeanette’s father suddenly disappears, the opportunistic woman casts her out of the house! Still, the eternal optimist Jeanette sees this as an opportunity for growth. Eager to start her life anew, she decides to call off her engagement to Count Claus Guivarch; rumor has it that the young man is being forced into this marriage to clear his family’s debt, and Jeanette wants to set him free. But to her surprise, the gentleman has other plans—he refuses to break up, and even offers to help her reclaim her father’s corporation. With the chances Claus gives her, Jeanette’s business acumen quickly begins to shine. But what’s behind Claus’s unexpected affection…?

(Source: J-Novel Club)

title.english: Jeanette the Genius: Defying My Evil Stepmother by Starting a Business with My Ride-or-Die Fiancé!
title.native: 隠れ才女は全然めげない ～義母と義妹に家を追い出されたので婚約破棄してもらおうと思ったら、紳士だった婚約者が激しく溺愛してくるようになりました!?～

188483.description:
Ji Geon-Woo has been a thief since childhood, surviving with quick hands and sharp instincts. He isn’t greedy, stealing is simply a means to an end. One day, he sets his sights on a priceless necklace owned by Lee Ye-Shin, a troubled rich heir. To get close, Geon-Woo infiltrates Ye-Shin’s home as a bodyguard. At first, Ye-Shin appears reckless and self-indulgent, but Geon-Woo soon realizes he is deeply lonely, suffering from chronic insomnia. As their relationship blurs, Ye-Shin grows possessive, and Geon-Woo finds himself wanting to protect him, rather than just stealing from him. But when Ye-Shin discovers Geon-Woo’s true intentions, their fragile connection shatters. Now, Geon-Woo must make a choice, walk away with the necklace or stay for Ye-Shin. Meanwhile, Ye-Shin realizes that the only thing he truly wants isn't wealth, but Geon-Woo himself.

(Source: Lezhin US)

I was reincarnated as the villainous aristocrat, Vanitas, and decided to defy my destined destruction. By using the absolute power of Domination Magic, I will protect the heroines who were originally meant to be taken away, and push forward on my path to the top of the magical world.

“I want to be a protagonist!”

With sheer fighting spirit alone, he brought genuine protagonists to their knees. Striking his most determined hero pose, he won over a princess knight heroine. Through fiery training, his stats skyrocketed as well!?

Before long, aided by the thoughtful misunderstandings of those around him (?), people began recognizing him as a powerful figure entirely on their own.

"I am not in love with you." -- Those were the words Abigail's groom uttered to her on the first night of their marriage, causing her to break out in a panic. A beauty in a priestess outfit destroyed one of the dungeons appearing across the world for the first time. Blowing away goblins in a single hit with a mysterious divine power! Clearing the last boss in less than half a day! She continues to rack up unprecedented achievements one after another.

Among them, she is most interested in dungeons, whose true nature is still unknown! Indifferent to precious artifacts inside, she blows through dungeons one after another. A VIP in the national Awakened Association, but for some reason she's also a big hit among the populace as an idol?

Sora Ueno, a high school student reincarnated from the Heian era, is trying to make it big in the world of dungeon streaming. But there's just one problem—Onmyoji are seen as nothing more than shady frauds in this day and age, and his streams are stuck at a depressing zero viewers. Everything changes when Sora saves a massively popular, gorgeous streamer during a live broadcast. The clip goes insanely viral, and overnight, Sora finds himself in the spotlight. But the real shocker? His Onmyoji powers aren't just real—they're so ridiculously overpowered that they blow everyone's expectations out of the water. And just like that, Sora's legendary dungeon-streaming journey begins, where every broadcast turns into a viral sensation!

As the young leader destined to shape his gang’s future, Ban was on the fast track to a brilliant yakuza career. But in a single night, he was betrayed by a rival, falling from grace and becoming a disgraced gangster. Swearing vengeance and a comeback, he forms an unlikely alliance—with the No.1 host from the enemy faction!? And to make things even more absurd, their first meeting ends with the host boldly declaring, “Make me your mistress!” Can Ban reclaim his place as an elite yakuza once more!?

"Hiyori-kun, I need your help with the final mission, and that is—"

Hiyori's part-time coworker, the delinquent high schooler Rennosuke, is full of contradictions. One moment, he's furiously sketching adorable drawings with a terrifying expression, the next, he's silently petting an "imaginary cat" when no one's around…
Hiyori has always wanted to befriend Rennosuke, but he hasn't even managed a proper conversation with graduation approaching.
Then, one day, by sheer coincidence, he finally gets to talk to him! Overjoyed, Hiyori thinks he's finally making progress—
But wait!!! What is even happening right now—!?!?!?

In the Tenpou era of the Edo period, a young street vendor named Tora crosses paths with a man draped in lavish, high-quality kimono—a man of wealth and intrigue. That man turns out to be none other than the owner of the infamous pleasure goods shop, Yotsumeya. A merchant of everyday wares and the proprietor of Japan’s oldest sex toy shop— thus begins a tale of passion and commerce in this sensual Edo-period BL story!

(Source: Tokyo Mangasha, translated)

188505.description:
After being reincarnated, the protagonist Sigmund awoke in another world as a meager ghost. Fleeing from monsters into a nearby cavern and slowly leveling inside of it, Sigmund had evolved into the all-powerful "Immortal King" before realizing it! Now, using the nearby vast forest as a base, gaining followers, constructing golems and working on building a self-sustained life is Sigmund's new goal. However, there's always trouble lurking around every corner...

Two junior college students will become fathers today!

In the summer of their third year at university, Keisuke and Rei start raising children as their fathers despite not being married! Keisuke doesn't have many relationships with other people, and his only best friend on campus is Rei, a handsome and popular guy who is kind to everyone. One day, Renji Sakasegawa came home from his college classes only to save Ganji Hirosue, who had collapsed in front of Renji's apartment building. However, alongside his new loving family, Seongguk soon learns that perhaps some things are better than money... not! He's going to have loving parents and money in this life, and there's no better time to start than now. Armed with an adorable face and the skills of a business tycoon, can Seongguk take his new family to the top?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: I Will Raise This Family to Greatness
I Will Raise This Family Up

title.english: Crawling My Way to the Top!

188622.description:
Ja-Yeon, a recessive omega, gets into Hankuk University to find the mysterious "Gong Ju" who saved him when he was in middle school. He immediately finds Gong-Ju, but it turns out his savior has a twin! Ja-Yeon tries to figure out which alpha twin helped him and believes it to be Gong Ju-Eun. Convinced of his savior’s identity Ja-Yeon asks Gong Ju-Dan to help him win over the icy twin, but Ju-Dan won’t do it for free.

(Source: Lezhin US)

188623.description:
After his wife and child leave him, Park Tae-San decides it's time to give up his life as major player in organized crime. Before he can retire though, he's betrayed by one of his own and brutally murdered. However, Tae-San gets a second life when his organs are sold on the black market and transplanted into Yoo Chang, the successor of a major company. With a mild-mannered pushover and a revenge-thirsty thug fighting for control of the same body, will either make it out alive?

(Source: Tapas)

title.native: 迷宮配信者スライム豆腐は迷宮でむちゃくちゃにされたい。
title.romaji: Meikyuu Haishinsha Slime Toufu wa Meikyuu de Muchakucha ni saretai.

188625.description:
Ian Lane wakes to find himself in an eerie house with no memory and only ominous strangers for company. He soon discovers that he's a member of a team of afterlife enforcers and that he was recently tricked into giving away an important key, setting off a chain of events that disturbs the entire balance of the beyond. It's up to the executors to set things right again, but between formidable new foes and demons from Ian's dark past, this job gives new meaning to the phrase "life or death."

(Source: Tapas)

188626.description:
Being a half-zombie, Yamiyama may not be the best adventurer, but she definitely gives the most bone-chilling blowjobs. It also turns out her hunched back may be hiding a couple "secrets" under her mage robe for any sugar daddy willing to fill her up with coin.

(Source: Irodori Comics)

188627.description:
Mu-Ryoung, a prodigy exorcist born into a famous family, begins taking small jobs in high school. But when he meets Hwan-Young, a classmate cursed with misfortune, their bond drags him into a dangerous exorcism unlike any other.

(Source: Manta)

title.native: メスガ○使い魔ちゃん発育中！
いじわるメイドの瑠衣さん

188630.description:
In a time when the cold, cold hellish demons come down to this world to prey on people, the supreme god of heaven, Indra, and the Four Heavenly Kings below him protect the world from the demons of hell. However, the supreme god, Indra, tries to take the protagonist, “Na-Sua,” away, saying that he is the reincarnation of someone he cherished, but when Na-Sua grabs his collar to stop him, Indra feels offended and cuts off Na-Sua’s arm. Na-Sua’s resentment toward Heaven reaches the hot, scorching Hell, the opposite side of the cold Hell, and Na-Sua acquires the arm of a scorching demon… Na-Sua, who has become neither human nor demon, tries to confront Heaven, who is fighting Hell in order to get his younger brother back.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

title.native: 行きおくれ勇者様パパ活中

synonyms: The Femboy Transfer Student Who Will Transform His Classmate's Fetishes After 100 Days♡
A Male Transfer Student Who Drives His Classmate Crazy After 100 Days♡

title.native: 100日後にクラスメイトの性癖を狂わせる、男の娘転校生♡
title.romaji: 100-ichi Go ni Classmate no Seiheki wo Kuruwaseru, Otokonoko Tenkousei ♡

188633.description:
The collection of ghost stories gathered by Masaya Hokazono in the "Ihon" series.

The much-anticipated manga adaptations of special works, previously excluded from past manga adaptations due to their ominous nature, are brought to life by the extraordinary talents of horror masters Michiru Noroi and Taimu, handpicked by Masaya Hokazono.

(Source: Bunkasha, translated)

188634.description:
After the war, Anna’s restaurant held her village together. She took in strays and sowed farms from war-torn fields. When the lumbering bear of a man, Bertram, wanders into town, she puts him to work chopping onions. He doesn’t shed a single tear. Instead, he offers his services to repay a debt to her late father. Meanwhile, Bertram, stripped of his ability to feel emotion, is not immune to Anna’s warmth. As forces converge around the village, a charming tale of curses, loss, and love simmers.

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: The Prince Doesn’t Cry From Mere Onions

title.english: The Prince Doesn't Cry Over Onions

188635.description:
When life has you against the wall and you have nowhere to turn to, there's a certain group online that can help you on your journey to the other side. As you prepare for your final moments, life has a funny way of throwing you a curve ball.

In the back of a dingy van, one studly sadist comes face to face with two stacked masochists who want to throw away their virginity before they throw everything away. But why let such sexy bodies go to waste? There’s no reason they can’t be recycled and reincarnated as pathetic onaholes to be used however their new master sees fit!

(Source: Fakku!)

Note: Released at Comic Market 105

188636.description:
Tsukushi Kirishima is a born loser, a second year high school student who is mocked even by his underclassmen. He has been granted a mystery skill called "Ignore Rules," but he doesn't know how to use it, so he struggles in obscurity both as a student and an explorer. One day in a dungeon, he encounters the famous streamer Miru Ayatsuki. Miru's goal is to film the "emergency monster" that has suddenly appeared in the dungeon, but its strength poses an uphill battle and he finds herself in mortal danger! The same moment Tsukushi intervenes and comes to her rescue, the mystery skill "Ignore Rules" activates...

(Source: Futabasha, translated)
synonyms: I Accidentally Became a Legendary Explorer After Saving a Famous Streamer Who Forgot to End Their Dungeon Stream

title.romaji: Dungeon Haishin wo Kiriwasureta Yuumei Haishinsha wo Tasuketara, Densetsu no Tansakusha toshite Bazuri Hajimeta: Inkya no Ore, Nazo Skill dato Omotteita "Rule Mushi" de Ukkari Musou

188638.description:
Abaraya Cleanser is an old man who works daily to clean abandoned town after the war. This man was actually a hero from the previous war...the "strongest old man" who protected the city from terrorists

(Source: Yanmanga, translated)

title.native: 籠のなかの竜聖女 ―虐げられた伯爵令嬢は、今日も溺愛されています―
title.romaji: Kago no Naka no Ryuu Seijo: Shiitagerareta Hakushaku Reijou wa, Kyou mo Dekiai sareteimasu

188640.description:
While working on her summer project, Yui from the Sculpture Department hatched an outrageous plan to dethrone Yukishiro, the department's top student...?!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

188641.description:
In the Yamatoba Empire, where two races, humans and night demons, have existed since time immemorial. Iku, whose hair and eyes are as pale as white snow, is mistreated by her family because of her strange, demon-like appearance. She is treated as little more than a servant until the day she is sold to a man for money, a fate she thought impossible to escape from...

One day, however, the next head of a prominent family, Subaru, learns of Iku's secret and offers her a marriage proposal. Though it is a political marriage, the two, both burdened with a damaged past, gradually become attracted to each other...? A love story of destiny unfolds as the hearts of a couple who have never known love melt together!

(Source : Manga Plaza )
synonyms: Kokuyou no Hanayome - Imikirawareta Watashi ga Reikoku Taii ni Aisareru Made

title.english: Bride of the Black Demon: How I Was Detested, Then Loved by The Ruthless Captain
title.native: 黒妖の花嫁～忌み嫌われた私が冷酷大尉に愛されるまで～
title.romaji: Kuro no Hanayome: Imikirawareta Watashi ga Reikoku Taii ni Aisareru Made

188642.description:
On the day he was abandoned by the company he devoted his entire life to, did he return to the moment of his first day at work? Kim Cheol-Su, a new employee with no qualifications who joined Hanyoung Trading, one of the largest conglomerates in Korea. Will he be able to rise to the position of 'CEO' that he had longed for in this life? A modern-day self-made story of success through hard work!

(Source: Naver, translated)
synonyms: リストラ男、回帰して人生逆転を目指す

title.native: DTがドスケベギャルにフェラ抜き搾精生ハメセックスで弄ばれる。
title.romaji: DT ga Dosukebe Gal ni Fella Nuki Sakusei Namahame Sex de Moteasobareru.

188644.description:
"Raijin" - that's the password for transformation! Ryoto, a young man who encounters a mysterious dog, fights in a new era of transformation hero action, wearing the armor of a thunderous man, begins here!

(Source: Cycomi, translated)
synonyms: Raijin: The Electrically Armored Steel Knight

title.native: 電騎装鋼 ライジン

188645.description:
Hatamoto Ikuto, the manager of the local bookstore "Book Forest ", is an otaku who can't resist spending money on his favorite characters in games. Todoroki Miran, the part-time leader, looks up to him but can't understand his obsession with spending on in-game things. When Ikuto claims, "For me, spending money is an investment", Miran teases, "If that's the case, how about you invest in me...?" As the two navigate a cycle of investment and returns, the distance between their hearts begins to shrink.

(Source: Mechacomic, translated)

Note: Originally self published on the mangaka's twitter, the series was later picked up and officially released by Amukomi as of October 8, 2024.
synonyms: A Story About Investing in a Girl at the Workplace

title.romaji: Shokuba no Onnanoko ni Toushisuru Hanashi

188651.description:
"Let me have fun with you, until I break you into little pieces..." What will be the fate of the Villianess, as death hangs the balance? With a gun and betting on her life, will it capture this very "dangerous man's" attention?!

(Source: Coolmic)
synonyms: Glücksspiel mit der Liebe: Die Villainess und der verrückte Mafioso

synonyms: The man in the iron mask

188655.description: Manga adaption of The Count of Monte Cristo by Alexandre Dumas

188657.description:
Aosaki Rei, a second-year high schooler, is a quiet loner who blends into the background at school… but online, she’s a hugely popular cross-dressing influencer! She enjoys the thrill of being famous in the digital world, until one day, a fan asks to meet in person for a makeup lesson. But when she arrives at the meeting spot, she’s stunned to find that her "fan" is actually the most popular and dazzling guy in her class?

(Source: Manga Park, translated)

title.native: 冴えない蒼崎さんは今日も変身する
title.romaji: Saenai Aosaki-san wa Kyou mo Henshin Suru

188658.description: Note: Also includes the 4-part story Shiosai ga Boku no Kokoro ni (潮騒がぼくの心に) and the one shots Koi wa Oshi no Itte! (恋はおしの一手!) and Yurushite Mama! (ゆるしてママ!)
synonyms: Shiosai ga Boku no Kokoro ni

188659.description: Note: Also includes the one-shot Hakuchou no Uta wo Kiite! (白鳥の歌をきいて！)

188660.description:
An emotional human drama set in a Chinese restaurant rumored to have a special seat that shows you the future you want to see the most.

A boy who lost his family in a fire and has lost the will to live—what kind of future will he see from that seat?
synonyms: Ichiban Mitai Mirai wo Misete Kureru Seki

title.native: 1番みたい未来を見せてくれる席
title.romaji: 1-ban Mitai Mirai wo Misete Kureru Seki

188662.description:
Just after entering university, Junya's room caught on fire, leaving him stuck with having to go to another room known for having some shady history. Nervously entering the room, there was a very cute older classmate in the room. They ate delicious food and his new roommate treated him very nicely. Wait? Could this be a good thing?! When he finally goes to sleep, he notices something strange—"This room is full of sensual requests!" as his older classmate comes on to him. When Junya goes to seduce him, his new roommate starts to act very strange...

(Source: Coolmic)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.native: 109号室には、かわいい色乞いが出るらしい。
title.romaji: 109-goushitsu ni wa, Kawaii Irogoi ga Derurashii.

188663.description:
Ryo is in love with his beautiful classmate Kotaro. The two gradually become closer, but one day Ryo hears a rumor about Kotaro's family from a classmate. When Ryo visits Kotaro's house, he sees Kotaro offering his body in a "ritual".

(Source: Hakusensha, translated)

188664.description:
"She feels lonely inside the screen so sometimes she appears in reality to tease you..."

Even if you can write good things by a fluke, doesn't mean it will guarantee your success next time. I am a novelist, but for years I have been writing things I couldn't understand myself. One day, a poltergeist occurrence visit my apartment... Was it "her" tease?

(Source: MANGA.club)

Collection of horror stories.

Included:
1. Sotoba no Saka (卒塔婆の坂) by Misakix Yumisaki
2. Tsui Teru Hito (ツイてる人) by Daisuke Motomi
3. Kunou! Bake Neko o Hashi (苦悩！化け猫おはし) by Neruko
