188667.description:
Tateyuki Chono is devastated when his apartment and extensive collection of insect specimens burns to the ground one evening. But his luck turns around when a chance leads him to meet famed entomologist Izumo Kusanagi. Chono is floored by the kind hospitality of Kusanagi and his beautiful daughter Toko. However, the warm atmosphere of the estate belies a sinister secret. What is the true nature of Dr. Kusanagi’s research? And is Chono already trapped in a deadly web of terror?

(Source: INKR)

title.native: まるなは森の仲間たち

title.romaji: Tenjou Ura ni Dare ka ga Iru

188674.description:
11 platoon members on a DMZ search operation, closed GP… They shouldn't have gone there.

(Source: Kakaopage, translated)

title.native: 花弁にピアス 奴隷たちの謝肉祭
title.romaji: Hanabira ni Pierce Dorei-tachi no Shanikusai

188676.description:
The hugely popular smartphone game "Disney Twisted Wonderland" has become a four-panel comic!
Each episode will focus on an individual character, bringing you a completely original story that depicts the daily lives of Night Raven College students that you can't see in the game!

188677.description: Note: Published in COMIC Kuriberon DUMA 2024-12 Vol.67

title.native: セールスで始まる恋もある
title.romaji: Sales de Hajimaru Koi mo Aru

188678.description:
Ten men and women of various ages and occupations who have never met each other are invited to this isolated island. However, the unidentified host is nowhere to be seen on the island, and soon, at the dinner table, a mysterious voice is heard exposing the crimes of their pasts... and one by one, they are killed just as the lyrics of the eerie nursery rhyme say. This masterpiece by the "Queen of Mystery" has shocked and terrified over 100 million people around the world, and was also voted the best overseas mystery of all time in Japan. Now it has been fully adapted into a comic!

(Source: HayaComic, translated)
synonyms: Agatha Christie: Und dann gab's keines mehr

title.native: そして誰もいなくなった

188679.description:
In the year AD 1127, the Mongols sacked Bianjing, the capital of the Song Dynasty, and took the Emperor and his brother prisoner. The incident became known as the Humiliation of Jingkang. The Song imperial court was forced to flee south to Lingan. Our story begins 17 years later, in the Niujia Village of Lingan Prefecture, where two sworn-brothers, Guo and Yang, reside…

(Source: Books.com.tw, translated)
synonyms: The Legend of the Condor Heroes
La Légende du Héros Chasseur d'Aigles

188680.description:
One guy on the easy path in life gets reincarnated into another world as a girl... with the mark of a criminal?! Having his way with all the pretty girls, and bullying those he didn't like--he was the king of the class. After getting caught under a guy who throws himself off a building, he dies and gets reincarnated as a girl! The magical mark left on him would only go away after cumming 1,000,000 times. Being groped and felt up by outlaws and lowlives... There was no way to fight them off. Every time she cums, the tattoo gets hot, cumming 1,000,000 times is sure to lead to death!

(Source: Coolmic)

Note: Simultaneously released in long-strip and traditional formats, with 9 episodes and 3 chapters respectively.

title.english: Reincarnated as a Toy: A Bully's New Life as a Woman
title.native: 愛玩転生～元いじめっ子の女体化異世界ライフ～
title.romaji: Aigan Tensei: Moto Ijimekko no Jotaika Isekai Life

188681.description:
An AI system accidentally breaks the dimensional barrier between the game world and the real world, causing characters from the game to suddenly appear at Tim Cooper's house. With secret manuals, legendary props, and spirit beasts now in play, the world enters an era of chaos and conquest! Tim doesn't want to get involved in the conflict, but that doesn't stop otherworldly girls from knocking on his door...

(Source: Webnovel)
synonyms: I Became the Target of the Harem in Another World

title.native: 我竟成了异世界后宫的采集对象
title.romaji: Wo Jìng Chengle Yì Shìjie Hougong De Caiji Duixiang

188682.description:
It was the most humiliating era of Chinese history. During those desperate times, there was a group of true heroes, who fought valiantly and gave up their lives, only to be seen as losers and treated with disdain by their own people over the next century. On the 120th anniversary of First Sino-Japanese War, we reject those prejudices, and with this work, commemorate the loyalty and courage of those brave souls.

(Source: Author's Foreword, translated)

188683.description:
Love, money, fame… They all come to Paradise Island chasing different things, but what they find is a nightmare. Oreum joins 15 other participants on a reality dating show, hoping to win prize money that could save her sister’s life. But when a mysterious virus spreads, turning people into flesh-hungry monsters, trust crumbles, terror rises, and Oreum’s only goal becomes making it out alive.

(Source: WEBTOONS)

188684.description:
Former national Taekwondo player Eun-Bi Lee. One day, while in a slump, she quit exercising and was living an ordinary life, she picks up an unidentified black puppy. But... that puppy turned into a human?! What are those ears and tail?! The fantasy cohabitation life of Sam-Wol, a puppy(?) who lost his memory, and Eun-Bi with 999 fighting power!

(Source: Naver, translated)

188686.description:
Sanghyeon has the uncanny ability to absorb powers of magical artifacts—by devouring them. But it took him thirty years to master, and at fifty-five, it’s too late to escape mediocrity. Then one day, he’s miraculously sent back in time to the fateful day he awakened his powers as a monster-hunting player. With a chance for a do-over, he wastes no time using his ability to its full potential, rapidly absorbing incredible powers and rising through the ranks, determined to become the hero he always dreamed of being.

(Source: WEBTOON)

188688.description:
In order to avenge her family, Naeng So-Wol has trained to be a special rank assassin her whole life. But before she completes her last mission, she is thwarted by Baek Woon-Bi, the heir of the most powerful faction in the martial world, who intervenes for his own plans. Despite their initial skirmishes, the two eventually agree to cooperate. It isn't long before their endeavors together stir up long-lost emotions inside So-Wol... and reveal a truth that could change the martial world forever.

(Source: Tapas, edited)

188689.description:
Lee-Hyun, the “Lightning Lord,” is one of the Twelve Apostles, the strongest Hunters in human history. He’s got fame, power, and glory… and he’s given it all up to become a web novelist. But a view from the top is pretty skewed, and Lee-Hyun can’t seem to escape criticism of his writing being “unrealistic.” Luckily, Lee-Hyun's got the perfect solution: he’ll just hide his power, join a low-ranked guild, and farm his team for inspiration! Easy-peasy, right?

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.
synonyms: The Top Ranker's Guide to an Aspiring Writer Life
The SSS-Ranker Who Wrote His Own Legend
今日から英雄やめて作家になります

title.english: Sorry, I'd Like to Save the World, But I Have a Deadline to Meet

188690.description:
Once unmatched, the Cloud God Emperor’s life nears its end as the so-called righteous Eight Great Sacred Lands close in to steal his sect’s secrets. At death’s door, a modern man named Yun Ye awakens in his body with a system that trades justice for lifespan. With six loyal disciples, he punishes the corrupt, reclaims lost treasures, and rebuilds his legacy. A fallen legend rises again, this time, justice will be repaid in full.

(Source: Webnovel)
synonyms: So I Am the Ancestor of the Demonic Path?
So I Am the Ancestor of the Devil?
It Turns Out That I'm the Demonic Ancestor!

title.romaji: Yuanlai Wo Shi Modao Lao Zu?

188691.description:
Zed, a former MMA champion, wakes up in the body of a scrawny prisoner in a fantasy world. Reborn as a member of the once-feared Arahan family, he’s trapped inside a brutal magical internment camp. With no spells at his disposal, Zed trains his body to become a living weapon. He escapes the prison with his only ally Riu, a sharp-witted inmate. Now hunted by both a ruthless warden and a noble house, Zed must fight his way to freedom only with his fists. Can a man with no magic change the rules of a world built on it?

(Source: WEBTOON)
synonyms: The Genius Mage Who Uses His Fists
The Genius Magician Who Uses His Fist

188692.description:
When darkness invades the city, zillions of human warriors come into being, but Aiden isn't one of them. One day, he comes across a mysterious ring and is sent into the Orc Realm where humans are forbidden, by a treaty. He magically survives his execution, lifts the Orc Tribe's sacred hammer, and becomes the tribe leader. Just then, he is transported back to his original reality.

(Source: WebComics)
synonyms: Become the Strongest Hero Through the Cheat System
The Boundless Ring's Champion Unleashed in Another World
Divine Ring Arrives: The Strongest Otherworld

title.english: The Divine Ring Descends: The Strongest Otherworld
title.native: 神戒降临: 最强异世界
title.romaji: Shen Jie Jianglin: Zui Qiang Yi Shijie

188693.description:
Humanity’s last hope just got a second chance… and a mountain of debt. Dohyeok, the champion of humankind, is sent back in time to stop the apocalypse. He then pours his time, money, and soul into preparing for an alien invasion that never comes. Now chased by creditors instead of aliens, Dohyeok turns to game streaming to repay his debt. Follow the ex-hero-turned-streamer as he hacks his way through popular game titles one epic stream at a time.

(Source: WEBTOON)
synonyms: Regressed, But the World Isn’t Ruined
ย้อนเวลา มาทำไม?

title.english: Regressed, but the World Didn’t End

title.native: 教育に煩い義母と優等生な義姉に種付けも勉強の一つと催眠をかけた結果
title.romaji: Kyouiku ni Wazurai Gibo to Yuutousei na Gishi ni Tanetsuke mo Benkyou no Hitotsu to Saimin wo Kaketa Kekka

188697.description: The story is about a young wizard who visits the non-magical world to crack down on his company's unauthorized magic users, and a non-magical girl who end up working together to investigate a magic-related crime.

title.native: 非魔法少女と即席魔法
title.romaji: Hi Mahou Shoujo to Sokuseki Mahou

title.native: 憧れの女上司が深夜のオフィスでオナってるところを見てから始まる秘密の関係。
title.romaji: Akogare no Onna Joushi ga Shinya no Office de Onatteru Tokoro wo Mite kara Hajimaru Himitsu no Kankei.

188699.description:
Wang Dam left his hometown and came to Seoul without a plan. In order to receive settlement funds, he had to be the top student in his entire school! However, the school he was transferring to was a so-called 'hard-working' school filled with the worst students who only bothered him when he studied... Will Wang Dam be able to become the top student in his entire school in the worst environment?

(Source: Naver, translated)

188701.description: The story of a mermaid who wants to be eaten by the man she loves.

title.native: 完堕ちXギャル母娘 ～マジ気持ちイイ！アタシたち、アンタの肉オナホにされちゃう～
title.romaji: Kan'ochi X Gal Oyako: Chou Kimochi Ii! Atashitachi, Anta no Niku Onaho ni Sarechau

188703.description: Hajime Saku is able to see “something” that others cannot. In the midst of a series of street riots, Hajime is called to Tsukiyomi by a Western-dressed man, who tells him that his eye attracts things that are not human. The man, who calls himself Mochizuki, offers him a deal: “I'll protect you and you'll be my decoy”!

title.native: あとさん～暗夜二巣食フ憑影～

188704.description:
"I'll teach you.... good things"

By the cousin whom live next to her house, Akito, is tutoring Yukino, who longs for Akito, who has a sadistic side, and one day he begins to teach her about adult lesson!?

188705.description:
"I knew you got wet." My superior's fingers sweetly went inside me... My body is already feeling hot and sensitive... It feels so good, I'll moan...!

(Source: Coolmic)

Note: Simultaneously released in long-strip and traditional formats, with 12 episodes and 4 chapters respectively.

title.native: あえぎ声は嘘つけない…！～業務命令、上司といちゃラブえっち！
title.romaji: Aegigoe wa Usotsukenai...!: Gyomu Meirei, Joshi to Icharabu Ecchi!

188706.description: Senpai is invited to go to the movies with his adorable kouhai.

188707.description:
One fine day, Se-Ha dies during a bungee jump, only to be reborn in "The Little Mermaid" as Princess Isabelle, a villain fated to be killed by the resentful Little Mermaid. To rewrite her fate, Isabelle seeks a different beau than the prince. This leads her to Grand Duke Waschke, who's the perfect husband material... if not for his curse, which claims the life of his bride on their wedding night. Will Isabelle find a way to break the curse and secure her happy ending? Or will she die a villain?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: 悪役のためのメルヘン

title.english: A Fairy Tale Written by a Villain

synonyms: Melt Me With Your Voice - Lion-kun's Sensitive Ears ♡
你的声音将我融化～狮子君敏感的耳朵♡～

title.native: 君の声で僕を溶かして～ライオン君の敏感なお耳♡～
title.romaji: Kimi no Koe de Boku wo Tokashite: Lion-kun no Binkan na Omimi

188709.description:
Clara had been oppressed for many years by her tyrant sister, Enefia. Even their parents obeyed the sister's wishes, and Clara had no place in the Baron Astraia's household despite it being her home. In the midst of this, Clara's sister's engagement to a prominent nobleman was decided, and Clara finally felt relieved, believing she would be freed from this hell. However, even after the engagement, the sister's unfaithful nature did not change, and fearing the fiancé might discover the inconvenient truth, the parents ordered Clara to monitor her sister. Despite Clara's efforts, her sister became pregnant with another man's child. The engagement was broken off, and the sister quickly eloped somewhere, leaving the Astraia household with a huge debt and angering the influential nobleman. In order to repay her family's debts, Clara was sold to a sadistic noble and faced severe torture, ultimately approaching death.

"If I could do it over again... This time, I will definitely kill you!" When Clara opened her eyes again, time had rewound to the day of her sister's engagement. Revived with strong determination, Clara pushed back against her sister's insidious bullying and ran to change the worst possible future.

(Source: Shueisha, translated)
synonyms: I Will Break Ties With the Harmful Sister

title.native: デビューJKは気が気じゃない
title.romaji: Debut JK wa Ki ga Ki ja Nai

188712.description: Yayoi, a saleswoman in a brand of women's clothing, has a boyfriend really cool, but lately she's a little sad in their couple... When she is transferred to the lingerie department, it's the trigger!

title.native: 潤愛ランジェリー～わたしのこと、飽きちゃった？
title.romaji: Junai Lingerie: Watashi no koto, Akichatta?

188715.description:
Kondo and Takahashi are now in the third year of junior high school. It was their daily routine to play with cats under elevated tracks before going to school. Kondo can spend her time naturally in front of Takahashi, but she is not familiar with the new class yet. In the midst of this, the worst seats were decided to change seats... The daily life of adolescence presented by the spirit of "Thank you for your growth."

(Source: Kurage Bunch, translated)

188717.description: A nail technician doing her best at work.

title.native: 白峰学園のメスブタ理事長

188719.description:
Lin Hao, a seemingly high school student who keeps his actual age a secret, was abducted by an enigmatic ancient god along with another five thousand humans. From that day forward, they embarked on a journey as the ancient god's warriors, traversing through new and extraordinary worlds with the missions of survival, exploration, and relentless self-improvement. As the protagonist, Lin Hao possesses unique talents such as the "Invigorated Man", "Kept Man", and "Game Player". Join him on his journey as he overcomes daunting challenges and witness how he harnesses these powerful talents to become the ultimate warrior of the ancient god.

(Source: Webnovel)

188720.description:
"I'll never let you go." My first kiss with him was a sweet sensation but also left a bitter aftertaste…

(Source: Coolmic)

Note: Simultaneously released in long-strip and traditional formats, with 21 episodes and 7 chapters respectively.

title.native: 臆病な2人の初キスは苦い。
title.romaji: Okubyou na Futari no Hatsu Kiss wa Nigai.

188721.description:
Isn't it normal for a girl to do perverted things after time has been stopped? Even though I can stop time, I still can't gain my composure in front of the person I like.

(Source: Pocket Comics)

Note: Simultaneously released in long-strip and traditional formats, with 18 episodes and 6 chapters respectively.

title.native: 時を止めて、君に、イケナイコト。
title.romaji: Toki wo Tomete Kimi ni Ikenai Koto

188723.description:
Komachi met Akitaka and Fuyutaka when all of them were little. It was then when the twins proclaimed her their servant, and her freedom has been limited ever since. This is the reason why Komachi never had a chance to make a boyfriend. Now, however, her young boss has caught her eye... about which she tells the twins when the three of them are drinking together. This triggers weird reactions in Akitaka and Fuyutaka who start kissing and caressing her, with an intention to make her lose her mind. Komachi's body reacts to their rough touch, while the two are debating which one of them will take her virginity.

(Source: Coolmic)

Note: Simultaneously released in long-strip and traditional formats, with 12 episodes and 6 chapters respectively.

title.english: I'll Have You Before He Does -Intense Love with Peerless Twins
title.native: アイツより先にお前を抱きたい〜絶倫双子のイキすぎ愛
title.romaji: Aitsu Yori Saki ni Omae wo Dakitai: Zetsurin Futago no Ikisugi Ai

188727.description:
Though born into poverty, Xiaolan was content with her simple life caring for her siblings. But out of desperation, her family was forced to make a terrible decision... Sent to the imperial palace as a servant, Xiaolan now spends her days washing laundry and tending to the consorts' needs. She doesn't mind her new lot in life—after all, there's food!—and soon makes friends with another servant, a strange girl named Maomao. Can the two help each other as they find their way in the scheming, status-seeking society of the rear palace?

(Source: Square Enix)

title.native: 薬屋のひとりごと外伝　小蘭回想録
title.romaji: Kusuriya no Hitorigoto Gaiden: Xiaolan Kaisouroku

188728.description:
A legendary martial artist, after countless reincarnations, awakens in the body of Jin-Ho Seok, the neglected bastard of a powerful merchant family. Once downtrodden and suicidal, Jin-Ho transforms into an unstoppable force, stunning his family with unmatched martial arts skill. As his reputation soars, Jin-Ho’s newfound strength sets him on a path to reshape his destiny and claim his place in a world that once cast him aside.

(Source: Tapas)

188729.description:
I am an ordinary college student, and I have a childhood friend who is one year younger than me, whom I've always treated like a little sister. Her problem this time is that “she's gotten fat while preparing for her exams,” so I decided to help her lose weight with some proper exercise…

(Source: Comic Alive Plus, translated)

title.native: ムッチムチな幼馴染がおれンチに筋トレしに来た
title.romaji: Mutchimuchi na Osananajimi ga Ore Nchi ni Sujitore Shi ni Kita

188730.description:
Invest like a pro!

The number of individuals investing in stocks is growing daily. But for every brilliant success story, there are countless failures. It isn't easy for small investors to succeed in the ruthless world of stock trading. Still, it isn't impossible — if you can just think like a quant!

(Source: Manta)

188731.description:
In the operating room, Dr. Jin-Hyeok Lee is flawless—unyielding, brilliant, and untouchable. But outside, he’s a ghost to his family and loved ones. He misses everything, even his mother’s final moments. By the time he understands what he’s lost, it’s too late… until it isn’t. He wakes up 27 years in the past. Now armed with a lifetime of memories, Jin-Hyeok vows to live differently. But peace won’t come easy. Old rivals, new battles, and countless lives await. Scrubs on. Lights up. Scalpel ready. And this time, Primum non nocere.

(Source: WEBTOONS)
synonyms: The Regressed Doctor Just Wanted to Live Quietly
คุณหมอไม่ขอเข้าเวร

title.english: The Regressed Doctor Just Wanted to Live Quietly

188732.description:
Ma Do-Jun is a virgin ghost who wants to transcend into nirvana and part ways with the mortal world forever. The only problem, however, is that the regret of not having lost his virginity before his death is too strong! After spending decades stuck on earth with nowhere to be, he hears a rumor regarding a girl. This girl had sent countless virgin ghosts to nirvana by taking their virginities. Ma Do-Jun decides to pay the girl a visit only to find out she's not such an easy target nor will she cooperate with his mission! Instead, she whips Do-Jun into shape and shows him a world he's never seen before!

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Part of Bomtoon’s and Lezhin’s Saekgwi Danpyeonseon (색귀 단편선) Collection or Dirty Demon Collection in English.
synonyms: [Sex Ghost Anthology] Can Ghosts Be Washed?

188733.description:
Ryoma runs a public bathhouse with his grandfather in a seaside town. One day, during his usual routine of running the bathhouse after school, a boy named Reo appears, claiming to be his father's illegitimate son. A bittersweet yet heart-warming drama unfolds between half brothers in a public bathhouse!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

Note: Winner of the 2026 Next Manga Award in the Web Manga Category.

188735.description:
If love is the ultimate prize, then the perils of courtship are the necessary trials and tribulations one must endure in its pursuit. It is a blessing for the society debutantes of London, then, that Cupid’s arrow should be guided by the dainty hand of Miss Laura Pendleton, granddaughter of Countess Pendleton and the city’s finest matchmaker. When Laura’s self-ascribed duties call her to befriend the stoic and saturnine Mr. Ian Dalton of Whitefield, however, she soon finds that when it comes to the grand contest of love, it may well be every woman for herself…

(Source: WEBTOON)

188736.description:
On the outside, Gwon Chang-Jun might seem like a pious, church-going man, but that is far from reality! He's sleazy, creepy, and a total scumbag! But karma soon comes for him in the form of a swift bash on the head, transporting him to a world of romance fantasy! He's told that the only way home is for him to satisfy the local god, but this guy's desires are quite...unusual. When the church said "thy will be done," this isn't quite what Chang-Jun imagined!

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Part of Lezhin's Erofan Short Story Collection (에~로판 단편선) or the Steamy Collection in english.
synonyms: [Erofan Short Story Collection] Should I just let it be as God wills!?
Shall We Let God Do His Will?

188737.description:
Suddenly, the Demon King has arrived in Kabukicho from the Demon World. By chance, he enters a host club and encounters Yuusha, Kabukicho's No. 1 host, and challenges him to a contest...!? The strongest and most beautiful battle(?) comedy in history has begun...!!

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

188738.description:
Adele, the knight of the grand order, is struck with despair when he witnesses Vayne sharing a secret romance with Marshal Kyle, his superior. Yet, amidst his heartbreak, he finds himself imagining what it would be like to be in love Vayne. As the turmoil deepens, Kyle, now aware of Adele’s true feelings, makes him a forbidden, yet tempting proposal...

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Part of Lezhin's Erofan Short Story Collection (에~로판 단편선) or the Steamy Collection in english.
synonyms: เผลอใจรัก นายอัศวิน

188739.description:
Making huge profits in the stock market, going to prison, telling fortunes, and starting his own public company... Life is a wheel of fortunes for Chase Han.

(Source: Toomics)

188740.description:
Meeting Kuruma brings about a major turning point in Nito's life.

Nito is a solo singer on the brink of his major label debut. One day, when he goes back to get the sheet music for one of his own compositions after forgetting it, he encounters Kuruma, a man playing it without his permission. He intended to complain about the messy arrangement and performance, but for some reason, he was drawn to the sound and started singing along...

A new interpretation of band BL, brought to you by an unconventional guitarist and a misanthropic singer!

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

188741.description:
She's usually a little devil, but in her dreams...
A romantic comedy about the secrets and misunderstandings between kouhai and senpai.

(Source: Dengeki Daioh G, translated)

title.native: 俺にだけ小悪魔な後輩は現実でも可愛いが、夢の中ではもっと可愛い
title.romaji: Ore ni Dake Koakuma na Kouhai wa Genjitsu demo Kawaii ga, Yume no Naka de wa Motto Kawaii

188743.description:
Confessing to my childhood friend Marika was impossible for someone as unpopular as me. So, I did what any desperate boy would do—I wished upon a shooting star! When I woke up, that dream had come true?! I could see a love meter for people, just like in a love simulation game. Once I realized this was real and not a dream I went straight to see Marika. Her love meter was so low it had broken and practically fallen all the way to hell! If she hated me so much why was she so nice?! Is this how she really felt or...?!

(Source: Coolmic)
synonyms: Le Love Meter infernal de Marika

title.native: 茉莉花ちゃんの好感度はぶっ壊れている

188744.description:
Year 20XX. The economy collapsed, and public order worsened. Asahi, who was on the verge of ending his life in a dirty alley, is rescued by a young man who introduces himself as "Rin". Initially, Asahi, who intended to die, lashed out at Rin, but since his true desire to live was exposed from the depths of his heart, he has come to forgive Rin.

He may not be stable, but he doesn't seem deceitful either. While treating him as if he were much younger, Rin, who occasionally wears a surprisingly lonely expression, made Asahi's heart tremble for the first time. That's when he thought he wanted to know more about Rin, no matter what kind of sorrow he carries.

(Source: Shu-Cream, translated)

title.native: ロッカ・バイ・ベイビー

188746.description:
he most terrifying guy and the most popular girl on campus are two people nobody could ever expect to see together. Why are they bonding over a little teddy bear, of all things? It's such a strange sight, but nothing is as strange or horrifying as the secret that ties their fates together!

(source: Manga Planet)

188747.description:
For everyone who has ever had their heart ache from love. A collection of three exquisite short stories.

1. Belladonna no Koibito (ベラドンナの恋人)
2. Ouji-chan no Suki na Hito (王子ちゃんの好きな人)
3. Ningyo Hime (人魚姫)

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

188748.description:
He thoroughly makes love to me, and continues to give me a deep fulfillment that I've not gotten in a long time... I never would have thought that the man in control of me would be a high school student...!

(Source: Coolmic)

Note: Simultaneously released in long-strip and traditional formats, with 45 episodes and 15 chapters respectively.

title.english: My Body Can't Take This Kind of Love!
title.native: 愛されすぎてカラダもたない…！～３０歳干物女が男子校生の嫁になったら～
title.romaji: Aisare Sugite Karada Motanai...!: 30-sai Himono Onna ga Danshi Kousei no Yome ni Nattara

188749.description: A beautiful transfer student, Hitode Rokishima, clad in a jet-black sailor suit, arrives in a classroom where one after another, the dead are "beheaded" by flying ski boards, steel doors in the subway, and crashing traffic lights. The only way to save the cursed high school students is to sacrifice one of them. Is the enigmatic girl friend or foe? Envy and fear, love and hatred are all mixed up in this horror story of school suspense.

title.native: ひとでちゃんに殺される

188750.description:
She suddenly got engaged to her handsome boss at work, and they started living together… But it's a fake engagement！ What will happen to them？ Shizuha is known at her company as a no－nonsense, mature woman who's very serious about her job, but she's actually socially awkward and has no romantic experience. Her boss, Inori Hatsukura, helps her as she's targeted by a stalker and proposes a contract to her： to live together and pretend to be engaged for three months until Inori moves to the US branch of the company. After much deliberation, Shizuha decides to accept. What is in store for the two of them？

(Source: Coolmic)

Note: Simultaneously released in long-strip and traditional formats, with 24 episodes and 12 chapters respectively.

title.english: 90 Days Lovers: Our Engagement Is Fake, but He's Head Over Heels for Me!
title.native: 90日の恋人〜同居契約から始まる愛され生活〜
title.romaji: 90-nichi no Koibito: Doukyo Keiyaku kara Hajimaru Aisare Seikatsu

188751.description:
"Does it feel good? Ok, I'll give you more." He licks up the dripping creamy liquid. Going to melt... --One day, an apartment superintendent named Mana is saved from a predicament by a guy living in apartment 501, whose appearance and personality is a mystery. ...But he looks just like that person...!?? "That reaction makes me want to touch you more." He whispers as their tongues intertwine. "You're turned on?" Being asked in that voice, I'm gonna cum—Who in the world is he...!?

(Source: Coolmic)

Note: Initially released in both long-strip and traditional formats, with 18 episodes and 6 chapters respectively.

title.english: In Apartment 501 Lives a Sex Hero
title.native: 501号室はＨなヒーローが住んでいる
title.romaji: 501 Goshitsu wa Ecchi na Hero ga Sundeiru

188752.description:
"I will embrace you, curse and all...I love every part of you." The hated Shrine Maiden's heart and body are both about to be melted by the hot Imperial Prince.

(Source: Coolmic)

Note: Simultaneously released in long-strip and traditional formats, with 18 episodes and 6 chapters respectively.

title.native: その呪いごと抱いてやる～嫌われ巫女は皇子の寵愛に乱れ濡れる
title.romaji: Sono Noroigoto Daite Yaru: Kiraware Miko wa Ouji no Chouai ni Midare Nureru

188754.description:
"I'll get you the dress you deserve!" Kanade was born into a banking family, but is treated like a servant by her sister due to her being the daughter of their father's previous wife. Just as she wishes to be free, she is forced to marry Yukito, the president of a company that is rumored to be a cold-hearted man... instead of her sister! Without anyone to support her at her wedding, Kanade is the target of ridicule when her sister stains her wedding dress. However, could the man she's marrying be hiding a different side behind his icy exterior? Yukito helps Kanade transform into a beautiful new woman and the scene at the ceremony completely changes...! After a lifetime of being unloved, Kanade's journey is now starting to blossom.

(Source: Coolmic)

title.native: 色めくドレスで花開け～冷徹御曹司は私の運命を変える旦那様～
title.romaji: Iromeku Dress de Hanahirake: Reitetsu Onzoushi wa Watashi no Unmei wo Kaeru Danna-sama

188755.description:
Though he has become more of an adult than me, that "boy" from back then still loves me with all his heart. Can I handle all 15 years of all his pent up love?

(Source: Coolmic)

Note: Simultaneously released in long-strip and traditional formats, with 18 episodes and 6 chapters respectively.)

title.native: 15年分、愛を貪れ～あの日の少年は私に焦がれる騎士長さま
title.romaji: 15-Nenbun, Ai wo Musabore: Ano Hi no Shounen wa Watashi ni Kogareru Kishichou-sama

188756.description:
Qin Chuan transmigrated into a mysterious fantasy world. Not only did he gain a son, Qin Zi, for free, but also a cheatcode - a system that made him stronger every time his son caused trouble. After discovering that Qin Zi was a weakling with immense plot armor, Qin Chuan started on an endless journey to troll his son…

(Source: Webnovel)
synonyms: My Son, Quickly Rely On Your Father's Prestige

title.english: Son, Put Your Father To The Test

188757.description:
To support the family after her father's untimely death, Milvia sacrifices her life force to make gold using the forbidden practice of alchemy. But after being accused of trying to kill her stepsister, Relliana, she is sentenced to death. Just before taking her last breath, Milvia realizes she's been betrayed by her own family and is mysteriously given a second chance at life. Now, with the help of a knight named Deus, she's determined to get revenge, but things are not as simple as they seem...

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Chapter count includes epilogue.
synonyms: How a Time-Limited Villainess Gets Revenge
倒计时恶女的复仇计划
余命わずかな悪女が復讐する方法

188758.description:
She and I.
Secret encounters on the rooftop.
A youthful musical graffiti.

(Source: Sunday Webry, translated)

188759.description:
Laria Rohan spent years branded a failure because she couldn't shapeshift like everyone else. When she finally transforms into a white fox, she's captured by the feared Black Wolf shapeshifter, Zenox Crassium, who mistakes her for an ordinary fox. Unable to return to her human form, Laria spends months as his pet before escaping. Three years later, the crown arranges for Laria to meet a potential suitor, only for her to discover it's none other than Zenox himself. He doesn't recognize her... but how long can she hide the fact that she's the runaway fox he's never stopped searching for?

(Source: WEBTOON)
synonyms: My Kidnapper Is My Arranged Marriage Partner?!

title.native: お見合い相手は誘拐犯!?

188760.description:
Sadie, a young witch, has lost her memories. Since losing them, she's been exploited by the yakuza for her magical abilities. Determined to uncover her past, she sneaks out of their hideout right under the boss's nose, but...

(Source: MANGA Plus)

188761.description:
Despite having access to numerous mistresses, King Faslan, who ascended to the throne at a young age, chose only one woman. Though he continued to love her and her alone, their happiness was fleeting and brief. All that remained was her 'custom' that she left behind—

(Source: MANGA Plus)

188762.description:
Yu-Kyung Han, once a gifted ballerino, had his dreams shattered by an accident. Five years later, his world falls apart once more when his partner, Shi-Yoon, admits to cheating, a pregnancy, and a shotgun engagement. Heartbroken and spiraling, Yu-Kyung turns to risky casual sex and encounters Do-Jin, an old classmate with a faded crush. Do-Jin introduces him to BDSM with the promise of distracting Yu-Kyung from his ex. Can this complicated new connection offer him a new beginning?

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Chapter count includes 3 side stories.

188763.description:
There are people in the world who particularly catch others' attention. Jun Kang, who lived as the 'good model student' while secretly hiding his miserable one-sided love, finds himself entangled with Yohan Go, a classmate he now shares a class with in the second year... What if he had liked Yohan Go instead?

"Jun, how is it? The taste of first love."

(Source: MrBlue)

188764.description: Note: Published in Weekly Shounen Sunday 2023 issue 17.

188765.description:
For Nick Foster, the infamous underachiever, this is his third awakening exam. Rated as a one-star again, he’s the laughingstock until he discovers his skills involve “forbidden spells” and “dark power.” Nick isn’t a dark lord, but these forbidden spells are insanely powerful! Now, with dark power surging through the city, Nick must grow stronger before anyone discovers it’s all coming from him.

(Source: Webnovel)
synonyms: I Really Don't Want to Learn Forbidden Spells
覚醒したら禁術でした

title.english: My Reluctant Journey into Forbidden Spells
title.romaji: Wo Zhen Buxiang Xue Jìn Zhou

188766.description:
The cutting words of Lee Seok-Jun’s first love during his school days left a scar that still follows him into adulthood. His fear of intimacy and emotional distance have turned breakups into a recurring theme in his life. One night, while venting about yet another failed relationship at a bar with friends, Seok-Jun crosses paths with Yae Ji-Hoo—a notorious bar regular with a reputation for living like a gigolo. Enticed by Ji-Hoo’s bold offer of a "crash course in adult technique," Seok-Jun narrowly escapes an awkward situation just in time. But Ji-Hoo’s wounded pride refuses to let the matter rest. When he learns that Seok-Jun works as a swimming instructor, Ji-Hoo begins plotting an elaborate revenge scheme.

(Source: Lezhin US)

188767.description:
South Korea's most popular idol 'GIFT' suddenly became a fool?! The last chance given to the leader 'Park Ha'. Go back to the past and stop the team's downfall. A fool reboot!

(Source: Naver, translated)

188768.description:
In a world where blue snow freezes everything it touches, humanity has long forgotten what warmth feels like. Seonu, a teenage boy with a prosthetic leg, carries the lifeless body of Iseo through the snow-covered wasteland, determined to bring her home one final time. The snow will soon erase his footsteps but not the promise that keeps him moving.

(Source: WEBTOON)

188769.description:
Tadano, who exudes the aura of a "highly capable man," is shockingly bad at his job. Today, he even spilled coffee on the "Ice Emperor" himself—President Hidaka…
Feeling down, Tadano unexpectedly runs into President Hidaka while grocery shopping! A cool and flawless president should be able to handle household chores with ease—
…Or so he thought!?

(Source: Shodensha, translated)

title.native: クールなふたりは見かけによらない
title.romaji: Cool na Futari wa Mikake ni Yoranai

188770.description:
In the shadows of Mt. Bukhan, a lonely tiger spirit discovers the corpse of a man and seizes the chance to live among humans in his body. Dreaming of love but armed with raw instinct, he stumbles through human life until he meets Suhyeon, a quiet young man with a shaman grandmother who sends him to confront the unruly spirit. But when a protective charm breaks, the tiger’s suppressed desires explode, and he becomes fiercely obsessed with making Su-Hyeon his mate—promising to protect him for life, no matter what.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.
synonyms: แหกกฎหัวใจนายเทพเสือ

188771.description:
Riku, a beloved handyman known throughout the town, struggles with crowds due to his sensitive ears. After failing his entrance exams for that very reason, the one who supported him was his high school friend, Sumiharu. Despite being busy running his own business, Riku found comfort in Sumiharu's companionship. However, one day, during an ordinary phone call, Riku unexpectedly felt aroused just from hearing Sumiharu's voice. Confused by this sudden change in his feelings, Riku begins to notice that the physical closeness between him and Sumiharu is steadily increasing. What could this mean for their relationship?

(Source: Frontier Works, translated)

Note: Includes an extra chapter.

188772.description: A One Shot of Hokkaido Gals Are Super Adorable! published in WSJ issue 1 2021

title.english: Hokkaido Gals Are Super Adorable! Special oneshot with color feature
title.native: 道産子ギャルはなまらめんこい 番外編
title.romaji: Dosanko Gal wa Namara Menkoi Bangei-hen

title.native: マイホームを買った漫画家夫婦が、違約金480万円払うハメになった話。
title.romaji: My Home wo Katta Mangaka Fuufu ga, Iyakukin 480 Manen Harau Hame ni Natta Hanashi.

188774.description:
Sol Rock plays the role of support in Black Tiger, an up-and-coming party of prodigies known as the Miracle Children. His party sees him as deadweight and he’s expelled by the leader, but the truth is that he has a special talent that gives him the godlike power to bestow incredibly OP skills and stats upon his companions! Only two members of his party, “Iron Wall” Reen and “Saint of Healing” Julia, realize that Sol is the source of their amazing powers, and they choose to leave with him. With no one holding him back, Sol can finally unleash his true potential, and he decides to use it to create the world’s most powerful party. When Sol is offered five cards, each depicting a monster powerful enough to take on the world on its own, he begins a journey to gather them all to his side and fulfill his dream!

(Source: J-Novel Club)
synonyms: The Boy Who Rules the Monsters

title.english: The Boy Who Ruled the Monsters
title.native: 怪物たちを統べるモノ ～最強の支援特化能力で、気付けば世界最強パーティーに！～
title.romaji: Kaibutsu-tachi wo Suberu Mono: Saikyou no Shien Tokuka Nouryoku de, Kizukeba Sekai Saikyou Pary ni!

188777.description:
My step-brother, who is studying abroad, will make his debut as a singer and be back to Japan! His younger sister, Mizuho, who had loved him secretly for as long as she could remember, was looking forward to seeing him for the first time in a long time. However, her step-brother, whom she finally met, told her that she was "plain." Mizuho decided to make herself beautiful in front of her step-brother who had become super popular. After the makeover, Mizuho went to her brother's first live concert, but she wasn't used to looking like that, and she was tired of the crowds, so she went home first and slept as is. When her brother came home and saw her like that, he suddenly attacked her. "You like me, don't you? If it's you, I don't mind having sex." She could hear her brother whispering in her ear and feal his hot fingertips. She was drowing in pleasure, but... "Do you even know me, Bro? No one has touched me before, but if it's him, I don't care about anything anymore..."

(Source: Mobile Media Research)
synonyms: 大人のキス、お兄ちゃんが教えてくれた。

title.english: My Brother Taught Me How to Kiss Like Adults
title.native: 大人のキス、お兄ちゃんが教えてくれた
title.romaji: Otona no Kiss, Onii-chan ga Oshiete Kureta

188778.description: Young Ryoichi Ishikawa lost his only remaining relative, his father, so the electronics shop they worked so hard to build is now closed. Strange things happen and Ryoichi chooses to transfer to a foreign world as a result. Our protagonist wanted to just explore this second life, but can't just abandon those in need. Ryoichi solves their problems with God-granted skills along ability as a craftsman. Very quickly, Ryoichi's surrounded by a bunch of quirky weirdos that become his friend?! The goofy off-world adventures of this good-natured craftsman begins here!

title.english: A Good-Natured Craftsman Leisurely Travels Through Another World
title.native: お人好し職人のぶらり異世界旅
title.romaji: Ohitoyoshi Shokunin no Burari Isekai Tabi

188779.description:
Spring is in the air, the flowers are blooming…and the freshmen are thirsting. It’s the start of the semester, and everyone’s dreaming of the perfect campus life. But college isn’t all sunshine and cherry blossoms. It’s also packed with scandalous hookups, secret flings, and outrageous rumors that spread faster than midterm anxiety. From the library to the lecture halls, these tantilising tales are being whispered behind every closed dorm door. Want to find out what really goes down on campus?

(Source: Lezhin US)
synonyms: そんなこともあったって話

188780.description:
Iori, a hunter who is sent to another world after saving the wolf cub. In the forest where he arrives, he meets a pair of cute beastman twins and decides to live together. But these twins are super strong!? The wolf cub that was sent with him is also a "divine beast"!?

A fun and fulfilling life in another world begins with Iori, who is kind-hearted but tends to get out of control when it comes to cooking, and the "important things" he has found!

(Source: Alphapolis, translated)

title.native: 拾ったものは大切にしましょう～子狼に気に入られた男の転移物語～
title.romaji: Hirotta Mono wa Taisetsu ni Shimashou: Korou ni Kiniirareta Otoko no Teni Monogatari

188781.description:
Max and Joy may sit just inches apart at work, but they're miles apart in every other way. Max prefers to be a fly on the wall, while Joy is the office's social butterfly. So when Max accidentally sees something on Joy's work laptop he wasn't meant to, he's pulled off the wall and thrown straight into the tangled web of workplace dynamics. Maybe this change is exactly what he needed... or is it?

(Source: WEBTOON)

188782.description:
Zhu Wen, one of the unlucky players, faces an unforgiving system: no second chances, no restarts, and absolutely no hints. Armed with just a matchstick, he must unravel the game’s sinister puzzles to survive. As he ventures deeper, haunted NPCs and treacherous landscapes await, each step more perilous than the last. Will Zhu Wen crack the cryptic codes and outsmart the game, or will he fall victim to the lurking horrors?

(Source: Webnovel)

title.english: You Don’t Decrypt at All, Do You?
title.romaji: Nin Wanquan Bu Jiemi Shi Ma?

188784.description:
One day Nicolas found himself wandering into a party with a beautiful musical performance. There, he's approached by a man named Noel. He asks Nicolas if he enjoys the song, called "For Dahlia," mentioning that it's a song the composer wrote for his beloved wife, a symbol of happiness that pledges eternal and unchanging love. When asked if the song was an appropriate one for a ceremony like today's, Nicolas mutters to Noel that he finds it to be rather sad. Noel is moved by these words, and grabs Nicolas as he turns to leave. In a single night, Noel fell in love with Nicolas. But Nicolas refuses to open his heart, he turns down Noel's advances. However, Noel does not give up and continues to invite Nicolas out. While stubbornly refusing to trust anyone, Nicolas is unable to let go of his faint hope. Gradually, he begins to open his heart to Noel... But what is to become of Nicolas, who inhabits two realities: one centered around Noel's love and the other as a wretched sex slave...

(Source: Coolmic)
synonyms: LOVESONG 性●隷と純愛ふたつの現実を生きる青年の話
LOVESONG Se●rei to Junai Futatsu no Genjitsu wo Ikiru Seinen no Hanashi

title.native: デカチチな女の子はお好きですか?
title.romaji: Dekachichi na Onnanoko wa Osuki desu ka?

188788.description:
Pania Elarona, an average elf with the special ability to see people's status windows, idolizes the infamous lone wolf Naos Shalia. When a new law forbids solo dungeon adventuring, she volunteers to pair up with him. Reluctantly, Naos agrees, but a hidden lust demon curse triggers in the dungeon, trapping him in a passionate haze! Pania checks his status window, and a mission appears saying... he needs to get off?! Can these elves conquer the curse, or will the lust be too strong to overcome?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: จับคู่รัก ฝ่าคำสาปร้าย
エルフの交尾 ～最強ハンターさんの呪いを解くためにHすることにしました❤～

188789.description:
Lanting, a Taoist priest, was trying to exorcise a thousand-year-old female ghost when she inexplicably formed a love-bond with her! Now the girlie ghost hugs and kisses her every day and tells Lanting that she smells nice? What's going on, a Taoist priest is letting a ghost molest her every day?! Aren't Taoists suppose to be above worldly affections? Is it really okay to be so affectionate with a ghost?

Lanting: Why are you running away? Aren’t you coming to bed with me?

Jiang Si: I thought you said that humans and ghosts have separate destinies and can't be together?

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

title.romaji: Nu Gui Xiaojie, Jinzhi Tie Tie!

188790.description: A car and a man speed through the endlessly stretching wasteland.

188791.description:
Defeated by the heroes, the monster Lurio is not left to a cold death, but is reborn as a young girl in a rehabilitation facility!!
Distrustful at first, Lurio gradually warms up to her caretaker, Yukihito.
However, the rehabilitation facility has its own agenda…

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: そしてヒーローと嘘を吐く
title.romaji: Soshite Hero to Uso wo Tsuku

188792.description:
Keito, an author troubled by his inability to sleep, has taken an interest in a man named Furukawa who works for a bedding manufacturer. Though they start out as patrons at the same cafe, they eventually get closer and start spending time together on a personal level. The sociable yet secretive Furukawa keeps Keito on his toes, yet his good looks make it impossible for Keito to stay away... But what will he do when Furukawa proposes cuddling in the same bed as a way to cure his insomnia?!

(Source: Animate International)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.
188792.hashtag: #でき愛  #できれば愛をつづりたい

title.english: I’d Like to Write About Love
title.native: できれば 愛 をつづりたい

synonyms: Around 40 Ossan wa Slow Life no Yume wo Miru ka?

title.native: アラフォーおっさんはスローライフの夢を見るか？
title.romaji: Arafou Ossan wa Slow Life no Yume wo Miru ka?

188794.description:
The RPG “Lost Story” not only allows players to interact with NPCs but also introduces a new system to rank your closeness with them. With this update, the hero discovers that his relationship with Emma, one of the guild receptionists, is maxed out—even though that shouldn’t be possible! Despite being level 99, Emma always worries whenever he leaves, no matter how much he tries to reassure her that he’ll be fine. Meanwhile, he encounters two star-crossed lovers: the inventor Slaki and Iragneff, the avatar of a god. Can he help them be together while also coming to terms with his own feelings for Emma?

(Source: WEBTOON)

188795.description:
“I will never cuckold you!”

A young man reincarnated as a villain character in a game tries to live an honest life to avoid a bad ending, but for some reason he ends up becoming friends with the heroines...!?

“Dungeon Brave Soul” It is a game that drew in many men, and at the same time, it is a game that broke the brains of many men with its sequel's NTR, depression, and bad ending.

All because of the overwhelmingly hated antagonist of “Dunbure 2”――

The young man who was reincarnated as Zenon Baskerville, however, in order to avoid the bad ending according to the scenario of "Dunbure 2", He tries to live honestly...!?

title.native: 悪逆覇道のブレイブソウル

188796.description:
With a pure mind and innocent heart, Xuan Jin-Yu has lived a diligent life as a mother for her daughter Song-Yan. Even her encounter with the vengeful Mr. Spirit, a soul possessing a broken sword, cannot shake her entirely. But when Jin-Yu’s husband sells Song-Yan to make money for gambling, Jin-Yu is forced to work alongside Mr. Spirit to find her daughter. Will Xuan Jin-Yu be able to use martial arts to save the day? Or will the dark thoughts from the malicious spirit consume her mind?

(Source: Tapas, edited)
synonyms: 魔刀仙子〜鮮血の極悪人、田舎娘に憑依する〜

188797.description:
The best cruise in Korea invited the Yongjin Taekwondo team, which has amassed ten million views on YouTube and is growing in popularity, and boarded to perform. But what awaits them after their performance is a ?! There is still a week until the cruise gets to land. On top of the sea, where there is nowhere to go, the cruise turns into a prison where the people are locked up in an instant, and the fight to survive the zombie chase begins!

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)
synonyms: 漂流地獄 〜逃げ場なき船上〜

188799.description:
From the moment Rick first saw Nelly, his future sister-in-law, he was aroused. What would it feel like to unload all over that demure face? The large breasts he glimpsed, though she tried to hide them, drove him crazy. He stayed at the Cavendish estate to have Nelly, and blackmailed her with his brother's secret...

"Come to my room tonight. Or else, you know?"

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

Note: The second story in Daewon's Neungyong Romance Danpyeon (능욕로맨스단편) Collection.
synonyms: [Anthology of Romance and Rape] Nellie's Secret Garden
[Humiliation Romance Short Story] Nelly's Secret Garden

188800.description:
With the death of Earth’s potential Constellation, the Crimson Eye is now bent on consuming the world. Simun Kim--an alchemist out of necessity, due to an inability to use magic--successfully transmuted the Philosopher’s Stone to stop this cosmic threat. But he still failed. As death closes in, the Philosopher’s Stone rewinds time, waking Simun in the past with one last chance to rewrite the end of the world.

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: The Regressed Genius Player's Legendary Weapon Creation
The Mythical Weapon Creation of the Regressed Genius Player

title.english: The Regressed Genius Player's Mythical-Rank Weapon Creation

188801.description: Post-epilogue oneshot commemorating the Live-Action broadcast

title.native: アリスさんちの囲炉裏端 番外編

188802.description:
The Demon Queen, Ragurindo Generufu Korasouda, was a workaholic. When the heroes attacked, her underlings took advantage of the situation to mount a rebellion. Deciding she could take it easy if she were dead, she used the opportunity to successfully fake her death and disappear. Hours later, when she finally arrived in a faraway land, what was waiting for her was... a huge number of furball slimes?

(Source: Hifumi Shobo, translated)

title.native: 元魔王様の南国スローライフ 〜部下に裏切られたので、モフモフ達と楽しくスローライフするのじゃ〜
title.romaji: Moto Maou-sama no Nangoku Slow Life: Buka ni Uragirareta node, Mofumofu-tachi to Tanoshiku Slow Life suru no ja

188806.description:
“Your game ends here.”

Every 100 years, in a competition that will grant them more than one wish, there is only one final winner. The young boy Han Si-Joon jumps into a fierce battle while risking everything to save his family.

(Source: Naver, translated)

title.native: 性悪男とAIのセオリー～自我に目覚めたのにブラック企業に酷使されてるAIが戯れにVTuberデビュー！バズってめんどくせぇことになって人類滅亡の危機!?っつっても僕AIなんで知りませーん～
title.romaji: Shouwaru Otoko to AI no Theory: Jiga ni Mezameta noni Black Kigyou ni Kokushi sareteru AI ga Tawamure ni VTuber Debut! Bazutte Mendokusee Koto ni Natte Jinrui Metsubou no Kiki!? Tsuttemo Boku AI nan de Shirimaseen

title.native: 古代幻視行 姫巫女

188829.description:
So-Hwa is a red fox with white hair, separated from her family and living alone in the mountains. One day, she comes across Do-Hwi, an injured and abandoned wild cat, and decides to take care of him. But little does she know that Do-Hwi is actually a fearsome tiger, reborn after a thousand years of life. Do-Hwi conceals his identity well, but as the years go by, he matures into quite the hunk and grows more and more attached to the beautiful fox. So-Hwa grows suspicious amidst frightening dreams of being chased by a tiger, not to mention making steamy hot love with him, and their relationship is about to take a drastic turn... for better or worse.

(Source: Pocket Comics)
synonyms: The Song Of The Golden Eagle
Das Leben mit der gefährlichen Bestie

188831.description:
Ryu is handsome, top of his class, and popular. Haru is a quiet, unnoticed presence. In class, they have no connection at all—but in secret, they’re in a band together. And not just that—they’ve been secretly sharing kisses in Haru’s home studio. Just as their ambiguous relationship continues, a former bandmate from Haru’s past suddenly appears, stirring things up!?

(Source: Media Soft, translated)

Notes:
- Originally self-published, was then later licensed by Media Soft for commercial release.
- Includes one extra chapter.

title.native: クラスのイケメンと地味キャラがバンド組む話
title.romaji: Class no Ikemen to Jimi Kyara ga Band Kumu Hanashi

title.native: 転校生はTSロリおじさん

188834.description:
This is a story about growing from ignorance to wisdom...
(Source: Pixiv, translated)

188835.description:
When I remember later, I feel embarrassed...

(Source: Pixiv, translated)

title.native: ヤンデレっぽい女の子が握ったおにぎり

188841.description:
Souji Hataki is an ordinary high school boy who has just landed the perfect new part-time job as a housekeeper for the house of Momogusa. What’s so significant about that? It just so happens to be the home of the most beautiful girl in school! Perfect, pretty, and popular, Momogusa-san is amazing at everything she does and now Hataki will have a chance to see her in her element. But, he quickly learns something shocking: Momogusa is incredibly lazy at home! The moment she’s home from school, she seems to transform into a totally different version of herself and even expects to be pampered! Somehow she grows fond of Hataki and even begins to let him pamper her. Could this be the start of some sort of relationship or is Hataki just a glorified manservant?

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title.native: 桃草さんがものぐさすぎる!!

188842.description: Note: Published in COMIC RUDE vol.01

188843.description:
I love you.
and I will always love this ordinary life, as long as you are in it.

Onodera and Yuki find comfort in working together at the same company for years, seeing one another as part of the daily routine - but in life, change is ever-present, unavoidable. Onodera transferring jobs throws off the cordial coworker relationship they've always had... But starts to mold it into something new.

Warm yet somber adult life yuri showcasing Rion-sensei's unique style and mastery of paneling.

(Source: Yuri Hub)

title.native: 隷嬢たちの放課後　テニス部員と図書委員長
title.romaji: Reijou-tachi no Houkago: Tennis Buin to Tosho Iinchou

188845.description:
Sayo was born into the family of Kannagi, a shrine maiden who uses her powerful supernatural powers to please the gods, but her powers are weak and she is persecuted by her stepmother and sister, and eventually sold off to a Shojo in another world. There, Sayo meets the ugly and hated god Hozuki, but what does he look like in Sayo's eyes...?

A cursed god and an exiled girl... their meeting was inevitable! A top-class Taisho-era fantasy filled with romance and doting love!!

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title.native: 火の神さまの掃除人ですが、いつの間にか花嫁として溺愛されています
title.romaji: Hinokami-sama no Soujinin desu ga, Itsunomanika Hanayome toshite Dekiai sareteimasu

188846.description:
A comedian, gone, leaved behind his wife, Kyoko, and his daughter not yet a year old. Determined to hold what remains of his brother's family together, the older brother Shouji moves in with them, under one roof.
But Shouji carries something invisible with him: a mind pulled between two extremes. The restless, frenzied heights of mania, and the slow, suffocating weight of depression.
Eat. Work. Sleep. Wake.
Even the most ordinary rhythms of daily life become a mountain to climb. And yet, the three of them reach toward something worth living for.
A stepfamily story from an author with bipolar disorder.

(Source: Comic Days, translated)

188849.description:
1. Hisonzai Yokkyuu (非存在欲求)
2. Kasoku no Saki (加速の先)
3. Rikai to Murikai (理解と無理解)
4. Taki to Saho (滝と佐保)


Note: Released at COMITIA 131.

188850.description:
Yoon Hee-Woo is blessed with a slim build, a pretty face, and an irresistible charm. There’s just one problem: despite being the toppiest top in the history of tops, everyone insists on treating him like a bottom! His sex life? A tragic comedy of mistaken positions. But one day, fate (or maybe just some shady tech) gifts him a mysterious hypnosis app… Watch out big guys with bigger egos - Yoon Hee-Woo is on the prowl. Bottoms up!

(Source: Lezhin US)
synonyms: แอปสะกดจิตพิชิตใจ

188851.description:
Cover: Ringo Kuroishi

1. Shoujo (少女) [maami]
2. Sad Slave Sisters [Kakogawa Tarou]
3. Goshujin-sama dake no Watashi (ご主人様だけの私) [Rio Kouzuki]
4. Koujin-ke no Ichizoku (荒神家の一族) [Kurenai Yuuki]
