10. Prisoner of Darkness [Riro]

title.native: 黒愛 一夜妻館・淫口乱乳録
title.romaji: Kuro Ai Ichiya Saikan: Inkou Rannyuu-roku

188853.description:
After transmigration, time traveler Chen Yu found himself in a martial-domineering world, where he was deemed by “the will of the world” an illegal intruder and cursed with a state of reverse causality! While others ate to satisfy their hunger, Chen Yu suffered from starvation when he did. But wait, in this dog-eat-dog martial-domineering world, doesn’t it mean that taking a heavy blow can help him increase his Qi Energy and HP?

(Source: Webnovel)

title.native: 禁断病棟～ナースの秘蜜

188855.description:
Raised as brothers in an orphanage, Ba-Woo and Joseph take opposite paths—Joseph becoming a priest and Ba-Woo becoming an underground fighting champion. However, when Joseph awakens as the great demon Lucifer and massacres the residents of their orphanage, their brotherly relationship turns into one fueled by revenge. In order to bring Joseph to justice, Ba-Woo sets off on a relentless pursuit of him and his cult. As threats mount and doubts creep in, can Ba-Woo’s powerful fists and allies overcome Joseph’s overwhelming supernatural powers and influence?

(Source: WEBTOON)

188856.description:
Available on the author's Pixiv Fanbox.

Note: Originally released at Hokkaido COMITIA 7; later re-released at COMITIA 124.

188857.description:
A weak guy wishes to be stronger—and his wish is granted, but with a twist. Instead of raw power, he gains the ability to create clones, doubling his strength with numbers. But there’s an unusual way for him to grow even stronger… and it involves something far more intimate.

(Source: Toomics)

188858.description:
Sumio, an ordinary high school student, suddenly awakens to supernatural powers one morning. As his daily life begins to change, his best friend's reaction remains unchanged... What does being "Special" mean to Sumio? A fresh new take on the SF teenage drama genre from an emerging talent!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title.native: おまえをリコーダーで殴りたい

188861.description:
Compilation of Sci-Fi Yuri short stories.
1. Saiai no Hitosara (最愛の一皿)
2. Kimi yo Mugen no Kawa wo Ugate (君よ無限の河を穿て)
3. Sake no Uo Denmou ni Muragaru (鱖魚群電網 / さけのうおでんもうにむらがる)

Note: Released at COMITIA 127.

title.native: さけのうおでんもうにむらがる
title.romaji: Sake no Uo Denmou ni Muragaru

188862.description:
1. Kouchuu no Ai (甲虫の愛)
2. Itami wa Toki no Ya (痛みは時の矢)
3. Jiga ga Kitarite Fue wo Fuku (自我が来たりて笛を吹く)

Notes:
- Released at COMITIA 128.
- Chapter 3 is a crossover with the mobile game ALTER EGO.

188864.description:
"I want to bring back your past smiles." He found me. The invisible me. But I can't recall his eyes, or his kind hands…

(Source: Coolmic)

title.native: あの日、殺された恋をもう一度。
title.romaji: Ano Hi, Korosareta Koi wo Mou Ichido.

188865.description:
Kawai, an emotional, quirky, and somewhat twisted elementary school girl, accidentally lets her classmate Takenouchi witness one of her most embarrassing moments. But somehow, this awkward incident leads to an unexpected friendship between the two. Watch as these two, far from your typical elementary school kids, engage in lively, heartfelt conversations in this heartwarming comedy!

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title.native: 追放されたおっさん鍛冶師、なぜか伝説の大名工になる ～昔おもちゃの武器を造ってあげた子供たちが全員英雄になっていた～
title.romaji: Tsuihou Sareta Ossan Kajishi, Nazeka Densetsu no Dai Meikou ni Naru: Mukashi Omocha no Buki wo Tsukutteageta Kodomotachi ga Zenin Eiyuu ni Natteita

188867.description:
Princess Alice, who was turned back to her 10-year-old self with the "witch's power" before she died, meets Theodore, a heretic (Nox). He is the most hated and shunned member of the Knights' Order, but for a girl who was killed because of her crimson hair, he is the only person who can share her loneliness! However, contrary to the rumors (of the past), she is intelligent and gets caught up in a battle over the right to inherit the throne...?
"Would you like to become a witch's knight out of self-interest?" "That's a ridiculous invitation, I don't think you're a princess, is it?"
A relife story of a figurehead princess and a lonely knight who finally meet, both of whom have "crimson"!

(Source: TO Books, translated)

title.native: 正式に魔女になった二度目の悪役皇女は、もう二度と大切な者を失わないと心に誓う@COMIC
title.romaji: Seishiki ni Majo ni Natta Nidome no Akuyaku Oujo wa, Mou Futatabi to Taisetsu na Mono wo Ushinawanai to Kokoro ni Chikau @COMIC

synonyms: 새벽의 마녀 레이시는 자유롭게 살고 싶어 ~마왕 토벌을 끝냈으니 느긋하게 가게를 개업합니다~

title.native: 暁の魔女レイシーは自由に生きたい～魔王討伐を終えたので、のんびりお店を開きます～
title.romaji: Akatsuki no Majo Lacey wa Jiyuu ni Ikitai: Maou Toubatsu wo Oeta node, Nonbiri Omise wo Hirakimasu

188869.description:
In a world where declining birthrates are the norm and people no longer show an interest in romance or producing offspring, the government has issued a new directive. Across college campuses around the country, students are to have sex with members of an elite squadron known as the “Copulation Corps” once every 2 months. A new member is joining their ranks today in hopes that she, too, can help society get back on the right track.

(Source: Irodori Comics)

188870.description:
Sakuraba Sakurako is at the entrance ceremony of Neo Mogitori Academy, a school for training young ladies. She tries to enter the school with a dog as her companion, but the teacher stops her and she ends up fighting the dog. Sakurako narrowly wins the battle and meets the boys and girls who will work hard together to become the ultimate ojou-sama.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: やがて英雄になる最強主人公に転生したけど、僕には荷が重かったようです
title.romaji: Yagate Eiyuu ni Naru Saikyou Shujinkou ni Tensei Shita kedo, Boku ni wa Ni ga Omokatta you desu

188872.description:
Although she is just a beginner, Yohan finds out a VRMMO is having a collaboration event with an animated series called "Bachimon". Since she used to love that series as a kid, she decides to start playing the game. And of course, she chooses "summoner" as her occupation! While loving and admiring her long-missed Bachimon, she plays the collab event over and over and over again... And after all of that, she earns the last boss's equipment?! Now that Yohan can use all of the summoning beast's skills for herself, she even makes friends with the boss of her class?! And after bursting onto the scene, this impossibly strong newbie unknowingly starts rising through the ranks!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: お前のような初心者がいるか! 不遇職『召喚師〈サマナー〉』なのにラスボスと言われているそうです
title.romaji: Omae no You na Shoshinsha ga Iru ka! Fuguushoku "Summoner" nanoni Last Boss to Iwareteiru Sou desu

188873.description:
Reincarnated as the Secret Boss!? I’m Going to Fail My Year!
As a hardcore gamer, one day I find myself reincarnated as the secret boss of a game I’ve been playing for years. With the goal of returning to the real world, I aim for the fastest clear possible, but nothing goes as planned!
Where’s the main character!? A mob NPC has somehow become the hero!? And why is the villainess now part of my party!?
A quirky adventure of the strongest secret boss begins—expecting nothing but chaos and unexpected twists!

(Source: BookWalker, translated)

title.native: ゲーム内最強の『裏ボス』に転生したので､主人公の代わりに最速クリアを目指します!
title.romaji: Game-nai Saikyou no "Ura Boss" ni Tensei Shita no de, Shujinkou no Kawarini Saisoku Clear wo Mezashimasu!

188874.description:
Kuruhi, first prince of Gahama Kingdom, is the epitome of a spoiled brat with his arrogant attitude and behavior. After countless misdeeds, he is finally banished from the royal family and reduced to a commoner!
The wandering, mud-covered former prince finds himself at an inn run by Emma, a girl who has a severe obsession with royalty drama. Emma is bewildered by the sudden appearance of her "Oshi", and determined to get him back on his feet, she embarks on a grand project!

(Source: ComicGardo, translated)
synonyms: I Groom A Stray Prince to Be Imperfect.

title.english: I Picked Up a No-Good, Useless Prince
title.native: 断罪されたダメ王子、拾いました。

188875.description:
A legendary god-tier game, "Dungeon Job Hunting Recommendation", aka "DanKatsu", features an unprecedented 1,021 playable job classes and over 400 different endings! The more you play, the stronger you become, unlocking new abilities and rare items.
One dedicated gamer (PN: Zephyrus) finds himself reincarnated as the protagonist of this very game! Overjoyed at the chance to experience it in real life, he immediately enrolls in the Labyrinth Academy—the game's main stage. Armed with his extensive knowledge of the game's mechanics, he aims to obtain the ultimate class: Hero.
Not only that, but he also guides his timid childhood friend toward the Alchemist class, allowing the two of them to breeze through the academy's curriculum and rapidly level up! Powerful jobs, legendary loot, and epic rewards—secured at lightning speed!

(Source: TO Books, translated)
synonyms: Reincarnation in the Game World Dankatsu @Comic: Game Addict Plays "Encouragement for Job Hunting in Dungeons" from a "New Game"
Game Addict Plays "Encouragement for Job Hunting in Dungeons" from a "New Game"

title.native: ゲーム世界転生〈ダン活〉～ゲーマーは【ダンジョン就活のススメ】を〈はじめから〉プレイする～@COMIC
title.romaji: Game Sekai Tensei <Dankatsu>: Gamer wa [Dungeon Shuukatsu no Susume] wo <Hajime kara> Play Suru @COMIC

synonyms: I Should Have Been Reincarnated as a Supporting Role, but Before I Knew it, I Had Become a Legendary Alchemist

title.native: 脇役に転生したはずが、いつの間にか伝説の錬金術師になってた～仲間たちが英雄でも俺は支援職なんだが～
title.romaji: Wakiyaku ni Tensei shita Hazu ga, Itsunomanika Densetsu no Renkinjutsushi ni Natteta: Nakama-tachi ga Eiyuu demo Ore wa Shienshoku Nanda ga

188877.description:
The strongest necromancer in the hero's party was thought to have lost his life in the midst of battle and was abandoned. However, he had not died. He was revived as a lich, the creature strongest in terms of both physical and magical power, and resolved to leave the human race and live on the side of the demon races. The reason was because among the demon races, he could freely research the necromantic arts in a easygoing environment! With Alice as his partner (a beauty, one of six demon generals), the lich immerses himself in his research. Will the lich really be able to live a life of research in peace and quiet without being disturbed by adventurers!?

(Source: Bunkasha, translated)

title.native: 勇者パーティーを追い出された死霊魔術師はリッチになって魔王軍で大好きな研究ライフを送る
title.romaji: Yuusha Party wo Oidasareta Shiryou Majutsushi wa Lich ni Natte Maougun de Daisuki na Kenkyuu Life wo Okuru

188880.description:
An anthology of five short stories written by Teppei Fukushima that deal with darker themes generally regarding romance and sexuality.

1. Amaryllis (アマリリス)
2. Ethan Hanten no Kyoudai wa Kyou mo Nakayoshi (イーサン飯店の兄弟は今日も仲良し)
3. Haru yo Koi (ハルよ来い)
4. Lucia Onzone, Matsu (ルチア・オンゾーネ、待つ)
5. Watashi to Sayuri (私と小百合)
6. Amaryllis [Epilogue] (アマリリス【epilogue】)
synonyms: 福島鉄平短編集 アマリリス

188881.description:
Two boy-band members who can't stand each other are suddenly trending all over social media because of a fan-video! Younger puppy-dog boy X Older cool dude?! The shippers are going feral over this pairing! They've never gotten along ever since their debut, but they're now stuck with each other in a fan-pleasing fake relationship…

(Source: Kuaikan Manhua, translated)

188885.description:
People knelt in prayer and offered up sacrifices on the riverbank.

“We beseech the great Water God for protection…”

But just then, from beneath the water came the voice of a young boy: “Damn it, could you stop sacrificing maidens to me already? I’m really not the Water God!”

(Source: Webnovel)
synonyms: Becoming a God, Starting as Water Monkey
Ascension: From Water Spirit to Deity

title.romaji: Zong Shui Houzi Kaishi Cheng Shen

188886.description:
For four years, Ji-In has been working as an actor in Korea. While on a photo shoot in Bangkok, a man approaches him, and for the first time, Ji-In gives in to his advances. Although the man’s expressions linger in his mind, he returns to Seoul pretending to be unaffected, as he always has. However, an unexpected reunion with the man shakes his calm exterior.

“I can be pushy sometimes. I’m just pretending to be patient because I don’t want you to dislike me.”

As the man’s persistence reveals more than his initial suave demeanor, Ji-In finds himself slowly drawn to him. This is a story about men making imperfect choices, seeking change for themselves and their loved ones, and discovering the best decisions amidst life's many options.

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

188887.description:
After his parents passed away in an accident during his school days, Yoon Seo-Ho borrowed money from a loan shark and got into a big debt. He is currently paying off his debt by helping with fraudulent gambling at an illegal casino run by the loan shark Jang Sa-Jang. A high school classmate who happened to see Seo-Ho like that proposes a plan to free Seo-Ho by beating Jang Sa-Jang at gambling...

(Source: Mr. Blue, translated)

188888.description:
When I-Ru starts college, she unexpectedly meets Ha-Im, a guy who looks just like Ha-Yul—the one who used to torment her as a child. She feels uneasy around him yet finds herself drawn to his seemingly perfect nature. Is it really okay for her to open up her heart to him?

(Source: WEBTOON)

title.english: Starting Over With the Dead You

188891.description:
The blood-stained truth can’t be hidden…

Hiromu Morinaga has lived through the unspeakable. Traumatized since witnessing the murder of his parents, the high school student is cursed with a haunting ability:

He can now see the terrified faces of victims on the backs of the murderers he encounters. When transfer student Yuzuka Kohaku arrives, a staggering number of ghosts cling to her back. This mysterious girl may be an unstoppable killer!

(Source: Alien Books)

188893.description:
In a world where names mysteriously appear on skin, pianist Do-Hwa "Eden" Ye-On finds Tristan Locke's name etched on his body. But after tracking the reclusive nobleman to a forest manor, Eden learns his name isn’t on Tristan. As his life ebbs without Tristan's touch, Eden clings to a man who stubbornly rejects him.

(Source: Manta)

188895.description:
A child shows up claiming to be Duke Maynard’s long-lost daughter, but he’s skeptical. However, Lilian came with proof, her best friend Swan’s locket, stolen from the orphanage’s headmaster’s office. After Swan died from an illness, Lilian heard the headmaster talking about Swan’s origins and his ruined plans to use her to gain the duke’s favor. She decides to stop living as an extra and live the life Swan was supposed to have.

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.
synonyms: The Extra Decided to Be Fake

title.english: The Extra Decided to Fake It

188897.description:
Hwan Woon-Ryong and Beom Pung-Ho have spent their entire lives locked in a fierce rivalry. As the heirs to the world’s two most powerful crime syndicates, their hatred runs deep—and so does their competition. But just as they’re poised to seize the biggest opportunity of their careers, fate throws them a curveball: a toddler named Hwan Beom-Hae, who, according to advanced DNA testing, is the biological child of both of them. Caught between disbelief and chaos, the two enemies are presented with an absurd yet high-stakes mission: raise Beom-Hae together, lovingly and responsibly. The reward? Exclusive construction rights to the largest global development project in history, sanctioned by the United Nations itself. But co-parenting isn’t exactly easy when you’d rather strangle your partner than share snack time and diaper duty. As Beom-Hae’s giggles and tantrums slowly chip away at their walls, Woon-Ryong and Pung-Ho must navigate tantrums, toys, and a growing sense of responsibility—not to mention some unexpected feelings. Can two lifelong enemies become the world’s most unlikely dream team dads? Or will their stubborn pride and unresolved tension bring everything crashing down?

Enemies-to-daddies has never looked this chaotic—or this heartwarming.

(Source: Lezhin US, edited)

title.native: シルク・フロス・ボート

188900.description:
Although she loves animals, high school girl Mossishi Hanae is not very good at interacting with primates (=humans). Her goal in high school is to make three friends! 
In the spring of her first year of high school, Hanae is invited by her classmate Komidori to try out basketball. She has trouble talking to people and behaves suspiciously, but her first team sport is full of excitement! 
You'll want to cheer her on after reading this! The girls' basketball youth graffiti is about to begin!

(Source: Pocket Magazine, translated)

title.native: ハナバス　苔石花江のバスケ論
title.romaji: Hana Basu: Kokeishi Hanae no Basuke Ron

188901.description:
It's been three years since Yeong-In and Seong-Hyeok parted ways. So why is Seong-Hyeok approaching her now -- gentler, and more intense than ever? Will their reunion end differently than before? Can they fill the emptiness in each other's hearts?

(Source: WEBTOON)

188902.description:
Shi-Hu Lee has logged 20,000 hours playing Let's Kill the Demon Lord! for the past 5 years. But when the game takes a turn he doesn't like, Shi-Hu cancels his pre-order of the DLC in anger, only to find himself sucked into the game! Now in the body of Julian Kreipart Prason, the villain, he has to play the part perfectly to survive the many enemies around him while unable to use the moonlight blade, Julian's signature ability. Under the watchful eye of Eileen, the genius gold mage, and his family members who want him gone, can Julian make it?

(Source: WEBTOON)

188903.description: Note: Also contains Hanakanmuri no Omoide (花かんむりのおもいで)
synonyms: 花かんむりのおもいで

188904.description:
The miraculous woman who saved France

Some 600 years ago, England and France were engaged in a long war for territory and the throne, which lasted almost 100 years. The French were being driven out of their territories by the British, who had a powerful army at their disposal, and were on the verge of extinction. France was saved by a 17-year-old girl.

Born and raised in a small French village, Joan of Arc one day heard the voice of God, took up the sword and led an army against the British. This is the story of the exploits and tragedy of a young girl who is still loved today as a heroine who saved France!
synonyms: ジャンヌ・ダルク (小学館版学習まんが人物館)

188905.description:
Jintarou, a bartender who recently broke up with his girlfriend, buys a house, determined to live alone for the rest of his life. However, upon moving in, he discovers that a young man and a little girl have taken up residence there without permission. The intruders? Susumu, a daycare worker who was thrown out by his partner with nowhere else to go, and Hina, a foster child in his care.

Desperate not to be separated from Hina, Susumu pleads with teary eyes, while Hina gazes at Jintarou with innocent curiosity. Swayed by their situation, Jintarou agrees to let them stay—for three months, at most. But then, Hina mistakenly assumes that Jintarou is her new dad—which means she thinks he and Susumu are a couple! Suddenly, Jintarou finds himself wrapped up in a pseudo-family situation, flustered by the unexpected closeness with a man ten years younger. And yet, the one who started all this—Susumu—seems to be having way too much fun…

(Source: Shinkosha, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.native: 家を買った。3LDK、子供と大人つきで。
title.romaji: Ie wo Katta. 3LDK, Kodomo to Otona Tsuki de.

188906.description:
Meng Nan, a man who had been single all his life, accidentally died in a car accident and traveled to a different world where everyone pursued the road of cultivation, and all men were guaranteed a wife. He thought he would live a happy life. But unfortunately, striving to be a great cultivator turned out to be a dead end for him!

(Source: Webnovel)
synonyms: Immortal Cultivation Is a Dead End

title.english: I'll Never Be a Greater Cultivator

188907.description: The Duchy of Normandy, located in western France, went on to conquer England. Was the man who laid the foundations, the Viking Rollo, a weakling and a whiner? A whole new interpretation of Viking warfare and life!

188908.description:
In the cutthroat world of game development, genius creator Ko Sehee’s life is upended when her junior, Choi Yuri, betrays her, stealing Sehee’s game “Land of Destiny” and relegating her to ghostwriter. But fate has a twist; a fatal accident plunges them into the very game world Sehee crafted. Now, reborn as the diabolical Princess Violeta, she must navigate treacherous waters where she is the villainess, and her nemesis is the beloved heroine. Who will triumph when the creator battles her usurper in a world of their own making?

(Source: Tappytoon)
synonyms: 악역 황녀는 배드엔딩을 용서할 수 없다
องค์หญิงตัวร้าย ขอไม่ทนกับแบดเอนดิ้ง
Die böse Prinzessin kann ein schlechtes Ende nicht verzeihen
Công Chúa Phản Diện Không Thể Chấp Nhận Kết Thúc Bi Thảm

title.english: The Villainous Princess Won't Tolerate a Bad Ending
title.native: 悪役皇女はバッドエンドを許さない
title.romaji: Akuyaku Koujo wa Bad End wo Yurusanai

188909.description:
At an age when everything is uncertain but exciting, a group of university students find themselves dealing with the ups and downs of life, love, and friendship. Popular freshman Yoo-Tae is learning how to take his first steps into romance, while shy senior So-Min recovers her confidence after her failed first love. Meanwhile, campus beauty Hye-Ri just wants to avoid being the target of rumors when cool and confident Hwa-Woon enters her life. Can they all find love amidst the turbulence of youth?

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Chapter count includes prologue and 3 side story chapters.

188910.description: This is a story about student Lee Geung-ha's first year of high school, when he befriends a student named Han Kang and gets to know his friends, Hyeon-min and Jeong-eon.

188911.description:
Who would want to become the Demon King?!'
In this world, social status is defined by supernatural abilities called [Blessings] bestowed by god. Born as the daughter to a ducal family, [Sheena] was someone that would've had a high status, but... for some reason, she was born without a [Blessing] and was oppressed her entire life.
She hated the world... She hated the humans... And in the midst of her despair, she was granted a [Blessing]ーTo become the [Demon King]. Trample on this world, and all of humanity.

(Source: Hyke Comic, translated)

title.native: 無才の令嬢 ジョブ【魔王】で蹂躙する
title.romaji: Musai no Reijou Jobu [Maou] de Juurin Suru

188912.description:
Include 4 short stories:

1. Jeogwoljeongi Sirijeu (적월전기 시리즈)
2. Piribuneun Sanai (피리부는 사나이)
3. Mereuhen, Baekseolgongjuui Gyemoe Gwanhan (<메르헨, 백설공주의 계모에 관한)
4. Jeogwoljeongi (적월전기)
synonyms: Mereuhen, Baekseolgongjuui Gyemoe Gwanhan (<메르헨, 백설공주의 계모에 관한)

188914.description:
One day, Ryouji (26), a hopeless and heartbroken salaryman, met with a goddess on the side on the road and was turned into a boy and sent to another world.
To his surprise, that world was filled with the stereotypes of the online light novels he loved !
Having used his experience to make precise requests to the goddess, he made full use of his cheat-level powers and soon became a master of both swords and magic.
After that, he teamed up with a receptionist and an adventurer he met at the guild, and started enjoying his life to the fullest.
He felt as though he had become the protagonist of his very own tale !

Strongest x Harem x Great adventure : the most exciting combination !
synonyms: The Different World Brims Over With Happiness Template.

title.native: 異世界は幸せ〈テンプレ〉に満ち溢れている@COMIC
title.romaji: Isekai wa Template ni Michiafurete Iru@COMIC

188915.description: Note: Originally released at J.GARDEN 54, was then licensed by Kaiohsha for digital release.

synonyms: The False Saintess Embraced by Her First Love, the Count
Nise Seijo wa Hatsukoi no Hakushaku-sama ni Dakareru

title.native: 偽聖女は初恋の伯爵様に抱かれる
title.romaji: Nise Seijo wa Hatsukoi no Hakushaku-sama ni Idakareru

188917.description:
The "Temporal Maiden" who possesses the power to control time, found herself in the midst of battle. Using her ability to turn back time whenever she is struck down, she and Zennosuke continue their path toward unifying the nation. What awaits these two beyond this time-transcending journey...?!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

synonyms: A Man Who Wants to Die

188919.description:
Shin is a high school girl who quietly uploads her own original music. Kako is a popular Vtuber. The two meet by chance through music, and are now pushing forward to form a band with the goal of performing at a major festival!

(Source: Comic Days, translated)

188920.description: Kang Yoo-jin is a nerdy girl who doesn't believe in falling in love at first sight. But after seeing Jae-young everything changes. The moment he sees Jae-young, who is a good dancer and handsome, Yoo-jin falls in love at first sight.

188921.description:
Include 3 short stories:

1. Bungu (붕우)
2. Mabeopsaui Hwajangsil (마법사의 화장실) - A Helmut spin-off
3. Peter Pan (피터팬)

188922.description:
Levin, a young man who was supposed to summon a sacred beast in a grand ritual, ended up calling forth a tiny lizard instead. Furious, the king exiled him from the kingdom.
Guided by the lizard, Levin soon encounters a colossal dragon that carries an entire continent on its back!? As it turns out, this little lizard is actually a pure white Divine Dragon, and the vast continent on its back is her homeland.
At the dragon’s request, Levin takes on the task of developing the desolate Dragon Continent and restoring the lost capital of the Divine Dragon Clan. From building his dream home with mysterious magical tools to being healed by adorable sacred beasts, Levin embarks on a thrilling sky-high adventure, soaring freely between the heavens and the earth!

(Source: Alphapolis, translated)

title.native: トカゲ（本当は神竜）を召喚した聖獣使い、竜の背中で開拓ライフ
title.romaji: Tokage (Hontou wa Shinryuu) wo Shoukan shita Seijuutsukai, Ryuu no Senaka de Kaitaku Life

188923.description:
The most talented girl in the kingdom, Roselia, is a scholar, fighter, and the apple of everyone's eye. Today happens to be the day of marriage to a childhood friend and now lover, Robert, the head of a ducal family. Everyone was congratulatory and enjoying the wedding, until...Robert's cute little sister Margaret was brought into the ceremony in tatters! Margaret was attending the Royal Academy and engaged to the prince. But he broke the engagement accusing her of a crime that was never committed, and ruthlessly beat her! Roselia is now furious at their disgusting treatment of Margaret, who did everything to clean up the prince's messes! But is Roselia really going to confront this corrupt royal court head on?!

(Source: AlphaPolis)

title.english: I Heard My Lovely Sister-In-Law's Engagement Was Broken So I'm Going to Show Them My 'Thanks!'
title.native: 可愛い義妹が婚約破棄されたらしいので、今から「御礼」に参ります。
title.romaji: Kawaii Gimai ga Konyaku Hakisareta Rashii node, Ima Kara "Orei" ni Mairimasu.

188924.description:
Holy maidens protect the world from "Impurities," monsters born from negative emotions in people.
Rena Retalie trains hard every day to become a holy maiden, but her powers are weak.
She feels like a failure, and now that her training is completed, she's been dispatched to the boonies.
Her family is so disappointed in her, they don't even care about her anymore...
Rena feels all alone until one day, she meets the knight-to-be Yulie who's also at the bottom of his class.
He volunteers to be her personal knight, saving her from having to team up with a total stranger.
Both nervous and excited, the two head off on their journey, but things are harder than they thought they'd be...!!
Keep reading for a fantasy that will show you that a tight bond between people might even change the fate of the world!!

(Source: Renta)

title.english: The Saint Of Connection Learns To Believe -How A Holy Maiden With No Attribute Moved To A Small Town In The Boonies-
title.native: 絆の聖女は信じたい～無個性の聖女は辺境の街から成り上がる～
title.romaji: Kizuna no Seijou wa Shinjitai: Mukosei no Seijo wa Henkyou no Machi kara Nariagaru

188925.description:
"Beatrice used her family's influence to impose herself as my fiance. It's not what I wanted." Beatrice is the daughter of an influential Duke in the Kingdom, and has just overheard some of the girls saying that her intended, Prince Ernest, said those exact words. Beatrice has been despised by others in the academy for her relationship with the popular Prince Ernest but is determined to turn that around and live the way she wants to live! "I've been so occupied with trying to please Prince Ernest, I've never taken the time to get to know those around me. What have I been doing all this time?" However, when she starts to get to make some friends, talk to some handsome gentlemen, and finally enjoy her life at the academy... her salty fiance seems to become more and more assertive...!

(Source: MangaPlaza)

title.english: After Giving Up on Improving Our Relationship and Distancing Myself, My Salty Fiancé Began to Pester Me
title.native: 関係改善をあきらめて距離をおいたら、塩対応だった婚約者が絡んでくるようになりました
title.romaji: Kankei Kaizen wo Akiramete Kyori wo Oitara, Shiotaiou datta Konyakusha ga Karandekuru You ni Narimashita

188926.description:
To protect her dual job, Ha-ru finds herself having to go out with Woo-hyeon, whom she's already dumped four times. He's handsome, rich, and works at the same company as her. This encounter will revive memories of a past that only he seems to know.

(Source: Naver, translated)

188927.description:
Hae-Bum Shin and Ryu-Jin Jung have both suffered devastating losses at the hands of a corrupt government. Despite this, they find themselves on opposite sides of the coin—one as leader of the Disciplinary Training Corps and the other as a member of an anti-government organization. Now, revenge will require them to set aside their differences.

(Source: Manta)

188929.description:
Princess Anatrisha is only a year old, but her life is already far too complicated. Her father, the emperor, is cold and distant, and her mother is nowhere to be seen. Her older brother, meanwhile, is bullied by other nobles. Luckily, Anatrisha was an S-class hunter in her past life and is set on using her skills and magic to protect her loved ones. Can this little princess defend her right to the throne and bring her family closer together? Or will it be game over for this S-class baby?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: The S-Class Little Princess Is Too Strong
最強S級赤ちゃん皇女様
องค์หญิงตัวน้อยระดับ S แกร่งเกินต้าน

title.english: The S-Class Baby Princess Is Too Powerful

188930.description:
Feared by name alone, Shin Juhyeok never expected his toughest challenge to be... raising a kid? After rescuing a young hybrid named Lee Hae-on from an accident, Juhyeok planned to keep him around just until he recovered. But the once-scrawny stray grows up—fast—and now towers over his reluctant guardian, refusing to leave his side. Juhyeok can handle gangs and thugs, but nothing could prepare him for this: Hae-on’s first heat. Sweet, clingy, and completely unaware of personal space, Hae-on’s affection is anything but subtle. Raising a hybrid was never part of the plan—but neither was falling for one.

(Source: Lezhin US)

188931.description:
A heart-fluttering romantic comedy about a young actor and a shy manga artist.

(Source: Shodensha, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.native: 推しつ推されつ恋になる

188932.description: Based on a fictional anime from the ChäoS;HEAd universe, starring the magical girl Seira Orgel as the heroine who fights aliens, along with fellow magical girl Erin-fray Orgel (her little sister) and the bounty hunter Sedna Février (her romantic rival).

title.native: ブラッドチューン The NOVELIZATION

188934.description:
A story of a girl and boy who responds with a template.

(Source: Jump Rookie, translated)

188936.description:
One day, an ordinary office worker bought "him". He doesn't talk unless it's absolutely necessary. The man takes him home, dresses him up, jogs with him, and sometimes plays with his body. Who is this silent, obedient young man? And what is the relationship between the two of them...?

(Source: Fusion Product, translated)

188937.description:
My pet dog, who is like my child, turns out to be the heir to a wealthy family?

It's been a year since he adopted Janggun, who was abandoned. But this special guy, well, not only became a family to Do-Hun, who was lonely, but he also brought him a fateful love called 'Lee Chae-Young'. However, Chae-Young was definitely not an easy target. Just as their love is about to begin, a second generation chaebol suddenly appears and says he wants to take Janggun away. And Janggun's surprising secret is revealed. Will Do-Hun be able to protect both his love and his family?

(Source: Naver, translated)

Note: Includes six extra chapters.

188938.description:
When work gets her down, overwhelmed office worker Chikage turns to her one and only pick-me-up: her favorite pop star, Satoi. She'd always admired her fave from afar as one of his countless fans, but who would have thought he was actually her neighbor?! And just what will happen when an unexpected series of mishaps leads to the two of them sharing a kiss...?

(Source: MangaPlaza)

title.english: I Won't Fall in Love With My Favorite Pop Star (Probably)
title.native: 推しとは恋に落ちません。(たぶん)
title.romaji: Oshi to wa Koi ni Ochimasen. (Tabun)

188939.description:
The last thing a powerful attorney like Jin Do-Ha wants to do on the weekends is fill in for his sister as a housekeeper. It doesn't help that his client, Yi Won-Yi, always finishes the chores for him. Won-Yi, on the other hand, is just trying to live her best life as far away from her messy family as possible. At the law firm where she works, she's known for being cold and distant, but somehow Do-Ha never sees that side of her. Could her rare show of openness have to do with her feelings for him?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: おじさん, この気持ちは何？

188940.description:
After his career as a pro baseball coach ends in disgrace, Jung Min-Yong comes to Dongcheon High School to whip the baseball team into shape. With his no-nonsense teaching style, the players are pushed to their limits, and when a gifted newbie is recruited to the team, the existing players are forced to face just how much they still have to learn. With Coach Jung laying down one reality check after another, will the players call it quits? Or will it be enough motivation to let their gifts shine?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: ギフト〜才能が見える監督〜

188942.description:
A snowman girl with a human soul, Seol-Ha! Because her body melts when it heats up, she has been in love with her first love for 100 years. There is only one way Sublingual can become a human. To achieve love!? However, unlike the previous life, which was affectionate Lee Ram doesn't know Seol-Ha's heart... Even Woo-Jo, the God of work, who bickered every day shows a different attitude than before. Will Seol-Ha be able to safely achieve love?

(Source: Kakao Webtoon, translated)
synonyms: A Girl in Her Declining Days
ヤブヌマ　侵食されゆく妻の蜜肌
ヤブヌマ２　他人棒に啼かされる君が愛しくて

188945.description:
A "best friend" I only know online changes my boring, gray days!

Note: Includes two extra chapters.

188946.description:
The vicious cycle of the ouroboros.

Life at school is bleak for outcast Hyeon. But one day, she receives a letter from Jeong, her dear old friend from middle school. Filled with nostalgia and excitement, Hyeon begins reading the letter... only to discover that their time together was a nightmare for Jeong. Where did it all go wrong?

(Source: Manta, edited)

188947.description: Note: Published in Weekly Young Jump 2025 No.9.

title.native: ヒトヅマカリ　―人妻借り―

188949.description:
The bond of family can be a star that guides us in the night, or a chain that drags us down. For aspiring hunter Seung-Hyeon Gi, both are true. He dreams of becoming a legendary hunter like his father, despite his bitterness at his family’s preoccupation with his comatose sister, So-Hyeon. Everything changes when So-Hyeon suddenly regains consciousness and reveals herself as a ‘Homecomer’, possessing powerful abilities from transmigrating to another world while comatose. Seung-Hyeon realizes that if he wants to protect his sister, he'll need to grow stronger, and there’s no better place than the Seong-Han Academy for the Gifted…

(Source: WEBTOON)
synonyms: The Island Where Stars and Chains Rise

188952.description:
Office lady senpai / kouhai yuri.

A serious and very responsible senpai office lady gets stuck working late all alone on Christmas. Her kouhai–who is so bold you wouldn't think she's a kouhai–pays her a visit... and that's where the story begins.

(Source: Booth, translated)
synonyms: Yesterday's Enemy Is Still an Enemy Today

title.romaji: Kinou no Teki wa Kyou mo Teki

188953.description:
Sayo was born to be the next protector of her village, but her lack of spiritual powers earned her the nickname "worthless shrine maiden." One night, she is attacked by yokai when the demon god Akatsuki, who is worshiped by the village, comes to her rescue. Nanase, her younger sister who became the shrine maiden in her place, hears of this and demands that Sayo be sacrificed as the "Bride of the Demon God." The sacrificial ceremony begins, and Sayo, dressed in the bridal kimono, makes a desperate attempt to escape when in her moment of need, a familiar figure appears...

(Source: MangaPlaza)

title.english: A Worthless Shrine Maiden and The Demon God Who Loves Her
title.native: 能なし巫女は、鬼神さまに愛される
title.romaji: Nounashi Miko wa, Kishin-sama ni Aisareru

188954.description:
He ended up in another world with a mythical tree that bears countless magical fruits. Those fruits will bring him many kinds of magical objects and even gods and demons. In that bizarre and scary world, he will lead the human race to survive and climb to the pinnacle of his life.

(Source: Webnovel)

188955.description:
After a bizarre car accident, Yun Xinghe wakes up to find himself in a perilous world. To his shock, a beautiful demon starts doing all sorts of embarrassing things to him and even claims she has to take responsibility for him. "Hey… what are you saying!? I’m a gentleman! Wait, what’s with this unlimited job changing? Where’s the promised harem of beauties?!"

(Source: Webnovel)

title.english: Unlimited Profession Switching: I Can Summon Max Level Goddesses
title.native: 无限转职：我能召唤满级女神
title.romaji: Wuxian Zhuan Zhi: Wo Neng Zhaohuan Man Ji Nushen

188957.description:
A girl came to Tokyo alone for an open campus visit. There, she unexpectedly ends up sightseeing in Tokyo with two handsome guys!? At the end of this dreamlike day, what kind of scenery awaits her?

Published in Bessatsu Margaret issue 4/2025.

title.native: 東京ナイトランデブー

188958.description:
Tsukasa, a high school student with a rough personality, suddenly finds herself face-to-face with Maizono-kun, who has just made a sudden exit from the entertainment industry.

(Source: Margaret, translated)
188958.hashtag: #今日からふつうの舞園くん

title.native: 今日からふつうの舞園くん

188959.description:
Reborn into a novel, 5-year-old Mariette has spent her life on the run with her witch mom Yurie, who is desperate to save her daughter from the imperial temple's relentless witch hunt. But when Yurie finally dies from the mana that has overtaken her body, Mariette must fulfill a promise to watch over her new dad, the strong and cool Duke Descartes, who is destined by the story to be a slave of the temple. With the help of her witch protector Koon, can Mariette awaken her powers and save her dad?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: おたがい初めてなんです

title.english: The Little Witch and Her Dad

188960.description:
Chu Ran, known as the "heartbreak consoler," mends broken hearts by dealing with scumbag boyfriends. However, when these scoundrels retaliate by forcing him to be with ladyboys, it unwittingly unleashes a cosmic force—the Sword Immortal System. Suddenly, he finds himself transported to a realm of feminist immortality. The Mount Yao Sect becomes his training ground, a place where he must cultivate to ascend as an immortal. Armed with scientific knowledge and futuristic weaponry bestowed by the system, Chu Ran embarks on an extraordinary adventure where women reign supreme.

(Source: Webnovel)

title.english: Liberated Sword Immortal In Feminist Realm
title.romaji: Ben Jian Xian Juebu Wei Nu

title.native: 彼氏持ちの姪は信じてた伯父に犯される
title.romaji: Kareshi Mochi no Mei wa Shinjiteta Oji ni Okasareru

188963.description:
After getting caught in the act brings their first time together screeching to a halt, Atsushi and Michiru’s relationship is left in ruins—until, by sheer coincidence, they reunite during the summer of their high school entrance exams. Michiru, still wanting nothing more than to forget it ever happened, turns and runs, but Atsushi stops him in his tracks with an all-too-familiar line…

In spite of himself, Michiru finds all his walls being gradually broken down by Atsushi’s charm, though he still can’t escape the heartache he feels from their shared trauma. But even when he stands his ground in wanting to stay separate, Atsushi’s just as set on not letting him go…

(Source: Yen Press)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.native: サマー・ボーイ・ブルー

188964.description:
Fujinoki, an ordinary office worker, finds unexpected joy in the irregular calls from his elementary school classmate, Akaiwa. After 20 years without seeing each other, Fujinoki has no clue about Akaiwa's whereabouts or occupation. However, their peculiar phone-only friendship takes an unexpected turn!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

Note: Published in Afternoon May 2018 issue.
synonyms: The One Thing I Don’t Know About You
The Secret You Kept From Me

title.native: たったひとつのことしか知らない
title.romaji: Tatta Hitotsu no Koto shika Shiranai

188965.description: Note: Includes two one-shots: "Sensei wa Matanai XXnist" (先生はマタない××ニスト, The Teacher Is a Selfish Ass Enthusiast) and "Sensei wa Matenai XXnist: Bangai-hen" (先生はマない××ニスト 番外編, The Teacher Is an Impatient Ass Enthusiast: Extra), and an extra chapter.

title.english: The Teacher Is an Unsatisfied Ass Enthusiast
title.native: 先生はタリない××ニスト

title.english: The Teacher Is an Impatient Ass Enthusiast: Extra
title.native: 先生はマない××ニスト 番外編

title.english: The Teacher Is a Selfish Ass Enthusiast
title.native: 先生はマタない××ニスト

188968.description:
A succubus, Litta, suddenly appears in front of high school student Misao. In order to become a full-fledged member of the community, she seduces Misao every night with her own hands and tricks! They are supposed to do it, but it's the first time for both of them and they are very shy…? This is the start of slightly naughty romantic comedy between both of them...

Notes:
• The manga was cancelled after the author passed away.
• The chapter count includes 2 extra chapters.

title.native: サキュバスさんのはつしごと。

188969.description: Rintaro and Haruto are two friends who enjoy playing the VRMMO Eternal Maze Online, a fantasy video game where you can be a different person from the real world and enjoy a second life. One day Rintaro finds a mysterious item called the Reincarnation Jewel in his inventory so he decides to use it and teleports himself and his friend to a fantasy world. Rintaro became his female avatar who is a magician and Haruto his male avatar a strong paladin. Both stunned by what happened, they will search for information on how to get out of this fantasy world while at the same time trying to survive in this strange world so that they can return to their normal life.

title.native: 女魔術師さん、元の世界へ還るためにがんばります
title.romaji: Onna Majutsushi-san, Moto no Sekai e Kaeru Tame ni Ganbarimasu

188970.description:
In order to prevent the villainous princess from bringing doom upon this world, Jiang Xu—who transmigrated into her imperial sister-in-law—does her very best to nurture Her Highness into a virtuous and well-behaved ruler, despite her own frail health. However, when she grew up, the haughty yet alluring princess unexpectedly pins Jiang Xu down onto the bed.

"If you can love my brother, why not me, too? Won’t you have a look my way, my dear sister-in-law?"

Jiang Xu: …If you think I’ve lived long enough and want to drive me mad, just say so!

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

188971.description:
The untold past of Ayakawa and Yamagishi before they started dating…!?

(Source: Core Magazine, translated)
synonyms: His Secret Office Romance Partner is Me. Extra Edition

title.native: 社内恋愛の相手は俺ですけど？ 番外編
title.romaji: Shanai Renai no Aite wa Ore desu kedo? Bangai-hen

188972.description:
Aiko, now in her first year of high school, reunites with her senior from her senior days, Masumi, and is invited to be the manager of the baseball team. Aiko has secretly had feelings for Masumi, who she has admired since middle school. However, whether Masumi knows about Aiko's feelings or not, he has been acting indifferent to everything outside of baseball... Just as Aiko is trying to forget her unrequited love, a baseball team member named Shiba Motohiko appears before her, claiming to know her from middle school.

(Source: Natalie, translated)

title.romaji: Haru no Yume wo Hashiru Kimi e

188974.description:
Hasumi the librarian has trouble expressing himself in front of others, and is secretly admiring Shiraishi, a person with an elegant smile that often comes to borrow books. Shiraishi's personality is exactly what Hasumi wants to become, but...

(Source: Ichijinsha, translated)
188974.hashtag: #インテリお兄さんと図書館職員
synonyms: The Intellectual Guy and The Librarian

title.native: インテリお兄さんと図書館職員

188975.description:
A love comedy about a high school girl, Rin, who loves cats but has an allergy to them, and a high school boy, Tachibana, who turns into a cat at night. Rin has always been known to be caring, and one day she finds a weak cat at the shrine where she visits to admire them. For some reason, she does not develop an allergy to the cat, so she decides to protect it at her home. Rin is savoring the bliss of being able to experience the cuteness of the cat up close, but when the morning comes, the cat turns into Tachibana, a classmate of the company president's son who is always unsociable...

(Source: Natalie, translated)

title.native: NHK その時歴史が動いた 戦国武将の野望編
title.romaji: NHK Sono Toki Rekishi ga Ugoita: Sengoku Bushou no Yabou-hen

188977.description:
As the 13th Imperial Prince and the last in line to the throne, Kilad was happy to live outside the palace as Captain of the Imperial Border Guards. With his childhood friend Alkina, Kilad had made it his life's mission to defend the World Tree that grows in Noble, a territory of the Drakuntus Empire. However, Kilad's life takes an unexpected turn when his older brother, Elliott, is assassinated. To everyone's surprise, Elliott had named Kilad as his successor to the Drakuntus throne.The 13th Imperial Prince must now lead the empire while protecting his life and the lives of those he holds dear.

(Source: Manta)

188978.description:
In the game, he plays as a strong character nearing the level cap. However, in real life, Lu Siqi is a highschooler with nothing left to live for. Only thinking about what is the meaning of being alive and death.
Operating as a meek female character in the game, in reality, Shi Liu is a self proclaimed sentient beast who is finding his next interesting prey behind the monitor screen.
The new update in《Fantasy ONLINE》added many new high level equips in the medium difficulty instance "Deville Labyrinth", which attracted many players to form groups.
Just like that, 647 who is planning to challege the instance, and Sixteen_16 who is looking for a new prey, met each other at the entrance of the instance—

(Source: Creative Comic, translated)

188979.description:
Based on characters from the Touhou Project series.
A new serialization has begun for a story brimming with emotion and lingering impressions that offers a glimpse into the casual interactions of fantasy girls.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

188980.description:
Unemployed and desperate, Ito Tohma stakes her life on a housekeeping job at a mansion in the middle of nowhere. But she's surprised to discover that it's actually for the Monster Center, a counseling office for monsters who disguise themselves as human! Now, she works at the Center to help the humanity-challenged with their problems.

(Source: K MANGA)

188981.description:
Workaholic Lee Da-In, the dazzling actress and national goddess, never saw herself walking down the aisle. But when her grandfather falls ill, she grants his final wish by marrying her failed one-night-stand, Seo Do-Jun. Suddenly, her life spins into chaos: handling wacky in-laws, dodging a junior actor's advances, and dealing with her hubby's ex. Armed with her trademark confidence and sass, she's ready to take it all on. But will this rollercoaster marriage ever find its happily ever after?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: วิวาห์ทระนง

188982.description:
The subcontractors were nothing more than robots I was grateful for. It was only natural to squeeze everything out of them. But after being betrayed by the group I worked for, I opened my eyes in a new body and finally saw the tears of those "robots." Having gained a second life on the brink of death, can my soul be saved?

(Source: Naver, translated)

188983.description:
Join the prince in training and his friends on a joy ride to the throne.

(Source: Toomics)

188985.description:
“You don’t know how long I’ve waited, Danny…all while staring at this name on my arm.”

After moving to the small town of Edendale with his son, single father Danny begins to be frequently visited by Stan. After the visits become more and more unnerving, Danny begs Stan to stop - to no avail. Claiming the two are fated to be together, Stan will do whatever it takes to fulfill his destiny…come hell or high water.

(Source: Lezhin US)

188986.description:
Kyouguchi Yamato is a man who has spent his entire life working and has no experience dating. Though he scolds his love-struck and distracted subordinates, he secretly regrets his own past, a life filled only with work, without any friends or love. One day, while browsing through his old photos folder, Yamato suddenly finds himself back in his college days. Will he be able to rewrite his gray, colorless youth?

(Source: TOPTOON, translated)

188987.description:
"I wanted to meet you, master. Sincerely"

Liam is a challenger who is as good as pro gamers, and a virgin. One day his friend promises him that she will set him up with a girl if Liam helps her boost her score in Legends of League. When he was playing the game at internet cafe, he ends up having a real life PK. Unexpected lucky encounters lead to game-like events.

(Source: DAYcomics)

188988.description:
Souya, the manager of a trading company in a small city, is a 37-year-old office worker who enjoys single life. One day, when he wakes up in a strange meadow, he sees two moons floating in the night sky and regains the memory of being transferred to another world 20 years ago. An uncle's adventure in a different world, wearing a business suit, with a low amount of tension, a high level of ability, and a cool but slightly pathetic personality.

(Source: Shousetsuka ni Narou, translated)

Note: An extra chapter is included.

title.native: 元異世界転移者だった課長のおじさん、人生二度目の異世界を駆け廻る
title.romaji: Moto Isekai Tenisha Datta Kachou no Oji-san, Jinsei Nidome no Isekai wo Kake Mawaru

188990.description:
Two people, each with their own unique condition—can they overcome their insecurities and find love?

(Source: Toomics)

188992.description:
Peperon was playing the well-known one-player VRRPG "Magic & Sword" with the restriction that only the seven weakest races were under his control. One day, he woke up and found that he had been transferred into the game. He had lost almost all of the countries that he had worked so hard to build when he was transferred. All that was left was his own body, which boasted a high status, and the six subordinates he had devoted so much effort to nurturing. In order to rebuild the nation he once built, "Gloria Septem," Peperon once again begins his conquest of another world!

Note: Chapter count includes five volume-bonus chapters.
synonyms: The Conquest Record of Magic & Sword: The Mightiest Nation of the Unfavorable Species

title.native: 異世界征服記～不遇種族たちの最強国家～
title.romaji: Isekai Seifukuki: Fuguu Shuzoku-tachi no Saikyou Kokka

188993.description:
Our company is pleasing to the eye! From the gentle team leader to the handsome CEO! However, I made a ridiculous mistake at the new employee welcome party. The wonderful team leader until yesterday is starting to turn away from me... I can't put an end to my love for the team leader like this! I was going straight and going straight until you accepted my virtue... But can someone tell me why this becomes a love affair and not a virtue?

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)
synonyms: It's Okay to Be Left Out
君にハマっても大丈夫

title.native: 異世界征服記～不遇種族たちの最強国家～
title.romaji: Isekai Seifukuki: Fuguu Shuzoku-tachi no Saikyou Kokka

188995.description:
A middle-aged engineer who was weary of life ended up being reborn into a different world as Zack, the son of a frontier feudal lord. Once there, he received a mission from God. He was told to prepare himself for the task of “guiding the future hero of the world”.

With that in mind, Zack not only trained himself in swordsmanship and magic but also committed himself towards reforming problems in hygiene and education. After developing a new local product, Zack was reminded of his once forgotten dream: brewing alcohol!

As he resurrected his long lost passion, it was the beginning of his “Dream Life”.

title.native: ドリーム・ライフ: 夢の異世界生活
title.romaji: Dream Life: Yume no Isekai Seikatsu

188996.description:
1. Koburiawase Zenpen (コブリアワセ 前編)
2. Koburiawase Kouhen (コブリアワセ 後編)

188997.description:
Makoto’s favorite childhood memories are of playing baseball with his best friend and former teammate Shusuke, the catcher of his baseball team. When Shusuke suddenly moved away, Makoto was left devastated, but he clung to the promise of the two of them someday reuniting for the championship game at Koshien Stadium. Now in high school, Makoto is the ace pitcher of the baseball team, and he and Hokuto, the team’s catcher, are an all-star duo. But then Shusuke suddenly transfers back to Makoto’s school, and it gets harder and harder for the boys to keep their heads in the game under the scorching heat of the baseball diamond…

(Source: Kodansha USA)

188998.description:
Imagine being summoned to another world to be the hero, beat the Demon King, and live an adventure...only to be forced to return to modern-day Japan. That's what happened to Hizaki Shio. Those exploits seem like forever ago—he is in high school now—even though it's only been three years.

But just as Hizaki has settled back into reality, he's suddenly summoned again and this time to stop the Secret Society, Helheim! However, Shio has a slightly cringey secret... He founded Helheim himself, during an embarrassing phase when he went around calling himself the Corpse King. It's physically painful to remember. So who could be using Helheim's name in his place, and how did it become so powerful? It's time to confront the marks he left behind. First stop: the Steel City of Gaghiel to rescue a noble heiress!

(Source: J-Novel Club)
synonyms: The Return of the Corpse King

188999.description:
Tina was born into the Valia family, a house renowned for their powerful command over magic, but when she fails to show any magical abilities, she is forced to live through daily taunts and abuse from her family. Then one day, Tina develops extremely rare dark magic powers. Unfortunately, dark magic is seen as a curse and those who wield it, abominations…

Tina soon finds herself imprisoned in a shack deep in the forest. After a year of this solitary and cruel existence, Tina is barely clinging to life when a mysterious nobleman appears before her and rescues her from her prison. She awakes in the estate of the Duke of Lawliet, to find her saviour is none other than Reiner Lawliet, head of the family and wielder of Holy Magic. With the help of Reiner’s love, Tina’s wounded heart slowly begins to heal, but can she truly find happiness despite her curse?

(Source: Pocket Comics)
